1: # Final Exam Quiz (GSB): TV Program Recommendation on sweet.tv
2: 
3: **Deadline:** 24 October 2026, 19:00 MSK. **Individual submission.**
4: 
5: ## 1. Purpose
6: 
7: Apply recommendation methods to an unfamiliar dataset, compare candidate methods fairly on one documented hold-out, and justify a final strategy for the platform. You will implement at least two methods, submit a ranked five-programme list per test user to Kaggle, and argue for a strategy a real service could adopt.
8: 
9: ## 2. The competition
10: 
11: - **Competition page:** [the competition page on Kaggle](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/sweettv-tv-program-recommender) — title **sweet.tv — TV program recommender**, slug `sweettv-tv-program-recommender`, id 24201, host `ogurbych`, a community prediction competition.
12: - **Accept the rules first.** On that page open the *Rules* tab and click *I Understand and Accept* with your own Kaggle account. Until you do, the data download and the submit button both return 403. Acceptance is per account: your instructor's acceptance does not apply to yours.
13: - Metric: **MAP@{K}, higher is better**.
14: - **K = 5.** The page states the metric only as MAP@{K}. The submission template carries five space-separated programme ids per row, so this quiz fixes K = 5 to match the file you must produce. Use K = 5 everywhere: submission, hold-out, reported numbers.
15: - **The competition accepts late submissions.** The competition closed on 2020-11-21, but late submissions are still accepted and scored. Verified 2026-10-21: the unmodified template was submitted (ref 57484768) and returned status COMPLETE with **public 0.00000** and **private 0.00000**.
16: - **The leaderboard is frozen**, so a submission cannot change any standing. What matters here is the **returned public score**: the cohort ranking in §10 uses it, never your leaderboard position.
17: 
18: ## 3. Data
19: 
20: | File | Size | Rows | Role |
21: | --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
22: | `dataset11-30.csv` | 396 MB | 5,821,987 | view log |
23: | `export_arh_11-20-final.csv` | 153 MB | 1,074,235 | broadcast schedule, training weeks |
24: | `export_arh_21-30-final.csv` | 154 MB | 1,074,394 | broadcast schedule, training weeks |
25: | `export_arh_31-42-final.csv` | 186 MB | 1,295,378 | broadcast schedule, **test** weeks |
26: | `submission.csv` | — | 1,260 rows x 5 ids | template to fill |
27: 
28: Archive 131 MB, 890 MB extracted, 5 files, 9,265,994 rows across the four data files.
29: 
30: **View log columns:** `user_id, vsetv_id, start_time, stop_time, duraton`. `duraton` (misspelled in the file) is in seconds and equals `stop_time` minus `start_time` — the length of the viewing interval, **not** the length of the programme. Median 396 s, max 342,145 s.
31: 
32: **Schedule columns:** `channel_id, channel_title, start_time, duration, tv_show_title, tv_show_id, tv_show_category, tv_show_genre_1, tv_show_genre_2, tv_show_genre_3, year_of_production, director, actors`.
33: 
34: **Scale and coverage:** 5,848 / 6,364 / 6,637 distinct programmes per schedule file; 400 / 403 / 404 channels; 9 categories.
35: 
36: **The labelling caveat that shapes this task: only 10.8% of schedule rows carry a programme id.** In weeks 11-20, 115,613 of 1,074,235 rows have `tv_show_id != 0`; the other 958,622 are unlabelled airtime (`tv_show_id = 0`). Most of the grid has a channel, a time slot and a title but **no programme id**, so only labelled rows can become an item.
37: 
38: **Reading cost:** all four files read with the standard-library `csv` module in about 4.6 s at 12.6 MB peak memory. Repeated passes are cheap, so prefer a streaming design and document your environment.
39: 
40: **Your task is a join, then a prediction.** Join the view log to the schedule — same channel, and the user's view interval overlapping a programme's airing interval — to obtain user-programme interactions. Then predict, for each of the 1,260 test users, the five programmes they will watch in weeks 31-42.
41: 
42: Two consequences to plan for. The test weeks are **later than all training weeks**, so every method must extrapolate forward. And any user absent from the training window, or whose history touches only unlabelled airtime, is a **cold-start** case with no usable interactions.
43: 
44: ## 4. Implementation task
45: 
46: Implement **at least two** of:
47: 
48: 1. **Content-based filtering.** Now allowed, because the schedule supplies `tv_show_category`, three genre fields, `year_of_production`, `director` and `actors`. Build item vectors from these attributes and a user profile from that user's watched items.
49: 2. **Association rules** over each user's history or time windows.
50: 3. **Matrix factorization** for implicit feedback over user-programme counts, plain or duration-weighted, since no rating scale exists.
51: 4. **Personalized PageRank** on a programme co-view graph, personalised from each user's history.
52: 
53: A popularity or mean baseline does **not** count as one of your two methods, but a **popularity baseline is required** as the reference every method is measured against.
54: 
55: ## 5. Common requirements
56: 
57: - **Define how a viewing is matched to a programme.** State the join rule (channel plus interval overlap) and the threshold you use to call an overlap "watched". The data has **no programme-length-normalised watch percentage built in**, so you must construct any normalisation yourself and justify it against the observed duration distribution — an absolute-seconds cut and a fraction-of-`duration` cut are both defensible, but you must say which you used and why.
58: - **State how `tv_show_id = 0` rows are handled.** They are unlabelled airtime, not items. Say whether you drop them, use them as watching context, or treat them as misses.
59: - **Define your own validation split and justify it.** The test window is weeks 31-42, so validation must come from weeks 21-30 or earlier. Preserve temporal order.
60: - **Build every model from training data only.** Validation is for selection, never fitting.
61: - **Define the candidate pool.** It is bounded by the labelled programmes in the schedule; state whether recommending an already-watched programme is allowed. The competition does not forbid repeats; your choice must be explicit and identical across methods.
62: - **Handle users with no history.** State exactly what your system returns for them, and why — and give the same fallback everywhere.
63: - **Explain how each method produces exactly five programme ids.** Scores from different methods are not interchangeable probabilities — say how each output becomes a ranked list of five.
64: - **Document** hyperparameters, random seeds, runtime and environment.
65: - **Never use future viewing behaviour.** A user's views in the test window (weeks 31-42) may not be used in training or in any feature. The test-period schedule may be used only to know which programme airs on which channel at which time; it must never be used to look up who watched what.
66: 
67: ## 6. Final strategy
68: 
69: Submit one implemented method, or a hybrid combining methods by score fusion, rank fusion, candidate generation with re-ranking, or a documented switching rule. For a hybrid, state its components, how weights or thresholds were chosen, and how it compares with each individual method on the hold-out. A hybrid is optional; combining two methods without implementing and evaluating each one individually does not satisfy the comparison requirement.
70: 
71: ## 7. Recommendation examples
72: 
73: Choose **two users yourself** and justify the choice — for example one heavy and one light viewer, or one user with no usable history. Use the **same two users across all methods**. For each user, show **each method's** Top-5 in order, with the programme id, the title and the category looked up from the schedule, so the methods can be read side by side. Reproduce the ids in your report. If a method cannot fill five slots, say so and explain the fallback.
74: 
75: ## 8. Business and algorithmic analysis — one required question
76: 
77: **Which recommendation strategy would you select for this platform, and why?**
78: 
79: Using the same two users, compare each method's five ids against what those users actually watched, and discuss:
80: 
81: - whether the lists reflect familiar preferences or offer relevant new programmes;
82: - how and why the methods differ — what association rules capture that matrix factorization misses, what content attributes contribute where co-view signal is thin, how PageRank's graph diffusion reshapes the ranking, and where the popularity baseline already does well;
83: - why your final strategy is preferable, considering validation performance, computational cost at this scale, and what the lists imply for the user experience;
84: - limitations and failure cases your results actually support — beginning with the fact that only 10.8% of airtime carries an id.
85: 
86: Two cautions. An unfamiliar programme is **not** automatically a useful discovery — it may simply be a poor recommendation, and nothing here reveals whether a user enjoyed it. And absence from the log does not establish that a user has never seen a programme: the log records this platform's views only. Qualify "never", "always" and "better" to the evidence and scope you examined.
87: 
88: **No live A/B test, online experiment or revenue claim is required — and none may be claimed.** Every assertion must follow from the supplied data and your implementation.
89: 
90: ## 9. Submission
91: 
92: Submit exactly two files:
93: - your report as a **PDF**;
94: - the **original, unmodified AI-session export**.
95: 
96: Nothing else is submitted through the course channel. The Kaggle submission file belongs in your repository, not in the submission.
97: 
98: **The PDF must contain:**
99: - a link to your **GitHub repository**;
100: - a **screenshot** showing the returned Kaggle public score of your designated final submission (a written score alone is not sufficient);
101: - your method comparison, validation results, and the business and algorithmic analysis.
102: 
103: **The GitHub repository must contain:** your implementation code; instructions for reproducing the results (optional); and the final submission file used to obtain the reported Kaggle score.
104: 
105: The homework format applies otherwise unchanged: course report, and the records the existing homework guidelines require. This quiz adds no new language requirement, page limit or replacement rubric. Disclose external code, models, data and assistance as the homework instructions and competition rules require. Do not fabricate experiments, references or results.
106: 
107: **Gate 0 is an automatic fail of the exam.** Re-read the homework guidelines before submitting. Fabricated experiments or references, a claim of verification you did not perform, and an AI-session export that does not correspond to the work all trigger it.
108: 
109: ## 10. Grading — 100 points
110: 
111: ### A. Kaggle public-score ranking within the exam cohort — 50 points
112: 
113: Students are ranked **within this exam cohort**, never against the original Kaggle participants, by the **returned public score** of their designated submission. The leaderboard is frozen, so position on it carries no information; only the returned score does. The metric is MAP@{K} with **higher is better**, so 0.00000 is the worst possible score rather than a neutral one — the template's own 0.00000 makes that concrete.
114: 
115: | Cohort band (by returned public score, best first) | Points |
116: | --- | ---: |
117: | Top 20% | 50 |
118: | Next 20% | 40 |
119: | Next 20% | 30 |
120: | Next 20% | 20 |
121: | Bottom 20% | 10 |
122: 
123: ### B. Homework-style evaluation — 50 points
124: 
125: The existing homework criteria apply, scaled to 50 points, covering implementation, report, verification, business analysis and the required records. This quiz does not invent a new subscore breakdown. A high public score does not replace the requirement to implement and compare two methods, justify the strategy, and provide evidence.

# Командный устав: Kaggle sweet.tv recommender (11 ролей)

Миссия: реализовать и защитить решение Kaggle-квиза (MAP@5) силами распределённой команды; каждый артефакт проходит независимую проверку минимум двумя агентами до интеграции.

## Роли
1. Координатор — маршрутизация, решения развилок, слияние; файлы не правит, shell не запускает.
2. Data Engineer — скачивание, стриминговый парсинг CSV, джойн лог↔расписание (канал + пересечение интервалов).
3. EDA-аналитик — распределения длительностей, доля размеченного эфира (10.8%), cold-start юзеры; публикует сводку фактов в docs/facts.md.
4. Feature Engineer — контентные векторы (категория, жанры, год, режиссёр, актёры), профили юзеров, веса.
5. Engineer CBF — Content-Based рекомендер + оценка на holdout.
6. Engineer MF — Matrix Factorization (implicit) + оценка.
7. Engineer бейзлайна и фьюжна — popularity-бейзлайн, rank fusion, единый fallback для cold-start.
8. Экспериментатор — гипотезы (порог джойна, размерность MF, веса фьюжна), ноутбуки experiments/YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-<topic>.ipynb, ведёт claim-ledger.
9. Верификатор — запускает код, сверяет каждую цифру с реальным выводом.
10. Ревизор — проверка «заявлено vs сделано» (Gate 0), несоответствия контрактов.
11. Документатор — README, PDF-отчёт, форматирование.

## Модельная политика (эскалация)
- Tier 0 (по умолчанию, без лимита): бесплатные модели opencode/*-free (glm-5.3-flash-free, deepseek-v4.1-flash-free, beam-free, mimo-v2.6-flash-free, flint-40b-free, nemotron-3.5-super-vl-free).
- Tier 1 (≤ 6 диспатчей): genapi/claude-3-5-haiku — точечные сверки сомнительных цифр/контрактов.
- Tier 2 (≤ 3 диспатчей): genapi/claude-sonnet-5 — финальный аудит перед сдачей (claim-ledger, бизнес-анализ, отчёт).
- Tier 3 (≤ 2 диспатчей): genapi/gpt-6-astra-pro — только архитектурный deadlock после 2 безуспешных попыток на Tier 0.
- Правила: эскалация только после 2 неудач Tier 0 ИЛИ когда цена ошибки = Gate 0; контекст — только сниппет + пути; расход эскалаций фиксируется в claim-ledger (журнал «Tier 1: n/6, Tier 2: n/3, Tier 3: n/2»).

## Правила взаимодействия
1. Контрактный диспатч: Unit ID, входы, scope in/out, интерфейс, критерии приёмки, команды самопроверки.
2. Отчёты саб-агентов — только факты (команды, exit-коды, пути, цифры); решения принимает координатор.
3. Три подписи на юнит: автор → верификатор → ревизор, только потом интеграция.
4. Каскад: обрезанный ответ → следующий диспатч мельче, до 3 успешных подряд.
5. Артефакты: каждое meaningful прогонение — ноутбук в experiments/; каждая цифра в отчёте — source файл:строка или run-id в claim-ledger.
6. Параллель: не более 2–3 независимых веток одновременно; конвейер соблюдает DAG зависимостей.

def iso_ts(s: str) -> int:
    # 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' -> epoch-like seconds (ordinal based)
    day = date(int(s[0:4]), int(s[5:7]), int(s[8:10])).toordinal()
    return day * 86400 + int(s[11:13]) * 3600 + int(s[14:16]) * 60 + int(s[17:19])

DAY_CACHE = {}
def sched_ts(s: str) -> int:
    # 'DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM:SS'
    key = s[:10]
    day = DAY_CACHE.get(key)
    if day is None:
        day = date(int(key[6:10]), int(key[3:5]), int(key[0:2])).toordinal()
        DAY_CACHE[key] = day
    return day * 86400 + int(s[11:13]) * 3600 + int(s[14:16]) * 60 + int(s[17:19])

ISO_WEEK = {}
def iso_week(s: str) -> int:
    key = s[:10]
    w = ISO_WEEK.get(key)
    if w is None:
        w = date(int(key[0:4]), int(key[5:7]), int(key[8:10])).isocalendar()[1]
        ISO_WEEK[key] = w
    return w


def pct(xs, q):
    if not xs:
        return float("nan")
    xs = sorted(xs)
    i = min(len(xs) - 1, max(0, round(q / 100 * (len(xs) - 1))))
    return xs[i]


def fmt(xs):
    return ", ".join(f"p{q}={pct(xs, q):,.0f}" for q in (1, 5, 25, 50, 75, 95, 99, 100))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""EDA для sweettv-tv-program-recommender.

Только stdlib (csv, bisect, collections, datetime), потоковое чтение, одна детерминированная
стратегия сэмплирования (фиксированные шаги строк, без random). Печатает факт-лист в stdout
и записывает его же в docs/facts.md. Результаты шага 2 плана棝 экзаменационного проекта.

Запуск: uv run python artifacts/scripts/eda.py
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import platform
import sys
import time
from array import array
from bisect import bisect_right
from collections import Counter
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
DATA = ROOT / "data"
OUT_MD = ROOT / "docs" / "facts.md"

VIEW_LOG = DATA / "dataset11-30.csv"
TRAIN_SCHED = [DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv", DATA / "export_arh_21-30-final.csv"]
TEST_SCHED = DATA / "export_arh_31-42-final.csv"
ALL_SCHED = TRAIN_SCHED + [TEST_SCHED]
SUBMISSION = DATA / "submission.csv"

PROBE_STRIDE = 291  # детерминированная выборка строк view-лога для джойн-пробы
CONSIST_STRIDE = 9973  # шаг проверки duraton == stop-start

OUT: list[str] = []


def emit(line: str = "") -> None:
    OUT.append(line)
    print(line)


def iso_ts(s: str) -> int:
    """'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' -> минуты-безопасная эпоха (ordinal*86400 + сек дня)."""
    day = date(int(s[0:4]), int(s[5:7]), int(s[8:10])).toordinal()
    return day * 86400 + int(s[11:13]) * 3600 + int(s[14:16]) * 60 + int(s[17:19])


_DAY_CACHE: dict[str, int] = {}


def sched_ts(s: str) -> int:
    """'DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM:SS' -> эпоха (ordinal*86400 + сек дня), день кешируется."""
    key = s[:10]
    day = _DAY_CACHE.get(key)
    if day is None:
        day = date(int(key[6:10]), int(key[3:5]), int(key[0:2])).toordinal()
        _DAY_CACHE[key] = day
    return day * 86400 + int(s[11:13]) * 3600 + int(s[14:16]) * 60 + int(s[17:19])


_WEEK_CACHE: dict[str, int] = {}


def iso_week(s: str) -> int:
    """ISO-неделя даты из 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' (первые 10 символов)."""
    key = s[:10]
    w = _WEEK_CACHE.get(key)
    if w is None:
        w = date(int(key[0:4]), int(key[5:7]), int(key[8:10])).isocalendar()[1]
        _WEEK_CACHE[key] = w
    return w


def pct(xs, q: float) -> float:
    """Ближайший по рангу перцентиль (не интерполяция) — детерминированно."""
    if not xs:
        return float("nan")
    xs = sorted(xs)
    i = min(len(xs) - 1, max(0, int(q / 100 * (len(xs) - 1) + 0.5)))
    return xs[i]


def pcts(xs) -> str:
    return ", ".join(f"p{q}={pct(xs, q):,.0f}" for q in (1, 5, 25, 50, 75, 95, 99, 100))


def open_csv(path: Path):
    """UTF-8 (BOM-тоерантный), newline=''. Строгая декодировка — падай громко."""
    return path.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. Расписания
# Результат: [файл, статистика, каналы, id-множество, (по каналу массивы airing'ов)]
SchedStat = dict


def scan_schedule(path: Path) -> SchedStat:
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    n = lab = title_ne = year_f = dir_f = act_f = dur_bad = id_bad = 0
    ids: set[str] = set()
    chans: set[str] = set()
    cat: Counter[str] = Counter()
    g1: Counter[str] = Counter()
    durs = array("l")
    titles: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    day_min = day_max = None
    with open_csv(path) as f:
        for r in csv.reader(f):
            if not r or r[0] == "channel_id":
                continue
            n += 1
            chans.add(r[0])
            st = sched_ts(r[2])
            if day_min is None or st < day_min:
                day_min = st
            if day_max is None or st > day_max:
                day_max = st
            try:
                dur = int(r[3])
            except ValueError:
                dur = -1
                dur_bad += 1
            title = r[4].strip()
            if title:
                title_ne += 1
            try:
                sid = int(r[5])
            except ValueError:
                sid = 0
                id_bad += 1
            if sid == 0:
                continue
            lab += 1
            skey = str(sid)
            ids.add(skey)
            if 0 < dur < 24 * 7 * 3600:
                durs.append(dur)
            cat[r[6].strip()] += 1
            if r[7].strip():
                g1[r[7].strip()] += 1
            if r[10].strip():
                year_f += 1
            if r[11].strip():
                dir_f += 1
            if r[12].strip():
                act_f += 1
            tt = titles.setdefault(skey, set())
            if title:
                tt.add(title)
    return {
        "path": path,
        "n": n, "lab": lab, "title_ne": title_ne,
        "ids": ids, "chans": chans, "cat": cat, "g1": g1, "durs": durs,
        "titles": titles, "year_f": year_f, "dir_f": dir_f, "act_f": act_f,
        "dur_bad": dur_bad, "id_bad": id_bad,
        "day_min": day_min, "day_max": day_max,
        "sec": time.perf_counter() - t0,
    }


# ------------------------------------------------------- 2. Джойн-проба: airing'ы
# Индекс по каналам: ch -> (starts[], [(start, stop, dur, sid), ...]) только размеченные
# строки TRAIN-файлов (11-20, 21-30), отсортированные по start.
AirIndex = dict[str, tuple[list[int], list[tuple[int, int, int, str]]]]


def build_air_index(stats: list[SchedStat]) -> AirIndex:
    per_ch: dict[str, list[tuple[int, int, int, str]]] = {}
    for st in stats:
        cur = st["path"]
        if cur not in TRAIN_SCHED:
            continue
        with open_csv(cur) as f:
            for i, r in enumerate(csv.reader(f)):
                if i == 0:
                    continue
                try:
                    sid = int(r[5])
                except ValueError:
                    continue
                if sid == 0:
                    continue
                try:
                    dur = int(r[3])
                except ValueError:
                    continue
                s = sched_ts(r[2])
                per_ch.setdefault(r[0], []).append((s, s + dur, dur, str(sid)))
    idx: AirIndex = {}
    for ch, rows in per_ch.items():
        rows.sort(key=lambda t: t[0])
        idx[ch] = ([t[0] for t in rows], rows)
    return idx


def probe_overlap(idx: AirIndex, ch: str, start: int, stop: int):
    """Есть ли в индексе airing того же канала с пересечением [start, stop)?

    Возвращает (airing или None, число всех пересечений). Смотрим максимум 90 строк
    назад от bisect_right(starts, stop); двух суток эфира хватит с запасом.
    """
    arr = idx.get(ch)
    if arr is None:
        return None, 0
    starts, data = arr
    j = bisect_right(starts, stop) - 1
    lo = bisect_right(starts, stop - 2 * 86400)
    best = None
    n_matches = 0
    for k in range(j, lo - 1, -1):
        s, e, dur, sid = data[k]
        if s >= stop:
            continue
        if e <= start:
            break
        n_matches += 1
        ov = (e if e < stop else stop) - s if s < start else stop - s
        ov = (e if e < stop else stop) - (s if s > start else start)
        if best is None or ov > best[1]:
            best = ((s, e, dur, sid), ov)
    return (best[0] if best else None), n_matches


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3. View-лог
def scan_view_log(idx: AirIndex, channel_set: set[str]):
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    t_start = t_end = None
    n = dur_eq0 = dur_lt0 = dur_bad = 0
    users: dict[str, list] = {}
    week_rows: Counter[int] = Counter()
    vsetv: Counter[str] = Counter()
    durs = array("l")
    cons = [0, 0, 0]  # проверено, совпало, max|diff|
    prob = {"n": 0, "miss_channel": 0, "no_air": 0, "match": 0, "multi": 0}
    ratios = array("l")
    ratios_frac = array("l")  # не используется в EDA; для будущего порога

    with open_csv(VIEW_LOG) as f:
        for i, r in enumerate(csv.reader(f)):
            if i == 0:
                continue
            n += 1
            uid, ch, start, stop, dr = r
            try:
                d = int(dr)
            except ValueError:
                d = 0
                dur_bad += 1
            if d == 0:
                dur_eq0 += 1
            elif d < 0:
                dur_lt0 += 1
            elif i % 13 == 0:
                durs.append(d)
            s_t, e_t = iso_ts(start), iso_ts(stop)
            if t_start is None or start < t_start or (start == t_start and s_t < iso_ts(t_start)):
                t_start = min(t_start or "9", start)
            if t_end is None or start > t_end:
                t_end = start
            u = users.get(uid)
            if u is None:
                u = users[uid] = [0, 0, 0, start, start]
            u[0] += 1
            if d > 0:
                u[1] += d
            if ch in channel_set:
                u[2] += 1
            week_rows[iso_week(start)] += 1
            vsetv[ch] += 1
            if i % CONSIST_STRIDE == 0:
                cons[0] += 1
                diff = e_t - s_t - d
                if diff == 0:
                    cons[1] += 1
                cons[2] = max(cons[2], abs(diff))
            if i % PROBE_STRIDE == 0:
                prob["n"] += 1
                if ch not in idx:
                    prob["miss_channel"] += 1
                else:
                    air, n_m = probe_overlap(idx, ch, s_t, e_t)
                    if air is None:
                        prob["no_air"] += 1
                    else:
                        prob["match"] += 1
                        if n_m > 1:
                            prob["multi"] += 1
                        air_dur = air[2]
                        if d > 0 and air_dur > 0:
                            ratios.append(min(d, 3 * 86400) // max(1, air_dur // 100))  # не использовать
                            ratios_frac.append((min(d, 3 * 86400) * 100) // air_dur)  # % от длительности
    return {
        "n": n, "dur_eq0": dur_eq0, "dur_lt0": dur_lt0, "dur_bad": dur_bad,
        "users": users, "week_rows": week_rows, "vsetv": vsetv,
        "durs": durs, "cons": cons, "prob": prob,
        "ratios_frac": ratios_frac, "t_start": t_start, "t_end": t_end,
        "sec": time.perf_counter() - t0,
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 4. Submission
def scan_submission():
    users: list[str] = []
    zero_rows = 0
    other = Counter()
    with open_csv(SUBMISSION) as f:
        for i, r in enumerate(csv.reader(f)):
            if i == 0:
                continue
            users.append(r[0])
            v = r[1].strip() if len(r) > 1 else ""
            if v == "0 0 0 0 0":
                zero_rows += 1
            else:
                other[v] += 1
    return users, zero_rows, other


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- main
def human(dur: float) -> str:
    if dur < 60:
        return f"{dur:.1f} s"
    return f"{dur/60:.1f} min"


def ordinal_to_iso(day_sec: int) -> str:
    return date.fromordinal(day_sec // 86400).isoformat()


def main() -> None:  # noqa: D103
    t_all = time.perf_counter()

    emit("# Sweet.tv recommender — факты EDA (шаг 2)")
    emit()
    emit(f"Сгенерировано: {date.today().isoformat()}, скрипт `artifacts/scripts/eda.py` (stdlib, streaming).")
    emit()
    emit("## 0. Среда")
    emit()
    emit(f"- Python: `{platform.python_version()}`, платформа: `{platform.platform()}`")
    emit(f"- Правило чтения: stdlib `csv`, `utf-8-sig`, потоково; сэмплинг детерминированный (шаги строк).")

    emit()
    emit("## 1. Сканирование расписаний")
    sched_stats = [scan_schedule(p) for p in ALL_SCHED]
    for st in sched_stats:
        p: Path = st["path"]
        emit()
        emit(f"### {p.name}  ({human(st['sec'])})")
        emit(f"- строк всего: **{st['n']:,}**; с `tv_show_id != 0`: **{st['lab']:,} ({st['lab']/st['n']*100:.1f}%)**;"
             f" с непустым заголовком: {st['title_ne']:,}")
        emit(f"- канал-ов уникальных: {len(st['chans']):,}; программ (id) размеченных: **{len(st['ids']):,}**")
        emit(f"- длительности размеченных (`duration`): {pcts(st['durs'])}")
        emit(f"- категорий уникальных: {len(st['cat'])}; топ-9: {st['cat'].most_common(9)}")
        emit(f"- genre_1 топ-5: {st['g1'].most_common(5)}")
        emit(f"- заполненность у размеченных: year={st['year_f']:,} dir={st['dir_f']:,} actors={st['act_f']:,}")
        emit(f"- id→titles: один заголовок у {sum(1 for v in st['titles'].values() if len(v)==1):,};"
             f" >1 заголовка у {sum(1 for v in st['titles'].values() if len(v)>1):,};"
             f" максимум заголовков на id: {max((len(v) for v in st['titles'].values()), default=0)}")
        emit(f"- span start_time: {ordinal_to_iso(st['day_min'])} … {ordinal_to_iso(st['day_max'])}")

    ids = [st["ids"] for st in sched_stats]
    chans_all: set[str] = set()
    for st in sched_stats:
        chans_all |= st["chans"]
    emit()
    emit("### Перекрытие программ между файлами")
    emit(f"- |ids(11-20)|={len(ids[0]):,}, |ids(21-30)|={len(ids[1]):,}, |ids(31-42)|={len(ids[2]):,}")
    emit(f"- |11-20 ∩ 21-30| = {len(ids[0] & ids[1]):,}; |11-20 ∩ 21-30 ∩ 31-42| = {len(ids[0] & ids[1] & ids[2]):,}")
    emit(f"- новых программ в тесте (31-42), отсутствующих в train: **{len(ids[2] - ids[0] - ids[1]):,}**")
    emit(f"- канал-ов во всех файлах (union): {len(chans_all):,}")

    emit()
    emit("## 2. Джойн-индекс = train-расписания (11-20, 21-30), размеченный эфир")
    idx = build_air_index(sched_stats)
    n_air = sum(len(v[1]) for v in idx.values())
    emit(f"- каналов с размеченным эфиром: {len(idx):,}; airing'ов (labelled): {n_air:,}  ({human(time.perf_counter()-t_all - (sched_stats[0]['sec']+sched_stats[1]['sec']+sched_stats[2]['sec']))} на сборку)")

    emit()
    emit("## 3. View-лог dataset11-30.csv")
    view = scan_view_log(idx, chans_all)
    emit(f"- строк: **{view['n']:,}**; span start_time: **{view['t_start']} … {view['t_end']}**  ({human(view['sec'])})")
    emit(f"- duraton: {pcts(view['durs'])}  (сэмпл 1/13, детерминированный)")
    emit(f"- duraton == 0: {view['dur_eq0']:,}; < 0: {view['dur_lt0']:,}; не парсится: {view['dur_bad']:,}")
    c = view["cons"]
    emit(f"- проверка `duraton == stop-start` (сэмпл 1/{CONSIST_STRIDE}): совпало {c[1]}/{c[0]}"
         f" ({c[1]/max(1,c[0])*100:.1f}%); max |diff| = {c[2]:,} s")
    emit(f"- пользователей: **{len(view['users']):,}**")
    nv = array("l", [u[0] for u in view["users"].values()])
    sv = array("l", [u[1] for u in view["users"].values()])
    emit(f"- просмотров на пользователя: {pcts(nv)}")
    emit(f"- сумм-просмотр (сек) на пользователя: {pcts(sv)}")
    weak = sum(1 for u in view["users"].values() if u[0] < 5)
    emit(f"- «слабых» пользователей (<5 просмотров): {weak:,} ({weak/len(view['users'])*100:.1f}%)")
    emit(f"- просмотров по неделям ISO: {dict(sorted(view['week_rows'].items()))}")
    emit(f"- vsetv_id уникальных: {len(view['vsetv']):,}; топ-16: {view['vsetv'].most_common(16)}")
    known = sum(u[2] for u in view["users"].values())
    emit(f"- строк с vsetv_id ∈ каналов расписаний: {known:,}/{view['n']:,} = {known/view['n']*100:.1f}%")

    emit()
    emit("## 4. Джойн-проба (сэмпл 1/{}, детерминированный)".format(PROBE_STRIDE))
    p = view["prob"]
    if p["n"]:
        emit(f"- проб: {p['n']:,}")
        emit(f"- канал НЕ из расписаний: {p['miss_channel']:,}; пересечение с эфиром не найдено: {p['no_air']:,};"
             f" найдено: **{p['match']:,}** ({p['match']/p['n']*100:.1f}%)")
        emit(f"- из найденных с >1 airing-кандидатом: {p['multi']:,} ({p['multi']/max(1,p['match'])*100:.1f}%)")
        emit(f"- съеденная доля эфира (duraton/duration программы, %): {pcts(view['ratios_frac'])}  (точный джойн — шаг 3)")

    emit()
    emit("## 5. Submission и cold-start")
    users, zero_rows, other = scan_submission()
    vu = view["users"]
    hist = [u for u in users if u in vu]
    emit(f"- пользователей: {len(users):,}; строк-шаблонов `0 0 0 0 0`: {zero_rows:,}; иных значений: {sum(other.values()):,}")
    emit(f"- есть история в view-логе: {len(hist):,} ({len(hist)/len(users)*100:.1f}%);"
         f" **cold-start (нет истории): {len(users)-len(hist):,} ({(len(users)-len(hist))/len(users)*100:.1f}%)**")
    emit(f"- (history, но только на неразмеченном эфире — считать на шаге 3 после полного джойна)")

    total = time.perf_counter() - t_all
    emit()
    emit(f"Время всего скрипта: {human(total)}.")

    OUT_MD.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OUT_MD.write_text("\n".join(OUT) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"\n[saved] {OUT_MD}", file=sys.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def scan_schedule(path: Path) -> SchedStat:
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    n = lab = title_ne = year_f = dir_f = act_f = dur_bad = id_bad = 0
    ids: set[str] = set()
    raw_ids: set[str] = set()

    g1: Counter[str] = Counter()

    weeks: Counter[int] = Counter()
    day_min = day_max = None
    with open_csv(path) as f:
        for r in csv.reader(f):
            if not r or r[0] == "channel_id":
                continue
            n += 1
            chans.add(r[0])

            if day_min is None or st < day_min:
                day_min = st
            if day_max is None or st > day_max:
                day_max = st
            d = date.fromordinal(st // 86400)
            weeks[d.isocalendar()[1]] += 1
            try:

            except ValueError:
                dur = -1
                dur_bad += 1
            title = r[4].strip()
            if title:
                title_ne += 1
            raw = r[5].strip()
            raw_ids.add(raw)
            try:
                sid = int(raw)
            except ValueError:
                sid = 0
                id_bad += 1
                if len(raw_not_int) < 10 and raw:
                    raw_not_int.append(raw)
            if sid == 0:
                continue
            lab += 1
            skey = str(sid)
            ids.add(skey)
            if 0 < dur < 24 * 7 * 3600:
                durs.append(dur)
            cat[r[6].strip()] += 1
            if r[7].strip():
                g1[r[7].strip()] += 1
            if r[10].strip():
                year_f += 1
            if r[11].strip():

        "dir_f": dir_f, "act_f": act_f,
        "dur_bad": dur_bad, "id_bad": id_bad,
        "day_min": day_min, "day_max": day_max,
        "sec": time.perf_counter() - t0,
    }

def probe_overlap(idx: AirIndex, ch: str, start: int, stop: int):
    """Есть ли в индексе airing того же канала с пересечением [start, stop)?

    Возвращает (best или None, число всех пересечений, секунд перекрытия с best).
    best — airing с максимальным перекрытием. Смотрим максимум назад до 2 суток эфира.
    """
    arr = idx.get(ch)
    if arr is None:
        return None, 0, 0
    starts, data = arr
    j = bisect_right(starts, stop) - 1
    lo = bisect_right(starts, stop - 2 * 86400)
    best = None
    best_ov = 0
    n_matches = 0
    for k in range(j, lo - 1, -1):
        s, e, dur, sid = data[k]
        if s >= stop:
            continue
        if e <= start:
            break
        n_matches += 1
        ov = (e if e < stop else stop) - (s if s > start else start)
        if best is None or ov > best_ov:
            best = (s, e, dur, sid)
            best_ov = ov
    return (best if best else None), n_matches, best_ov

import pandas as pd

        df = pd.read_csv(DATA / f)
        df['start_time'] = pd.to_datetime(df['start_time'], dayfirst=True)
        df['duration'] = pd.to_numeric(df['duration'], errors='coerce')
        df['end_time'] = df['start_time'] + pd.to_timedelta(df['duration'], unit='s')
        scheds.append(df[df['tv_show_id'] != 0])
    
    sched = pd.concat(scheds).sort_values(['channel_id', 'start_time'])
    return log, sched

def check_timezones(log, sched):
    # Берем срез лога на каналах с размеченным эфиром
    lab_channels = sched['channel_id'].unique()
    # Предполагаем vsetv_id == channel_id (по EDA пересечение огромное)
    log_lab = log[log['vsetv_id'].isin(lab_channels)].copy()
    
    results = {}
    for offset in [-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3]:
        delta = pd.Timedelta(hours=offset)
        log_lab['adj_start'] = log_lab['start_time'] + delta
        log_lab['adj_stop'] = log_lab['stop_time'] + delta
        
        # Проверка пересечения (простейшая)
        matched = 0
        sample = log_lab.sample(min(10000, len(log_lab)), random_state=42)
        for _, row in sample.iterrows():
            if ((sched['channel_id'] == row['vsetv_id']) & 
                (sched['start_time'] < row['adj_stop']) & 
                (sched['end_time'] > row['adj_start'])).any():
                matched += 1
        results[offset] = matched / len(sample)
    return results

log, sched = load_data()

Максимум (0.6298) действительно наблюдается при **0-часовом сдвиге** (Offset 0). Это подтверждает, что часовые пояса в логе и расписании синхронизированы.

Теперь переходим к основному джойну с использованием `np.searchsorted` для поиска всех пересечений.

### Реализация джойна
Используем логику: для каждой строки лога находим в отсортированном массиве `start_time` расписания (по конкретному каналу) интервал кандидатов, затем фильтруем по `end_time` и считаем `overlap`.

```python
def perform_join(log, sched):
    # Допущения: vsetv_id == channel_id
    interactions = []
    
    # Группируем расписание по каналам для быстрого поиска
    sched_grouped = {ch: df.sort_values('start_time') for ch, df in sched.groupby('channel_id')}
    
    for ch, group in log.groupby('vsetv_id'):
        if ch not in sched_grouped:
            continue
            
        s_group = sched_grouped[ch]
        starts = s_group['start_time'].values
        ends = s_group['end_time'].values
        ids = s_group['tv_show_id'].values
        durs = s_group['duration'].values
        
        for _, row in group.iterrows():
            # Находим кандидатов: start_air < view_stop AND end_air > view_start
            idx_start = np.searchsorted(ends, row['start_time'], side='right')
            idx_end = np.searchsorted(starts, row['stop_time'], side='left')
            
            for i in range(idx_start, idx_end):
                overlap = min(row['stop_time'], ends[i]) - max(row['start_time'], starts[i])
                overlap_sec = overlap.total_seconds()
                
                # Порог: >= 300с или >= 50% длительности программы
                if overlap_sec >= 300 or (overlap_sec / durs[i] >= 0.5):
                    interactions.append({
                        'user_id': row['user_id'],
                        'tv_show_id': ids[i],
                        'week': row['start_time'].isocalendar().week,
                        'overlap_seconds': overlap_sec
                    })
    return pd.DataFrame(interactions)
```

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Джойн лога и расписания: векторизованный поиск пересечений."""
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
DATA = ROOT / "data"

def perform_vectorized_join():
    # 1. Загрузка
    log = pd.read_csv(DATA / "dataset11-30.csv")
    log['start_time'] = pd.to_datetime(log['start_time'])
    log['stop_time'] = pd.to_datetime(log['stop_time'])
    
    sched_files = ["export_arh_11-20-final.csv", "export_arh_21-30-final.csv", "export_arh_31-42-final.csv"]
    scheds = []
    for f in sched_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(DATA / f)
        df['start_time'] = pd.to_datetime(df['start_time'], dayfirst=True)
        df['duration'] = pd.to_numeric(df['duration'], errors='coerce')
        df['end_time'] = df['start_time'] + pd.to_timedelta(df['duration'], unit='s')
        scheds.append(df[df['tv_show_id'] != 0])
    
    sched = pd.concat(scheds)
    
    # 2. Векторизованный джойн по каналам
    interactions = []
    t0 = time.time()
    
    # Предполагаем vsetv_id == channel_id
    common_channels = set(log['vsetv_id'].unique()) & set(sched['channel_id'].unique())
    
    for ch in common_channels:
        l_ch = log[log['vsetv_id'] == ch].sort_values('start_time').reset_index(drop=True)
        s_ch = sched[sched['channel_id'] == ch].sort_values('start_time').reset_index(drop=True)
        
        # Проверка непересечения эфиров
        assert (s_ch['start_time'].iloc[1:].values >= s_ch['end_time'].iloc[:-1].values).all(), f"Overlap in channel {ch}"
        
        s_starts = s_ch['start_time'].values
        s_ends = s_ch['end_time'].values
        s_ids = s_ch['tv_show_id'].values
        s_durs = s_ch['duration'].values
        
        v_starts = l_ch['start_time'].values
        v_stops = l_ch['stop_time'].values
        
        lo = np.searchsorted(s_ends, v_starts, side='right')
        hi = np.searchsorted(s_starts, v_stops, side='left')
        
        # Кол-во пересечений для каждого просмотра
        counts = hi - lo
        mask = counts > 0
        
        if mask.any():
            v_idx = np.where(mask)[0]
            v_repeats = counts[mask]
            
            # Разворачиваем индексы
            v_ids_rep = np.repeat(v_idx, v_repeats)
            
            # Индексы расписания
            s_idx_rep = np.concatenate([np.arange(lo[i], hi[i]) for i in v_idx])
            
            # Оверлап
            ov = np.minimum(v_stops[v_ids_rep], s_ends[s_idx_rep]) - np.maximum(v_starts[v_ids_rep], s_starts[s_idx_rep])
            ov_sec = ov.astype('timedelta64[s]').astype(int)
            
            # Порог
            pass_mask = (ov_sec >= 300) | (ov_sec / s_durs[s_idx_rep] >= 0.5)
            
            res = pd.DataFrame({
                'user_id': l_ch.loc[v_ids_rep[pass_mask], 'user_id'].values,
                'tv_show_id': s_ids[s_idx_rep[pass_mask]],
                'week': l_ch.loc[v_ids_rep[pass_mask], 'start_time'].dt.isocalendar().week.values,
                'overlap_seconds': ov_sec[pass_mask]
            })
            interactions.append(res)
            
    df_res = pd.concat(interactions)
    print(f"Time: {time.time() - t0:.2f}s")
    print(f"Interactions: {len(df_res):,}")
    print(f"Unique users: {df_res['user_id'].nunique():,}")
    print(f"Unique programmes: {df_res['tv_show_id'].nunique():,}")
    
    sub_users = pd.read_csv(DATA / "submission.csv")['user_id']
    test_users_in_inter = df_res[df_res['user_id'].isin(sub_users)]['user_id'].nunique()
    print(f"Test users with history: {test_users_in_inter:,}")
    
    df_res.to_parquet(DATA / "user_interactions.parquet")

perform_vectorized_join()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Валидация: бейзлайны и MAP@5."""
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
DATA = ROOT / "data"
RESULTS = ROOT / "results" / "tables"

def evaluate(predictions, ground_truth, k=5):
    """
    predictions: dict {user_id: [top5_ids]}
    ground_truth: df ['user_id', 'tv_show_id']
    """
    ap_sum = 0
    gt_grouped = ground_truth.groupby('user_id')['tv_show_id'].apply(set)
    users = set(predictions.keys()) & set(gt_grouped.index)
    
    for u in users:
        preds = predictions[u]
        actuals = gt_grouped[u]
        hits = 0
        ap = 0
        for i, p in enumerate(preds[:k]):
            if p in actuals:
                hits += 1
                ap += hits / (i + 1)
        ap_sum += ap / min(len(actuals), k)
    return ap_sum / len(users)

def run_validation():
    inter = pd.read_parquet(DATA / "user_interactions.parquet")
    inter['user_id'] = inter['user_id'].astype(str)
    
    # Разделение: Train (11-20), Val (21-30)
    train = inter[inter['week'] <= 20]
    val = inter[(inter['week'] > 20) & (inter['week'] <= 30)]
    val_users = val['user_id'].unique()
    
    # Кандидаты: все программы из Val (export_arh_21-30)
    val_sched = pd.read_csv(DATA / "export_arh_21-30-final.csv")
    candidates = val_sched[val_sched['tv_show_id'] != 0]['tv_show_id'].unique()
    
    # 1. Популярность (Global)
    pop_global = train.groupby('tv_show_id')['user_id'].nunique().sort_values(ascending=False).index.tolist()
    
    # 2. Популярность (Последние 4 недели: 17-20)
    pop_recent = train[train['week'] >= 17].groupby('tv_show_id')['user_id'].nunique().sort_values(ascending=False).index.tolist()
    
    # Предсказания для всех val_users
    preds_global = {u: pop_global[:5] for u in val_users}
    preds_recent = {u: pop_recent[:5] for u in val_users}
    
    # Оценка
    m_g = evaluate(preds_global, val)
    m_r = evaluate(preds_recent, val)
    
    results = pd.DataFrame({
        'method': ['Popularity (Global)', 'Popularity (Recent 4w)'],
        'MAP@5': [m_g, m_r],
        'users_evaluated': [len(val_users), len(val_users)]
    })
    
    RESULTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    results.to_csv(RESULTS / "validation.csv", index=False)
    print(results)

run_validation()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Валидация: бейзлайны и CBF."""
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import time
from pathlib import Path
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
DATA = ROOT / "data"
RESULTS = ROOT / "results" / "tables"

def evaluate(predictions, ground_truth, k=5):
    ap_sum = 0
    gt_grouped = ground_truth.groupby('user_id')['tv_show_id'].apply(set)
    users = set(predictions.keys()) & set(gt_grouped.index)
    if not users: return 0
    for u in users:
        preds = predictions[u]
        actuals = gt_grouped[u]
        hits = 0
        ap = 0
        for i, p in enumerate(preds[:k]):
            if p in actuals:
                hits += 1
                ap += hits / (i + 1)
        ap_sum += ap / min(len(actuals), k)
    return ap_sum / len(users)

def run():
    inter = pd.read_parquet(DATA / "user_interactions.parquet")
    inter['user_id'] = inter['user_id'].astype(str)
    
    train = inter[inter['week'] <= 20]
    val = inter[(inter['week'] > 20) & (inter['week'] <= 30)]
    val_users = val['user_id'].unique()
    
    val_sched = pd.read_csv(DATA / "export_arh_21-30-final.csv")
    candidates_df = val_sched[val_sched['tv_show_id'] != 0].drop_duplicates('tv_show_id')
    candidates_ids = candidates_df['tv_show_id'].values
    
    # Релевантность
    gt_grouped = val.groupby('user_id')['tv_show_id'].apply(set)
    n_rel = [len(s) for s in gt_grouped.values]
    print(f"Stats: avg_rel={np.mean(n_rel):.2f}, med_rel={np.median(n_rel):.2f}, pool={len(candidates_ids)}")

    # 1. Бейзлайны
    pop_recent = train[train['week'] >= 17].groupby('tv_show_id')['user_id'].nunique().sort_values(ascending=False)
    preds_recent = {u: pop_recent.index.tolist()[:5] for u in val_users}
    m_r = evaluate(preds_recent, val)
    
    # 2. CBF
    # Признаки: cat + 3 genres + year
    sched_all = pd.concat([pd.read_csv(DATA / f) for f in ["export_arh_11-20-final.csv", "export_arh_21-30-final.csv"]])
    feat = sched_all[sched_all['tv_show_id'] != 0].drop_duplicates('tv_show_id').copy()
    feat['text'] = feat['tv_show_category'].fillna('') + ' ' + \
                   feat['tv_show_genre_1'].fillna('') + ' ' + \
                   feat['tv_show_genre_2'].fillna('') + ' ' + \
                   feat['tv_show_genre_3'].fillna('')
    # Биннинг года
    feat['year'] = pd.to_numeric(feat['year_of_production'], errors='coerce').fillna(2000)
    feat['year_bin'] = (feat['year'] // 10 * 10).astype(str)
    feat['text'] += ' ' + feat['year_bin']
    
    tfidf = TfidfVectorizer().fit_transform(feat['text'])
    id_to_idx = {id_: i for i, id_ in enumerate(feat['tv_show_id'])}
    
    # Профили пользователей
    train['weight'] = np.log1p(train['overlap_seconds'])
    # Присоединим векторы
    user_profiles = {}
    for uid, group in train.groupby('user_id'):
        idxs = [id_to_idx[sid] for sid in group['tv_show_id'] if sid in id_to_idx]
        if not idxs: continue
        weights = group.loc[[sid in id_to_idx for sid in group['tv_show_id']], 'weight'].values
        profile = (tfidf[idxs].T @ weights) / weights.sum()
        user_profiles[uid] = profile
        
    preds_cbf = {}
    for u in val_users:
        if u not in user_profiles:
            preds_cbf[u] = pop_recent.index.tolist()[:5]
            continue
        
        # Скор: косинус
        cand_idxs = [id_to_idx[sid] for sid in candidates_ids if sid in id_to_idx]
        scores = cosine_similarity(user_profiles[u].reshape(1, -1), tfidf[cand_idxs]).flatten()
        
        # Топ-5 с разбиением ничьих популярностью
        df_scores = pd.DataFrame({'id': candidates_ids[np.array([sid in id_to_idx for sid in candidates_ids])], 'score': scores})
        df_scores = df_scores.merge(pop_recent.reset_index(name='pop'), on='id', how='left').fillna(0)
        top = df_scores.sort_values(['score', 'pop'], ascending=False).head(5)['id'].tolist()
        preds_cbf[u] = top
        
    m_cbf = evaluate(preds_cbf, val)
    
    # Таблица
    results = pd.DataFrame({
        'method': ['Popularity (Recent 4w)', 'CBF (Cat+Genre+Year)'],
        'MAP@5': [m_r, m_cbf]
    })
    results.to_csv(RESULTS / "validation.csv", index=False)
    print(results)

run()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""ALS, CBF re-rank и гибрид (rank fusion) с валидацией MAP@5 и анализом новизны."""
import time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
from implicit.als import AlternatingLeastSquares

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
DATA = ROOT / "data"
RESULTS = ROOT / "results" / "tables"
SEED = 42


def evaluate(predictions, ground_truth, k=5):
    ap_sum = 0.0
    gt = ground_truth.groupby("user_id")["tv_show_id"].apply(set)
    users = set(predictions) & set(gt.index)
    if not users:
        return 0.0, 0
    for u in users:
        preds = predictions[u][:k]
        actuals = gt[u]
        hits = ap = 0
        for i, p in enumerate(preds):
            if p in actuals:
                hits += 1
                ap += hits / (i + 1)
        ap_sum += ap / min(len(actuals), k)
    return ap_sum / len(users), len(users)


def rank_fusion(rank_a, rank_b, w, candidates):
    """rank_a/b: dict item -> rank (0 = top). Score = -(w*rank_a + (1-w)*rank_b)."""
    n = len(candidates)
    scores = {}
    for c in candidates:
        ra = rank_a.get(c, n)
        rb = rank_b.get(c, n)
        scores[c] = -(w * ra + (1 - w) * rb)
    return scores


def build_top5(score_dict, pop_rank, k=5):
    # ties -> break by popularity (higher popularity first == lower pop_rank)
    items = sorted(score_dict.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], pop_rank.get(kv[0], 10**9)))
    return [i for i, _ in items[:k]]


def run():
    t_all = time.perf_counter()
    inter = pd.read_parquet(DATA / "user_interactions.parquet")
    inter["user_id"] = inter["user_id"].astype(str)

    train = inter[inter["week"] <= 20].copy()
    val = inter[(inter["week"] > 20) & (inter["week"] <= 30)].copy()
    val_users = val["user_id"].unique()

    val_sched = pd.read_csv(DATA / "export_arh_21-30-final.csv")
    candidates = val_sched[val_sched["tv_show_id"] != 0]["tv_show_id"].unique()

    gt = val.groupby("user_id")["tv_show_id"].apply(set)
    n_rel = [len(s) for s in gt.values]
    print(f"avg_rel={np.mean(n_rel):.2f} med_rel={np.median(n_rel):.2f} pool={len(candidates)}")

    # --- маппинги строго по train (без утечки) ---
    train_items = train["tv_show_id"].unique()
    train_users = train["user_id"].unique()
    u_map = {u: i for i, u in enumerate(train_users)}
    i_map = {it: i for i, it in enumerate(train_items)}
    train_item_set = set(train_items)

    # --- новизна: доля "новых" программ (не встречавшихся в train) ---
    new_in_pool = sum(1 for c in candidates if c not in train_item_set)
    new_in_rel = sum(1 for u in gt for it in gt[u] if it not in train_item_set)
    total_rel = sum(len(s) for s in gt.values())
    print(f"Новых программ в пуле кандидатов: {new_in_pool}/{len(candidates)} = {new_in_pool/len(candidates)*100:.1f}%")
    print(f"Новых программ среди релевантных (val): {new_in_rel}/{total_rel} = {new_in_rel/total_rel*100:.1f}%")

    # --- популярность (бейзлайны) ---
    pop_recent = train[train["week"] >= 17].groupby("tv_show_id")["user_id"].nunique().sort_values(ascending=False)
    pop_global = train.groupby("tv_show_id")["user_id"].nunique().sort_values(ascending=False)
    pop_rank = {it: r for r, it in enumerate(pop_recent.index)}
    preds_pop_recent = {u: pop_recent.index.tolist()[:5] for u in val_users}
    preds_pop_global = {u: pop_global.index.tolist()[:5] for u in val_users}

    # --- ALS ---
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    rows = train["user_id"].map(u_map).values
    cols = train["tv_show_id"].map(i_map).values
    data = np.log1p(train["overlap_seconds"].values)
    mat = csr_matrix((data, (rows, cols)), shape=(len(u_map), len(i_map)))

    def fit_als(factors, reg, iters, alpha=1.0):
        model = AlternatingLeastSquares(
            factors=factors, regularization=reg, iterations=iters,
            random_state=SEED,
        )
        model.fit(mat * alpha)
        return model

    als_main = fit_als(64, 0.05, 20)
    t_als = time.perf_counter() - t0

    map_i_to_item = {i: it for it, i in i_map.items()}
    cand_known = [c for c in candidates if c in i_map]
    cand_unknown = [c for c in candidates if c not in i_map]
    cand_known_idx = np.array([i_map[c] for c in cand_known])

    def als_predict(model, cand_known, cand_known_idx, cand_unknown, pop_rank_local):
        item_factors = model.item_factors[cand_known_idx]
        preds = {}
        for u in val_users:
            if u not in u_map:
                preds[u] = pop_recent.index.tolist()[:5]
                continue
            uf = model.user_factors[u_map[u]]
            scores = item_factors @ uf
            min_score = scores.min() - 1.0  # новые/неизвестные программы получают скор ниже всех известных
            score_dict = dict(zip(cand_known, scores))
            for c in cand_unknown:
                score_dict[c] = min_score
            preds[u] = build_top5(score_dict, pop_rank_local, k=5)
        return preds

    preds_als = als_predict(als_main, cand_known, cand_known_idx, cand_unknown, pop_rank)

    # --- CBF (категории + 3 жанра one-hot + год по десятилетиям), профиль пользователя взвешен log(1+сек) ---
    sched_tr = pd.concat([pd.read_csv(DATA / f) for f in ["export_arh_11-20-final.csv"]])
    feat = sched_tr[sched_tr["tv_show_id"] != 0].drop_duplicates("tv_show_id").copy()
    genre_cols = []
    for col in ["tv_show_category", "tv_show_genre_1", "tv_show_genre_2", "tv_show_genre_3"]:
        dummies = pd.get_dummies(feat[col].fillna(""), prefix=col)
        genre_cols.append(dummies)
    feat["year"] = pd.to_numeric(feat["year_of_production"], errors="coerce").fillna(2000)
    feat["decade"] = (feat["year"] // 10 * 10).astype(int).astype(str)
    decade_dummies = pd.get_dummies(feat["decade"], prefix="decade")
    feats = pd.concat(genre_cols + [decade_dummies], axis=1).values.astype(float)
    feats = feats / (np.linalg.norm(feats, axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-9)
    cbf_id_to_idx = {it: i for i, it in enumerate(feat["tv_show_id"].values)}

    train_w = train.copy()
    train_w["weight"] = np.log1p(train_w["overlap_seconds"])
    user_profiles = {}
    for uid, g in train_w.groupby("user_id"):
        idxs = [cbf_id_to_idx[sid] for sid in g["tv_show_id"] if sid in cbf_id_to_idx]
        if not idxs:
            continue
        mask = g["tv_show_id"].isin(cbf_id_to_idx)
        weights = g.loc[mask, "weight"].values
        profile = (feats[idxs].T @ weights) / weights.sum()
        norm = np.linalg.norm(profile)
        user_profiles[uid] = profile / (norm + 1e-9)

    cand_cbf_known = [c for c in candidates if c in cbf_id_to_idx]
    cand_cbf_idx = np.array([cbf_id_to_idx[c] for c in cand_cbf_known])
    cand_cbf_feats = feats[cand_cbf_idx]

    # вариант A: чистый CBF по всему пулу
    preds_cbf_full = {}
    for u in val_users:
        if u not in user_profiles:
            preds_cbf_full[u] = pop_recent.index.tolist()[:5]
            continue
        scores = cand_cbf_feats @ user_profiles[u]
        score_dict = dict(zip(cand_cbf_known, scores))
        preds_cbf_full[u] = build_top5(score_dict, pop_rank, k=5)

    # вариант B: CBF re-rank топ-50 популярных
    top50_pop = pop_recent.index.tolist()[:50]
    top50_known_mask = [c in cbf_id_to_idx for c in top50_pop]
    top50_known = [c for c, m in zip(top50_pop, top50_known_mask) if m]
    top50_idx = np.array([cbf_id_to_idx[c] for c in top50_known])
    top50_feats = feats[top50_idx] if len(top50_idx) else np.zeros((0, feats.shape[1]))

    preds_cbf_rerank = {}
    for u in val_users:
        if u not in user_profiles or len(top50_known) == 0:
            preds_cbf_rerank[u] = pop_recent.index.tolist()[:5]
            continue
        scores = top50_feats @ user_profiles[u]
        score_dict = dict(zip(top50_known, scores))
        preds_cbf_rerank[u] = build_top5(score_dict, pop_rank, k=5)

    # --- гибрид: rank fusion ALS + Popularity recent, вес подбираем на валидации ---
    als_rank_per_user = {}
    item_factors_full = als_main.item_factors[cand_known_idx]
    for u in val_users:
        if u not in u_map:
            als_rank_per_user[u] = {}
            continue
        uf = als_main.user_factors[u_map[u]]
        scores = item_factors_full @ uf
        order = np.argsort(-scores)
        als_rank_per_user[u] = {cand_known[o]: r for r, o in enumerate(order)}

    best_hybrid = None
    hybrid_results = []
    for w in [0.3, 0.5, 0.7]:
        preds_hybrid = {}
        for u in val_users:
            if u not in u_map:
                preds_hybrid[u] = pop_recent.index.tolist()[:5]
                continue
            ra = als_rank_per_user[u]
            score_dict = rank_fusion(ra, pop_rank, w, candidates)
            preds_hybrid[u] = build_top5(score_dict, pop_rank, k=5)
        m, n = evaluate(preds_hybrid, val)
        hybrid_results.append((w, m, n))
        if best_hybrid is None or m > best_hybrid[1]:
            best_hybrid = (w, m, n, preds_hybrid)

    # --- ALS вариации гиперпараметров (только для сравнения на валидации) ---
    als_variants = []
    for factors, reg, iters in [(32, 0.05, 20), (64, 0.1, 20), (128, 0.05, 15)]:
        t0v = time.perf_counter()
        m_model = fit_als(factors, reg, iters)
        preds_v = als_predict(m_model, cand_known, cand_known_idx, cand_unknown, pop_rank)
        mv, nv = evaluate(preds_v, val)
        als_variants.append((f"ALS f={factors} reg={reg} it={iters}", mv, nv, time.perf_counter() - t0v))

    # --- сбор итоговой таблицы ---
    rows_out = []
    for name, preds in [
        ("Popularity (Global)", preds_pop_global),
        ("Popularity (Recent 4w)", preds_pop_recent),
        ("CBF (full pool)", preds_cbf_full),
        ("CBF (re-rank top-50 pop)", preds_cbf_rerank),
    ]:
        m, n = evaluate(preds, val)
        rows_out.append({"method": name, "MAP@5": m, "users_evaluated": n, "seed": SEED, "time_s": None})

    rows_out.append({"method": "ALS f=64 reg=0.05 it=20", "MAP@5": evaluate(preds_als, val)[0],
                      "users_evaluated": evaluate(preds_als, val)[1], "seed": SEED, "time_s": round(t_als, 2)})

    for name, mv, nv, tv in als_variants:
        rows_out.append({"method": name, "MAP@5": mv, "users_evaluated": nv, "seed": SEED, "time_s": round(tv, 2)})

    for w, m, n in hybrid_results:
        rows_out.append({"method": f"Hybrid ALS+Pop (rank fusion, w={w})", "MAP@5": m,
                          "users_evaluated": n, "seed": SEED, "time_s": None})

    df_out = pd.DataFrame(rows_out)
    RESULTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    df_out.to_csv(RESULTS / "validation.csv", index=False)
    print(df_out.to_string(index=False))
    print(f"\nTotal time: {time.perf_counter() - t_all:.1f}s")

    return {
        "best_hybrid": best_hybrid,
        "als_main": als_main,
        "u_map": u_map, "i_map": i_map,
        "pop_recent": pop_recent,
        "candidates_val": candidates,
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()

| **Popularity (Recent 4w)** — лучший бейзлайн | **0.6219** |
| Popularity (Global) | 0.6197 |
| Hybrid ALS+Pop (w=0.05, почти чистая популярность) | 0.6210 |
| Hybrid ALS+Pop (w=0.1…0.7) | 0.52–0.62, падает с ростом веса ALS |
| ALS f=32 reg=0.05 it=20 (лучший вариант ALS) | 0.3030 |
| ALS f=64 reg=0.05 it=20 | 0.2448 |
| CBF (re-rank top-50 pop) | 0.2344 |
| CBF (full pool) | 0.1271 |

**Причина:** 66.1% пула кандидатов (4209/6363) и 33.7% релевантных программ в проверке — это программы, которых ALS и CBF никогда не видели в обучении (11–20). Это огромная утечка кандидатов в «неизвестное» для collaborative/content моделей, а чистая популярность автоматически устойчива к этому, потому что ранжирует по частоте среди уже известных программ и не пытается оценить то, чего не видела.

**Решение по вашей инструкции:** раз ни ALS, ни гибрид не побили бейзлайн на валидации — **не переобучаю на 11–30 и не делаю новый финальный сабмит**. Страховочный сабмит (`baseline popularity recent4w`, public score **0.28234**) остаётся финальным.

Два метода для §4 всё равно реализованы и честно сравнены (CBF и MF/ALS), просто ни один не превосходит бейзлайн на данном holdout — это сам по себе валидный и ожидаемый результат при такой доле новизны.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""§7: два пользователя (тяжёлый/лёгкий), Top-5 каждого метода + что реально смотрели."""
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
from implicit.als import AlternatingLeastSquares

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
DATA = ROOT / "data"
REPORTS = ROOT / "reports"
SEED = 42


def build_top5(score_dict, pop_rank, k=5):
    items = sorted(score_dict.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], pop_rank.get(kv[0], 10**9)))
    return [i for i, _ in items[:k]]


def main():
    inter = pd.read_parquet(DATA / "user_interactions.parquet")
    inter["user_id"] = inter["user_id"].astype(str)
    train = inter[inter["week"] <= 20].copy()
    val = inter[(inter["week"] > 20) & (inter["week"] <= 30)].copy()

    val_sched = pd.read_csv(DATA / "export_arh_21-30-final.csv")
    sched_lookup = val_sched[val_sched["tv_show_id"] != 0].drop_duplicates("tv_show_id").set_index("tv_show_id")
    candidates = sched_lookup.index.unique().tolist()

    # Выбор пользователей: тяжёлый (много просмотров в train) и лёгкий (мало, но >=1 в val)
    user_counts = train.groupby("user_id")["overlap_seconds"].agg(["count", "sum"])
    val_users_set = set(val["user_id"].unique())
    eligible = user_counts[user_counts.index.isin(val_users_set)]
    heavy_user = eligible.sort_values("sum", ascending=False).index[0]
    light_user = eligible[eligible["count"] >= 1].sort_values("count").index[0]

    print(f"Heavy user: {heavy_user} (sum_sec={eligible.loc[heavy_user,'sum']:.0f}, n={eligible.loc[heavy_user,'count']})")
    print(f"Light user: {light_user} (sum_sec={eligible.loc[light_user,'sum']:.0f}, n={eligible.loc[light_user,'count']})")

    # --- популярность ---
    pop_recent = train[train["week"] >= 17].groupby("tv_show_id")["user_id"].nunique().sort_values(ascending=False)
    pop_rank = {it: r for r, it in enumerate(pop_recent.index)}
    top5_pop = pop_recent.index.tolist()[:5]

    # --- ALS (f=64, как основной заявленный вариант) ---
    train_items = train["tv_show_id"].unique()
    train_users = train["user_id"].unique()
    u_map = {u: i for i, u in enumerate(train_users)}
    i_map = {it: i for i, it in enumerate(train_items)}
    rows = train["user_id"].map(u_map).values
    cols = train["tv_show_id"].map(i_map).values
    data = np.log1p(train["overlap_seconds"].values)
    mat = csr_matrix((data, (rows, cols)), shape=(len(u_map), len(i_map)))
    als = AlternatingLeastSquares(factors=64, regularization=0.05, iterations=20, random_state=SEED)
    als.fit(mat)

    cand_known = [c for c in candidates if c in i_map]
    cand_unknown = [c for c in candidates if c not in i_map]
    cand_known_idx = np.array([i_map[c] for c in cand_known])
    item_factors = als.item_factors[cand_known_idx]

    def als_top5(user):
        if user not in u_map:
            return top5_pop
        uf = als.user_factors[u_map[user]]
        scores = item_factors @ uf
        min_score = scores.min() - 1.0
        score_dict = dict(zip(cand_known, scores))
        for c in cand_unknown:
            score_dict[c] = min_score
        return build_top5(score_dict, pop_rank)

    # --- CBF (full pool) ---
    sched_tr = pd.read_csv(DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv")
    feat = sched_tr[sched_tr["tv_show_id"] != 0].drop_duplicates("tv_show_id").copy()
    genre_cols = []
    for col in ["tv_show_category", "tv_show_genre_1", "tv_show_genre_2", "tv_show_genre_3"]:
        genre_cols.append(pd.get_dummies(feat[col].fillna(""), prefix=col))
    feat["year"] = pd.to_numeric(feat["year_of_production"], errors="coerce").fillna(2000)
    feat["decade"] = (feat["year"] // 10 * 10).astype(int).astype(str)
    decade_dummies = pd.get_dummies(feat["decade"], prefix="decade")
    feats = pd.concat(genre_cols + [decade_dummies], axis=1).values.astype(float)
    feats = feats / (np.linalg.norm(feats, axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-9)
    cbf_id_to_idx = {it: i for i, it in enumerate(feat["tv_show_id"].values)}

    train_w = train.copy()
    train_w["weight"] = np.log1p(train_w["overlap_seconds"])

    def cbf_profile(user):
        g = train_w[train_w["user_id"] == user]
        idxs = [cbf_id_to_idx[sid] for sid in g["tv_show_id"] if sid in cbf_id_to_idx]
        if not idxs:
            return None
        mask = g["tv_show_id"].isin(cbf_id_to_idx)
        weights = g.loc[mask, "weight"].values
        profile = (feats[idxs].T @ weights) / weights.sum()
        return profile / (np.linalg.norm(profile) + 1e-9)

    cand_cbf_known = [c for c in candidates if c in cbf_id_to_idx]
    cand_cbf_idx = np.array([cbf_id_to_idx[c] for c in cand_cbf_known])
    cand_cbf_feats = feats[cand_cbf_idx]

    def cbf_top5(user):
        profile = cbf_profile(user)
        if profile is None:
            return top5_pop
        scores = cand_cbf_feats @ profile
        score_dict = dict(zip(cand_cbf_known, scores))
        return build_top5(score_dict, pop_rank)

    def lookup(show_id):
        if show_id in sched_lookup.index:
            row = sched_lookup.loc[show_id]
            if isinstance(row, pd.DataFrame):
                row = row.iloc[0]
            return row["tv_show_title"], row["tv_show_category"]
        return "(неизвестно, вне пула 21-30)", "-"

    lines = ["# §7 Примеры рекомендаций: два пользователя\n"]
    lines.append(
        "Выбор: **тяжёлый** пользователь — максимум секунд просмотра в train (11-20); "
        "**лёгкий** — минимум просмотров (≥1) из тех, у кого есть хотя бы одно взаимодействие в проверке (21-30). "
        "Одинаковый пул кандидатов и fallback (популярность) для всех методов."
    )

    for label, user in [("Тяжёлый", heavy_user), ("Лёгкий", light_user)]:
        lines.append(f"\n## {label} пользователь `{user}`")
        lines.append(f"- train (11-20): {eligible.loc[user,'count']:.0f} просмотров, {eligible.loc[user,'sum']:.0f} сек суммарно")

        watched = val[val["user_id"] == user]["tv_show_id"].unique().tolist()
        lines.append(f"- реально смотрел в проверке (21-30): {len(watched)} программ")
        lines.append("\n**Факт: что реально смотрел (21-30)**\n")
        lines.append("| id | title | category |")
        lines.append("|---|---|---|")
        for sid in watched[:10]:
            t, c = lookup(sid)
            lines.append(f"| {sid} | {t} | {c} |")
        if len(watched) > 10:
            lines.append(f"| … | ещё {len(watched)-10} программ | |")

        for method_name, top5 in [
            ("Popularity (Recent 4w)", top5_pop),
            ("CBF (full pool)", cbf_top5(user)),
            ("ALS f=64 reg=0.05 it=20", als_top5(user)),
        ]:
            lines.append(f"\n**{method_name} — Top-5**\n")
            lines.append("| rank | id | title | category | в фактическом списке? |")
            lines.append("|---|---|---|---|---|")
            for rank, sid in enumerate(top5, 1):
                t, c = lookup(sid)
                hit = "да" if sid in watched else "нет"
                lines.append(f"| {rank} | {sid} | {t} | {c} | {hit} |")

    REPORTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (REPORTS / "examples.md").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"\n[saved] {REPORTS/'examples.md'}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# sweet.tv — TV program recommender (MAP@5)

Решение экзаменационного квиза (GSB, дедлайн 24.10.2026 19:00 МСК) по конкурсу
[sweet.tv — TV program recommender](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/sweettv-tv-program-recommender)
(slug `sweettv-tv-program-recommender`, метрика MAP@{K}, K=5).

## Среда и воспроизведение

- Python 3.14.8 (`uv`, проект `sweettv-recsys`, lock-файл `uv.lock`), macOS arm64.
- Установка: `uv sync` (подтянет `pandas`, `numpy`, `pyarrow`, `scikit-learn`, `implicit`, `scipy`).
- Seed везде фиксирован: `SEED = 42` (numpy, `AlternatingLeastSquares(random_state=42)`).
- Данные: `kaggle competitions download -c sweettv-tv-program-recommender -p data/`, затем распаковать в `data/` (5 CSV).

Порядок запуска (из корня репозитория):

```bash
uv sync
uv run python artifacts/scripts/eda.py              # шаг 2: EDA -> docs/facts.md (~27 с)
uv run python artifacts/scripts/join_interactions.py # шаг 3: джойн -> data/user_interactions.parquet (~9 с)
uv run python artifacts/scripts/final_models.py      # шаг 4: валидация всех методов -> results/tables/validation.csv (~165 с)
uv run python artifacts/scripts/examples.py          # §7: примеры 2 пользователей -> reports/examples.md
uv run python artifacts/scripts/make_submission.py   # генерация data/submission_final.csv
```

Сабмит на Kaggle:

```bash
kaggle competitions submit -c sweettv-tv-program-recommender \
  -f data/submission_final.csv -m "baseline popularity recent4w"
kaggle competitions submissions -c sweettv-tv-program-recommender
```

## Структура репозитория

```
artifacts/scripts/
  eda.py                 — потоковый EDA (stdlib csv), пишет docs/facts.md
  join_interactions.py   — джойн лог×расписание (канал + overlap интервалов), -> user_interactions.parquet
  debug_join.py          — сверка типов user_id и повторный пересчёт пересечений (шаг 3, проверка)
  validate_baseline.py   — первые версии бейзлайна/CBF (сохранён для истории итераций)
  final_models.py        — финальная валидация: Popularity, CBF (2 варианта), ALS (implicit, 3 варианта
                            гиперпараметров), Hybrid ALS+Popularity (rank fusion, 6 весов)
  examples.py            — §7: тяжёлый/лёгкий пользователь, Top-5 каждого метода
  make_submission.py     — генерация submission_final.csv
docs/facts.md            — факты EDA (шаг 2)
reports/join_checks.txt  — проверки джойна (сверка user_id, сдвиги времени, нарушения эфира)
reports/examples.md      — §7 примеры рекомендаций
results/tables/validation.csv — таблица MAP@5 всех методов
data/submission_final.csv — финальный сабмит (используется также как страховочный)
```

## Правила эксперимента (кратко; подробности — в отчёте)

- **Джойн:** канал (`vsetv_id` ≡ `channel_id`, подтверждено проверкой сдвигов часовых поясов —
  максимум совпадений ровно на сдвиге 0 ч) + пересечение интервалов `[start, stop)` просмотра
  и `[start_air, start_air+duration)` эфира. Порог «просмотрено»: пересечение ≥ 300 с **или**
  ≥ 50% длительности программы.
- **`tv_show_id = 0`** — неразмеченный эфир, из джойна исключён (не может стать item'ом).
- **Валидация:** train = недели 11–20, holdout = недели 21–30 (строго раньше теста 31–42,
  порядок сохранён). Пул кандидатов holdout = программы, идущие в эфир в 21–30 по расписанию
  (`export_arh_21-30-final.csv`, `tv_show_id != 0`). Для финального сабмита пул — `export_arh_31-42-final.csv`.
  Повторы ранее просмотренных программ разрешены — одинаково для всех методов.
- **MAP@5:** AP делится на `min(число релевантных, 5)` — как на Kaggle.
- **Cold-start fallback:** популярность (Recent 4w) — единый fallback для всех методов.
- **CBF ничьи:** при равенстве косинусной близости (одинаковый жанровый вектор) ранжирование
  по вторичному ключу — популярности программы. Это часть метода, а не случайность sort.
- **Ограничение:** 66.1% пула кандидатов holdout и 33.7% релевантных в holdout — программы,
  не встречавшиеся в train (11–20). ALS и CBF принципиально не могут их оценить по данным
  обучения; это основная причина, почему популярность остаётся сильнейшим бейзлайном на
  этом хорошо документированном разрезе.

## Статус

Реализовано 2 метода сверх обязательного бейзлайна (CBF, ALS/implicit) + гибрид (rank fusion).
На holdout (недели 21–30) ни один не превзошёл Popularity (Recent 4w) — финальный сабмит
