## Objective
- Raise Kaggle public MAP@5 for `sweettv-tv-program-recommender` above the current best, honestly and reproducibly, while writing the exam report deliverables (§4–§8) by deadline 24 Oct 2026 19:00 MSK.
- Currently executing a new improvement round ("exp3", user's full work order) with experiments E1–E4 (tripartite-graph PPR, time decay, weighted RRF, airing-boost), after fixing the new official final.

## Requirements
- Step 0 (DONE): final = `submission_rrf2_a_ppr05_als.csv` (public 0.32691 / private 0.31441) copied to root as `submission.csv`, README updated, git-committed. From now on final changes ONLY if a new submission is better on BOTH public AND private.
- Kaggle report deliverables per `exam_quiz_GSB.md`: §4 (≥2 methods + popularity baseline), §5 (join rule, thresholds, validation, pool, fallback, hyperparams/seed/runtime), §6 final strategy (method/hybrid, not pure popularity), §7 two-user examples, §8 business analysis, §9 PDF+AI-session export.
- MAP@5: AP / min(n_relevant, 5) (Kaggle convention). Validation: strict relevance (summed overlap ≥50% of show's max duration in val window); two splits: main (train≤20, val 21–30), early (train≤16, val 17–20); same users/pool across variants; candidate pool = labelled schedule programmes of val window (final: `export_arh_31-42-final.csv`); repeats allowed; cold-start fallback = popularity.
- Join: channel match + interval overlap, ≥300s OR ≥50% duration; `tv_show_id=0` excluded; per-channel loop with `np.searchsorted`, greedy truncation of overlapping airings; no numba/IntervalIndex/merge_asof.
- exp3 round rules: no fabricated numbers (only real code output); do NOT overwrite existing results/submissions — new files use prefix `exp3_`; weeks 31–42 view data never used anywhere (schedule 31–42 only for programme–channel–genre links and airing counts); work solo, no subagents; max 5 submissions in this round, then stop and output final summary table; "если паблик меньше 0.49 не публикуй" (user's verbatim closing constraint).
- Every variant first checked locally on both splits (to cut obviously bad ones); decisions by Kaggle.
- Submissions: training 11–30, same top-500 pool, template format (1260 rows, 5 unique ids, all from schedule 31–42), format-check script before sending.
- exp3 experiments (priority order):
  - E1: tripartite graph PPR user–programme–attribute (attributes: programme's channel from schedule [pool from 31–42], category, genres; programme–attribute edges bidirectional); attr_weight ∈ {0.1, 0.3, 0.5} = share of transition probability from programme to attributes instead of users; restart 0.5; report MAP@5 both splits + separately: how many never-trained programmes entered top-5 and how many of those relevant.
  - E2: freshness — user–programme edge weights × exp(−Δweeks/τ), τ ∈ {4, 8}, Δ = weeks from view to end of training; plus variant with same weight in restart vector. Applied on top of best E1 variant.
  - E3: fusion weights for best PPR from E1/E2: weighted RRF score = Σ w_c/(k+rank_c), w_pop ∈ {1, 1.5, 2}, w_ppr ∈ {1, 1.5, 2}, w_als ∈ {0, 0.5, 1}, k ∈ {20, 60}; plus ablation pop+PPR without ALS.
  - E4: score = PPR × (1+airings_31-42)^a, a ∈ {0.25, 0.5}, as standalone component instead of separate pop×airings.
  - Each stage → `results/tables/exp3_*.csv` with columns: variant, params, MAP@5 main, early, mean, time, seed.
- Submissions (≤5): best E1, best E1+E2, best E3, best E4, +1 discretionary with justification (only locally non-worse than current final on both splits).
- Round summary: table of all submissions (file, components, public, private) next to final 0.32691/0.31441, final decision by "better on both public and private" rule, 3–5 conclusion lines (which idea worked, which failed, where local validation matched/conflicted with Kaggle).

## Decisions
- `user_id` must be read as string everywhere; strict relevance = summed overlap ≥ 50% of max duration in val schedule window; top20 alt definition exists.
- vsetv_id ≡ channel_id (timezone-shift check peaked at 0h offset).
- Local validation systematically overestimates pure history-repeat and poorly predicts fusion effects — decisions by Kaggle, but every variant pre-checked locally on both splits.
- PPR restart 0.15→0.5 confirmed on Kaggle (+0.019 public in hybrid); local 0.7 slightly worse than 0.5; monotone growth 0.15→0.3→0.5 locally.
- New final rule: better on BOTH public and private (avoids overfitting to half the test).
- RRF k=60, pool top-500 by pop×log(1+airings); greedy ablation selected pop×airings + PPR + ALS (AR and CBF-new excluded — AR didn't help in fusion, CBF far below base).
- EASE best λ locally = 2000 (grid extended: λ=5000 worse than 2000; PPR restart=0.7 below 0.5).
- Git repo initialized/used; commit `f326c13` = final fix (submission.csv + README + all scripts/tables).

## Work State
### Completed
- Data download/EDA (`docs/facts.md`), join → `data/user_interactions.parquet` (2,392,344 rows), join checks (`reports/join_checks.txt`).
- All §4 methods implemented and evaluated: popularity (windows/decay/alpha/airings), CBF (HW2-style, cosine + Jaccard×slotpop for cold — failed, MAP@5 0.0129/0.0134), ALS, repeat (failed on Kaggle), association rules (HW4-style, 0.4658/0.3747 local; manual rule recalc verified to 1e-9), PPR/global PageRank (HW6-style, 0.4784/0.3958 local), RP3beta grid, EASE grid, RRF k=60 with greedy ablation.
- 13 Kaggle submissions made and scored; progression: popularity 0.28234 → pop×log(airings) 0.30050 → pop+ALS w=0.1 hybrid 0.30215 → RRF pop+PPR(0.15)+ALS 0.30806 → RRF pop+PPR(0.5)+ALS 0.32691 (best, now final).
- exp3 round Step 0 DONE: `submission.csv` (root) = final; README updated (final method description, structure, status, final-change rule); commit `f326c13` on branch main.
- Answered user's question: hybrid public grows with restart 0.15→0.5 (0.30806→0.32691, +0.0189; private 0.29611→0.31441); noted local-vs-Kaggle sign disagreement for fusion (local fusion worse than pure PPR, Kaggle opposite).

### Active
- exp3 E1 (tripartite graph PPR with attributes, attr_weight ∈ {0.1,0.3,0.5}, restart 0.5) — not started; then E2, E3, E4 in order, each stage → `results/tables/exp3_*.csv`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Implement E1: extend PPR graph to user–programme–attribute tripartite (attributes = channel [pool from 31–42 schedule], category, genres; programme–attribute edges bidirectional; attr_weight ∈ {0.1,0.3,0.5}; restart 0.5, 30 iterations, batch scipy.sparse), evaluate MAP@5 on main+early splits, report count of never-trained programmes in top-5 and how many relevant; save to `results/tables/exp3_e1.csv`.
2. E2 on best E1 variant: edge weights × exp(−Δweeks/τ), τ ∈ {4,8}, plus same-weight restart variant → `results/tables/exp3_e2.csv`.
3. E3 (weighted RRF grid w_pop/w_ppr/w_als/k + pop+PPR ablation) and E4 (PPR × (1+airings)^a, a ∈ {0.25,0.5}) on best PPR → `results/tables/exp3_e3.csv`, `exp3_e4.csv`.
4. Make ≤5 Kaggle submissions (best E1, E1+E2, E3, E4, +1 discretionary) with `exp3_` prefix, training 11–30, format-checked; then stop and output final table vs 0.32691/0.31441, final decision by both-metrics rule, 3–5 conclusion lines.

## Relevant Files
- `submission.csv` (root): official final = RRF k=60 pop×airings + PPR(restart=0.5) + ALS, public 0.32691 / private 0.31441.
- `artifacts/scripts/exp_rrf_hybrid.py`: reusable building blocks — evaluate(), strict_relevance(), build_split(), rank_list_from_scores(), build_ppr_graph(), ppr_batch(), row_normalize(), fuse_rrf(), RRF_K=60, POOL=500, SEED=42.
- `artifacts/scripts/exp_rrf2_submit.py`: final submission generator (PPR restarts 0.15/0.3/0.5, EASE, ALS, RRF fusion; variants a/b/c).
- `artifacts/scripts/exp_grid_rp3_ease_ppr_extra.py`: build_ppr_graph_local(), ppr_batch() (parameterized alpha) — to reuse for E1/E2.
- `artifacts/scripts/exp_grid_rp3_ease_ppr.py`: RP3beta/EASE/PPR grid reference.
- `results/tables/`: all experiment tables (`exp_stage1_*`, `exp_rrf_hybrid*`, `exp_grid_rp3_ease_ppr*`, `exp_ppr.csv`, `exp_assoc_rules*.csv`, `exp_cbf_hw2.csv`, `diagnostics*.csv`, `validation.csv`).
- `data/user_interactions.parquet`: joined interactions (user_id str, tv_show_id, week 11–30, overlap_seconds) — base for all training.
- `data/export_arh_31-42-final.csv`: test-window schedule — candidate pool, programme–channel–genre links, airing counts only (views never used).
- `data/submission.csv` (in `data/`): Kaggle template (1260 rows) — order/format reference.
- `data/submission_rrf2_a_ppr05_als.csv`: source of the current final.
- `README.md`: updated final description, structure, status, final-change rule (committed).
- `docs/improve_plan.md`: original improvement plan (§4A–E).
- `reports/examples.md`: §7 examples — generated with old method set, needs regeneration for final method.

## Important Context
- Kaggle CLI needs env reload before each call: `eval "$(grep -E '^\s*(export\s+)?KAGGLE_API_TOKEN=' ~/.zshrc | tail -1)"` then `kaggle competitions submit -c sweettv-tv-program-recommender -f <file> -m "<msg>"`; results via `kaggle competitions submissions -c sweettv-tv-program-recommender` after ~30s sleep.
- Standing rule: only real computed numbers, never estimated/fabricated; user said "Работай сам, без сабагентов".
- Key local-validation numbers (strict): PPR restart 0.15/0.3/0.5/0.7 → main 0.4788/0.5075/0.5333/0.5296, early 0.3962/0.4241/0.4577/0.4519; EASE λ=2000 → 0.4870/0.3968; base pop×airings (top-500 pool) → 0.4565/0.3732; RRF pop+PPR(0.15)+ALS → 0.4715/0.4018.
- Kaggle submissions (round 2): `submission_rrf2_a_ppr05_als.csv` 0.32691/0.31441 (final), `submission_rrf2_c_ppr03.csv` (pure PPR 0.3) 0.31138/0.29755, `submission_rrf2_b_ppr015_ease_als.csv` 0.30727/0.29269; earlier round: `submission_rrf_best_popair_PPR_ALS.csv` 0.30806/0.29611, `submission_rrf_ppr_popair_PPR.csv` 0.29967/0.29511, `submission_rrf_ar_popair_AR.csv` 0.29766/0.29316; stage1: `submission_exp_stage1_pop_w2.csv` 0.27903/0.27504, `submission_exp_stage1_hybrid_als_pool50.csv` 0.28076/0.27547; older: pop_x_log_airings 0.30050/0.29538, hybrid_pop_als_w01 0.30215/0.29635, hybrid_pop_cbf_w02 0.28914/0.28692, repeat_* 0.27339/0.24269, final (pop recent4w) 0.28234/0.27809.
- Local-vs-Kaggle disagreements to report honestly: repeat (local 0.4842 > pop 0.4479, Kaggle 0.27339 < 0.28234); window=2w popularity (local best 0.4520, Kaggle 0.27903 poor); fusion (local fusion worse than pure PPR, Kaggle fusion better); CBF tokens inverted correlation (relevant items mean cosine 0.2501 vs pool 0.3716).

102:     graph_users = agg["user_id"].unique()
103:     graph_items = agg["tv_show_id"].unique()
104:     u_map = {u: i for i, u in enumerate(graph_users)}
105:     i_map = {it: i for i, it in enumerate(graph_items)}
106:     rows = agg["user_id"].map(u_map).values
107:     cols = agg["tv_show_id"].map(i_map).values
108:     R = csr_matrix((agg["weight"].values, (rows, cols)), shape=(len(u_map), len(i_map)))
109:     Mu2i = row_normalize(R)
110:     Mi2u = row_normalize(R.T.tocsr())
111:     return u_map, i_map, Mu2i, Mi2u
112: 
113: 
114: def ppr_batch(Mu2i, Mi2u, Vu, Vi, alpha=0.85, n_iter=30):
115:     Pu = Vu.copy()
116:     Pi = Vi.copy()
117:     Mu2iT = Mu2i.T.tocsr()
118:     Mi2uT = Mi2u.T.tocsr()
119:     for _ in range(n_iter):
120:         Pi = alpha * (Mu2iT @ Pu) + (1 - alpha) * Vi
121:         Pu = alpha * (Mi2uT @ Pi) + (1 - alpha) * Vu
122:     return Pu, Pi
123: 
124: 
125: def ppr_rankings(train, val_users, pool, rank_pop):
126:     u_map, i_map, Mu2i, Mi2u = build_ppr_graph(train)
127:     warm_users = [u for u in val_users if u in u_map]
128:     cold = set(u for u in val_users if u not in u_map)
129:     pool_idx = np.array([i_map[c] for c in pool if c in i_map])
130:     pool_known = [c for c in pool if c in i_map]
131:     B = len(warm_users)
132:     Vu = np.zeros((len(u_map), B))
133:     Vi = np.zeros((len(i_map), B))
134:     for b, u in enumerate(warm_users):
135:         Vi[:, b] = Mu2i[u_map[u], :].toarray().ravel()
136:     Pu, Pi = ppr_batch(Mu2i, Mi2u, Vu, Vi)
137:     scores_pool = Pi[pool_idx, :]  # (n_pool_known, B)
138:     rankings = {}
139:     for b, u in enumerate(warm_users):
140:         sc = dict(zip(pool_known, scores_pool[:, b]))
141:         # кандидаты вне PPR-графа получают минимальный балл (ранг в хвосте)
142:         min_sc = min(sc.values()) - 1.0 if sc else 0.0
143:         for c in pool:
144:             if c not in sc:
145:                 sc[c] = min_sc
146:         rankings[u] = rank_list_from_scores(sc, rank_pop, k=POOL)
147:     for u in cold:
148:         rankings[u] = list(pool)  # rank_pop порядок, пул уже по убыванию pop×airings
149:     return rankings
150:

152: # --------------------- AR (association rules, по exp_assoc_rules.py) ---------------------
153: def ar_rankings(train, val_users, candidates, rank_pop, max_week):
154:     g = train[train["overlap_seconds"] > 0].groupby(["user_id", "week"])["tv_show_id"].apply(lambda s: frozenset(s.unique()))
155:     txns = [s for s in g.values if len(s) >= 1]
156:     n_txn = len(txns)
157:     item_count = defaultdict(int)
158:     pair_count = defaultdict(int)
159:     for txn in txns:
160:         for a in txn:
161:             item_count[a] += 1
162:         items = sorted(txn)
163:         for a, b in combinations(items, 2):
164:             pair_count[(a, b)] += 1
165:     freq = {}
166:     for pair, cnt in pair_count.items():
167:         sup = cnt / n_txn
168:         if sup >= MIN_SUPPORT:
169:             freq[pair] = (cnt, sup)
170:     rules_by_ant = defaultdict(list)
171:     for (a, b), (cnt_ab, _) in freq.items():
172:         cnt_a, cnt_b = item_count.get(a, 0), item_count.get(b, 0)
173:         if cnt_a == 0 or cnt_b == 0:
174:             continue
175:         conf_ab = cnt_ab / cnt_a
176:         lift_ab = conf_ab / (cnt_b / n_txn)
177:         if lift_ab > 1:
178:             rules_by_ant[a].append((b, conf_ab))
179:         conf_ba = cnt_ab / cnt_b
180:         lift_ba = conf_ba / (cnt_a / n_txn)
181:         if lift_ba > 1:
182:             rules_by_ant[b].append((a, conf_ba))
183: 
184:     recent4w = train[(train["week"] >= max_week - 3) & (train["overlap_seconds"] > 0)]
185:     user_recent_items = recent4w.groupby("user_id")["tv_show_id"].apply(lambda s: set(s.unique()))
186: 
187:     rankings = {}
188:     cand_set = set(candidates)
189:     for u in val_users:
190:         A_set = user_recent_items.get(u, set())
191:         if not A_set:
192:             rankings[u] = list(candidates[:POOL])
193:             continue
194:         score = defaultdict(float)
195:         for a in A_set:
196:             for c, conf in rules_by_ant.get(a, []):
197:                 if c in cand_set:
198:                     score[c] += conf
199:         if not score:
200:             rankings[u] = list(candidates[:POOL])
201:             continue
202:         rankings[u] = rank_list_from_scores(dict(score), rank_pop, k=POOL)
203:     return rankings
204:

206: # --------------------- ALS (по hybrid_final_submit.py) ---------------------
207: def als_rankings(train, val_users, pool, rank_pop):
208:     train_items = train["tv_show_id"].unique()
209:     train_users = train["user_id"].unique()
210:     u_map = {u: i for i, u in enumerate(train_users)}
211:     i_map = {it: i for i, it in enumerate(train_items)}
212:     rows_u = train["user_id"].map(u_map).values
213:     cols_i = train["tv_show_id"].map(i_map).values
214:     data = np.log1p(train["overlap_seconds"].values)
215:     mat = csr_matrix((data, (rows_u, cols_i)), shape=(len(u_map), len(i_map)))
216:     als = AlternatingLeastSquares(factors=64, regularization=0.05, iterations=20, random_state=SEED)
217:     als.fit(mat)
218:     pool_known = [c for c in pool if c in i_map]
219:     pool_idx = np.array([i_map[c] for c in pool_known])
220:     pool_factors = als.item_factors[pool_idx] if len(pool_idx) else np.zeros((0, 64))
221:     rankings = {}
222:     cold = []
223:     for u in val_users:
224:         if u not in u_map or len(pool_known) == 0:
225:             cold.append(u)
226:             continue
227:         uf = als.user_factors[u_map[u]]
228:         scores = pool_factors @ uf
229:         sc = dict(zip(pool_known, scores))
230:         min_sc = min(sc.values()) - 1.0
231:         for c in pool:
232:             if c not in sc:
233:                 sc[c] = min_sc
234:         rankings[u] = rank_list_from_scores(sc, rank_pop, k=POOL)
235:     for u in cold:
236:         rankings[u] = list(pool)
237:     return rankings

241: def load_train_schedule(train_end_week):
242:     sched = pd.read_csv(DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv", low_memory=False)
243:     sched["start_time"] = pd.to_datetime(sched["start_time"], dayfirst=True)
244:     sched["week"] = sched["start_time"].dt.isocalendar().week.astype(int)
245:     sched["hour"] = sched["start_time"].dt.hour.astype(int)
246:     sched["day_of_week"] = sched["start_time"].dt.day_of_week.astype(int)
247:     return sched[sched["week"] <= train_end_week].copy()

250: def build_item_tokens(train_sched):
251:     train_sched = train_sched[train_sched["tv_show_id"] != 0].copy()
252:     item_tokens = {}
253:     for _, row in train_sched.iterrows():
254:         toks = []
255:         if pd.notna(row["tv_show_category"]):
256:             toks.append("cat:" + str(row["tv_show_category"]))
257:         for g in ["tv_show_genre_1", "tv_show_genre_2", "tv_show_genre_3"]:
258:             if pd.notna(row[g]):
259:                 toks.append("gen:" + str(row[g]))
260:         toks.append("ch:" + str(int(row["channel_id"])))
261:         item_tokens.setdefault(row["tv_show_id"], set()).update(toks)
262:     vocab = {}
263:     for toks in item_tokens.values():
264:         for t in toks:
265:             if t not in vocab:
266:                 vocab[t] = len(vocab)
267:     item_mat = {}
268:     for sid, toks in item_tokens.items():
269:         vec = np.zeros(len(vocab))
270:         for t in toks:
271:             vec[vocab[t]] = 1.0
272:         item_mat[sid] = vec
273:     return item_mat, vocab
274:

276: def build_slot_popularity(train, train_sched, pop_train):
277:     sched_air = train_sched[train_sched["tv_show_id"] != 0].copy()
278:     sched_air["show_pop"] = sched_air["tv_show_id"].map(pop_train).fillna(0.0)
279:     slot_pop = sched_air.groupby(["channel_id", "hour", "day_of_week"])["show_pop"].mean()
280:     channel_pop = sched_air.groupby("channel_id")["show_pop"].mean()
281:     global_mean = float(sched_air["show_pop"].mean())
282:     return slot_pop, channel_pop, global_mean
283: 
284: 
285: def lookup_slot_pop(row, slot_pop, channel_pop, global_mean):
286:     key = (int(row["channel_id"]), int(row["hour"]), int(row["day_of_week"]))
287:     if key in slot_pop.index:
288:         return float(slot_pop.loc[key])
289:     ch = int(row["channel_id"])
290:     if ch in channel_pop.index:
291:         return float(channel_pop.loc[ch])
292:     return global_mean
293:

295: def cbf_rankings(train, val_users, pool, rank_pop, max_week, candidates):
296:     pop_train = train.groupby("tv_show_id")["user_id"].nunique()
297:     train_sched = load_train_schedule(max_week)
298:     item_mat, vocab = build_item_tokens(train_sched)
299:     V = len(vocab)
300:     slot_pop, channel_pop, global_mean = build_slot_popularity(train, train_sched, pop_train)
301:     slot_max = float(slot_pop.max()) if len(slot_pop) else 1.0
302: 
303:     val_sched = pd.read_csv(DATA / ("export_arh_21-30-final.csv" if max_week == 20 else "export_arh_11-20-final.csv"), low_memory=False)
304:     val_sched_air = val_sched[val_sched["tv_show_id"] != 0].copy()
305:     val_sched_air["start_time"] = pd.to_datetime(val_sched_air["start_time"], dayfirst=True)
306:     val_sched_air["hour"] = val_sched_air["start_time"].dt.hour.astype(int)
307:     val_sched_air["day_of_week"] = val_sched_air["start_time"].dt.day_of_week.astype(int)
308:     val_sched_air["slot_raw"] = val_sched_air.apply(
309:         lambda r: lookup_slot_pop(r, slot_pop, channel_pop, global_mean), axis=1)
310:     new_slot_norm = {}
311:     for sid, g in val_sched_air.groupby("tv_show_id")["slot_raw"]:
312:         new_slot_norm[sid] = float(g.mean()) / slot_max if slot_max > 0 else 0.0
313: 
314:     all_vec_cands = [c for c in candidates if c in item_mat]
315:     known_cands = [c for c in all_vec_cands if c in pop_train.index]
316:     known_mat = np.stack([item_mat[c] for c in known_cands]) if known_cands else np.zeros((0, V))
317:     known_norm = np.linalg.norm(known_mat, axis=1); known_norm[known_norm == 0] = 1.0
318:     all_mat = np.stack([item_mat[c] for c in all_vec_cands]) if all_vec_cands else np.zeros((0, V))
319:     all_card = all_mat.sum(axis=1) if all_mat.size else np.array([]); all_card[all_card == 0] = 1.0
320:     all_slot_vec = np.array([new_slot_norm.get(c, 0.0) for c in all_vec_cands])
321: 
322:     agg = train.groupby(["user_id", "tv_show_id"])["overlap_seconds"].sum().reset_index()
323:     agg["weight"] = np.log1p(agg["overlap_seconds"])
324:     agg = agg[agg["tv_show_id"].isin(item_mat)]
325:     warm_users = [u for u in val_users if u in set(train["user_id"].unique())]
326:     cold_users = [u for u in val_users if u not in set(train["user_id"].unique())]
327:     user_idx = {u: i for i, u in enumerate(warm_users)}
328:     profile = np.zeros((len(warm_users), V))
329:     for (u, sid), w in zip(zip(agg["user_id"], agg["tv_show_id"]), agg["weight"]):
330:         ui = user_idx.get(u)
331:         if ui is not None:
332:             profile[ui] += w * item_mat[sid]
333:     prof_norm = np.linalg.norm(profile, axis=1); prof_norm[prof_norm == 0] = 1.0
334:     pmax = profile.max(axis=1, keepdims=True); pmax[pmax == 0] = 1.0
335:     prof_unit = profile / pmax
336: 
337:     user_train_items = train.groupby("user_id")["tv_show_id"].apply(set).to_dict()
338:     all_vec_idx = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(all_vec_cands)}
339: 
340:     rankings = {}
341:     pool_known = [c for c in pool if c in pop_train.index and c in item_mat]
342:     known_mat_pool = np.stack([item_mat[c] for c in pool_known]) if pool_known else np.zeros((0, V))
343:     known_norm_pool = np.linalg.norm(known_mat_pool, axis=1); known_norm_pool[known_norm_pool == 0] = 1.0
344:     pool_all_vec = [c for c in pool if c in item_mat]
345:     all_mat_pool = np.stack([item_mat[c] for c in pool_all_vec]) if pool_all_vec else np.zeros((0, V))
346:     all_card_pool = all_mat_pool.sum(axis=1) if all_mat_pool.size else np.array([]); all_card_pool[all_card_pool == 0] = 1.0
347:     all_slot_pool = np.array([new_slot_norm.get(c, 0.0) for c in pool_all_vec])
348: 
349:     for b, u in enumerate(warm_users):
350:         # известные (pool): косинус
351:         if pool_known:
352:             cos = (profile[b] @ known_mat_pool.T) / (prof_norm[b] * known_norm_pool)
353:             known_scores = dict(zip(pool_known, cos))
354:         else:
355:             known_scores = {}
356:         # cold (в пуле, без просмотров этим пользователем): Jaccard*slotpop
357:         cold_pool = [c for c in pool_all_vec if c not in user_train_items.get(u, set())]
358:         cold_scores = {}
359:         if cold_pool:
360:             cold_idx = np.array([pool_all_vec.index(c) for c in cold_pool])
361:             jac_num = prof_unit[b] @ all_mat_pool[cold_idx].T
362:             jac = jac_num / all_card_pool[cold_idx]
363:             cold_scores = dict(zip(cold_pool, jac * all_slot_pool[cold_idx]))
364:         # два страта: сначала известные по косинусу, затем cold (как в exp_cbf_hw2.py)
365:         if known_scores:
366:             top_known = rank_list_from_scores(known_scores, rank_pop, k=POOL)
367:         else:
368:             top_known = []
369:         if cold_scores:
370:             top_cold = rank_list_from_scores(cold_scores, rank_pop, k=POOL)
371:         else:
372:             top_cold = []
373:         merged = top_known[:]
374:         for c in top_cold:
375:             if len(merged) >= POOL:
376:                 break
377:             if c not in merged:
378:                 merged.append(c)
379:         for c in pool:
380:             if len(merged) >= POOL:
381:                 break
382:             if c not in merged:
383:                 merged.append(c)
384:         rankings[u] = merged[:POOL]
385:     for u in cold_users:
386:         rankings[u] = list(pool[:POOL])
387:     return rankings
388:

390: # --------------------- RRF fusion + greedy ablation ---------------------
391: def fuse_rrf(rankings_by_component, selected, pool, weights=None, k=5):
392:     """rankings_by_component: {name: {user: [items ranked, 0=best]}}. selected: list of component names.
393:     RRF score(item) = sum 1/(RRF_K + rank). weights: необязательный dict name->float (по умолчанию 1)."""
394:     preds = {}
395:     users = set()
396:     for name in selected:
397:         users.update(rankings_by_component[name].keys())
398:     for u in users:
399:         sc = defaultdict(float)
400:         for name in selected:
401:             rank_list = rankings_by_component[name].get(u, [])
402:             wgt = 1.0 if weights is None else weights.get(name, 1.0)
403:             for r, item in enumerate(rank_list[:POOL]):
404:                 sc[item] += wgt / (RRF_K + r)
405:         if not sc:
406:             preds[u] = list(pool[:k])
407:             continue
408:         items = list(sc.keys())
409:         scores = np.array([sc[i] for i in items])
410:         order = sorted(range(len(items)), key=lambda i: -scores[i])
411:         preds[u] = [items[o] for o in order[:k]]
412:     return preds
413: 
414: 
415: def greedy_ablation(rankings_by_component, base_name, other_names, relevant, val_users):
416:     """Forward greedy: начинаем с base_name, по одному пробуем добавить каждый из other_names,
417:     оставляем компонент с лучшим MAP@5, повторяем, пока прирост есть."""
418:     selected = [base_name]
419:     log = []
420:     cur_map, _ = evaluate(fuse_rrf(rankings_by_component, selected, [], k=5), relevant)
421:     log.append((tuple(selected), cur_map))
422:     while True:
423:         best_gain = 0.0
424:         best_comp = None
425:         best_map = cur_map
426:         for comp in other_names:
427:             if comp in selected:
428:                 continue
429:             trial = selected + [comp]
430:             m, _ = evaluate(fuse_rrf(rankings_by_component, trial, [], k=5), relevant)
431:             if m - cur_map > best_gain:
432:                 best_gain = m - cur_map
433:                 best_comp = comp
434:                 best_map = m
435:         if best_comp is not None:
436:             selected.append(best_comp)
437:             cur_map = best_map
438:             log.append((tuple(selected), cur_map))
439:         else:
440:             break
441:     return selected, cur_map, log
442:

def ppr_tripartite(T, restart_mat, n_iter=N_ITER):
    """T — row-normalized (n_nodes×n_nodes) csr; restart_mat (n_nodes×B) — v (item block only).

    return P

Рёбра программа–атрибут двусторонние. attr_weight — какая доля вероятности
перехода из программы уходит в атрибуты, а не к пользователям: item→attr
масштабируется на attr_weight (равномерно по атрибутам программы),
item→user на (1−attr_weight) (пропорционально log(1+сек)), затем строковая
нормализация всего переходного оператора T (user→item без масштабирования).
Программы пула без просмотров в обучении имеют только атрибутные рёбра —
после нормализации вся их исходящая вероятность уходит в атрибуты (это и
позволяет «холодным» программам получать массу и попадать в топ-5).

Рестарт 0.5 (alpha = 1 − restart = 0.5), 30 итераций, батч scipy.sparse,
SEED=42. Restart-вектор — программы пользователя пропорционально весам
(как в бипартитном PPR).

attr_weight=0 — контрольный прогон: должен воспроизвести бипартитный
PPR restart=0.5 (main 0.5333 / early 0.4577;
results/tables/exp_grid_rp3_ease_ppr_sorted.csv).

Диагностика: сколько программ, не встречавшихся в обучении, попало в топ-5
(слотов и уникальных) и сколько из них релевантны.

MAP5_mean, time_s, seed + диагностика холодных программ).
"""
import time
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix

from exp_rrf_hybrid import (
    DATA, RESULTS, POOL, SEED,
    evaluate, build_split, rank_list_from_scores, row_normalize,
)

ATTR_WEIGHTS = (0.0, 0.1, 0.3, 0.5)  # 0.0 = контроль (бипартитный граф)
RESTART = 0.5
N_ITER = 30
USECOLS = ["channel_id", "tv_show_id", "tv_show_category",
           "tv_show_genre_1", "tv_show_genre_2", "tv_show_genre_3"]


def load_item_attrs(sched_paths):
    """tv_show_id -> список атрибутов (ch:/cat:/gen:) из расписания(й)."""
    frames = [pd.read_csv(p, usecols=USECOLS, dtype=str, low_memory=False)
              for p in sched_paths]
    sched = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
    sched["tv_show_id"] = sched["tv_show_id"].astype(np.int64)
    sched = sched[sched["tv_show_id"] != 0]
    parts = []
    ch = sched[["tv_show_id", "channel_id"]].dropna()
    parts.append(ch.assign(attr="ch:" + ch["channel_id"].astype(str))[["tv_show_id", "attr"]])
    cat = sched[["tv_show_id", "tv_show_category"]].dropna()
    parts.append(cat.assign(attr="cat:" + cat["tv_show_category"].astype(str))[["tv_show_id", "attr"]])
    for g in ["tv_show_genre_1", "tv_show_genre_2", "tv_show_genre_3"]:
        gg = sched[["tv_show_id", g]].dropna()
        parts.append(gg.assign(attr="gen:" + gg[g].astype(str))[["tv_show_id", "attr"]])
    attrs = pd.concat(parts, ignore_index=True).drop_duplicates()
    item_attrs = attrs.groupby("tv_show_id")["attr"].apply(list).to_dict()
    print(f"  [attrs] файлы={[Path(p).name for p in sched_paths]}: "
          f"программ с атрибутами={len(item_attrs)}, уникальных атрибутов={attrs['attr'].nunique()}")
    return item_attrs


def build_graph_base(train, pool_full, item_attrs):
    """База графа: рёбра user–item (агрегированные), словари узлов, атрибуты программ."""
    agg = train.groupby(["user_id", "tv_show_id"])["overlap_seconds"].sum().reset_index()
    agg["weight"] = np.log1p(agg["overlap_seconds"].astype(float))
    users = agg["user_id"].unique()
    train_items = agg["tv_show_id"].unique()
    items = np.unique(np.concatenate([train_items, np.asarray(pool_full, dtype=train_items.dtype)]))
    u_map = {u: i for i, u in enumerate(users)}
    i_map = {it: i for i, it in enumerate(items)}
    eu = agg["user_id"].map(u_map).to_numpy()
    ei = agg["tv_show_id"].map(i_map).to_numpy()
    ew = agg["weight"].to_numpy()

    # per-user (item_idx, weight) — для restart-вектора
    per_user = defaultdict(lambda: ([], []))
    for u_i, i_i, w in zip(eu, ei, ew):
        lst = per_user[u_i]
        lst[0].append(i_i)
        lst[1].append(w)
    user_restart = {}
    for u_i, (idxs, ws) in per_user.items():
        ws = np.asarray(ws, dtype=float)
        tot = ws.sum()
        if tot > 0:
            user_restart[u_i] = (np.asarray(idxs, dtype=np.int64), ws / tot)
        else:  # все веса нулевые -> равномерно
            user_restart[u_i] = (np.asarray(idxs, dtype=np.int64),
                                 np.full(len(idxs), 1.0 / len(idxs)))

    # атрибуты: item local idx -> list of attr local idx
    attr_index = {}
    per_item_attrs = []
    n_attrs_missing = 0
    for it in items:
        toks = item_attrs.get(int(it), [])
        if not toks:
            n_attrs_missing += 1
        idxs = []
        for t in toks:
            if t not in attr_index:
                attr_index[t] = len(attr_index)
            idxs.append(attr_index[t])
        per_item_attrs.append(idxs)
    print(f"  [graph] пользователей={len(u_map)}, программ={len(i_map)} "
          f"(train={len(train_items)}, в пуле не встречались={sum(1 for c in pool_full if c not in i_map or True)})", end="")
    print(f", атрибутов={len(attr_index)}, программ без атрибутов={n_attrs_missing}")
    return dict(eu=eu, ei=ei, ew=ew, nU=len(u_map), nI=len(i_map),
                nA=len(attr_index), i_map=i_map, per_user=user_restart,
                per_item_attrs=per_item_attrs, train_item_set=set(int(x) for x in train_items))


def build_transition(base, attr_weight):
    """T (csr, row-normalized): user→item (log1p-веса), item→user ×(1−aw),
    item→attr ×aw (равномерно), attr→item (равномерно)."""
    nU, nI, nA = base["nU"], base["nI"], base["nA"]
    n = nU + nI + nA
    I_off, A_off = nU, nU + nI
    eu, ei, ew = base["eu"], base["ei"], base["ew"]
    rows = [eu, ei + I_off]
    cols = [ei + I_off, eu]
    data = [ew, ew * (1.0 - attr_weight)]
    counts = np.array([len(a) for a in base["per_item_attrs"]], dtype=np.int64)
    total = int(counts.sum())
    if total > 0:
        item_ids = np.repeat(np.arange(nI, dtype=np.int64), counts)
        attr_ids = np.concatenate([np.asarray(a, dtype=np.int64)
                                   for a in base["per_item_attrs"] if a])
        # item -> attr
        rows.append(item_ids + I_off)
        cols.append(attr_ids + A_off)
        data.append(np.full(total, attr_weight) / np.repeat(counts, counts))
        # attr -> item
        rows.append(attr_ids + A_off)
        cols.append(item_ids + I_off)
        data.append(np.ones(total))
    T = csr_matrix((np.concatenate(data),
                    (np.concatenate(rows), np.concatenate(cols))), shape=(n, n))
    return row_normalize(T)


def ppr_tripartite(T, restart_mat, n_iter=N_ITER):
    """P = alpha*(T^T P) + (1-alpha)*restart; alpha = 1 − RESTART.
    restart_mat (n_nodes×B): ненулевой только блок программ (или нули для cold)."""
    alpha = 1.0 - RESTART
    Tt = T.T.tocsr()
    P = restart_mat.copy()
    for _ in range(n_iter):
        P = alpha * (Tt @ P) + (1.0 - alpha) * restart_mat
    return P


def main():
    inter = pd.read_parquet(DATA / "user_interactions.parquet")
    inter["user_id"] = inter["user_id"].astype(str)
    sub = pd.read_csv(DATA / "submission.csv", dtype={"user_id": str})
    sub_users = sub["user_id"].tolist()

    splits = {
        "main": dict(train_end_week=20, val_start_week=21, val_end_week=30,
                     sched_val_path=DATA / "export_arh_21-30-final.csv", max_week=20,
                     airings_file="export_arh_21-30-final.csv",
                     attrs_files=[DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv",
                                  DATA / "export_arh_21-30-final.csv"]),
        "early": dict(train_end_week=16, val_start_week=17, val_end_week=20,
                      sched_val_path=DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv", max_week=16,
                      airings_file="export_arh_11-20-final.csv",
                      attrs_files=[DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv"]),
    }

    acc = {aw: dict(MAP5_main=None, MAP5_early=None, time_s=0.0,
                    new_main=None, newu_main=None, newr_main=None,
                    new_early=None, newu_early=None, newr_early=None)
           for aw in ATTR_WEIGHTS}

    for split_name, cfg in splits.items():
        t_split = time.perf_counter()
        train, val_sched, candidates, relevant, val_users = build_split(
            inter, sub_users, cfg["train_end_week"], cfg["val_start_week"],
            cfg["val_end_week"], cfg["sched_val_path"])
        max_week = cfg["max_week"]
        airings = pd.read_csv(DATA / cfg["airings_file"], low_memory=False)
        airings = airings[airings["tv_show_id"] != 0]["tv_show_id"].value_counts().to_dict()
        pop_recent = train[train["week"] >= max_week - 3].groupby("tv_show_id")["user_id"].nunique()
        score_b = {c: pop_recent.get(c, 0) * np.log1p(airings.get(c, 0)) for c in candidates}
        pool_full = rank_list_from_scores(score_b, score_b, k=POOL)
        rank_pop = {it: r for r, it in enumerate(pool_full)}
        print(f"\n[split {split_name}] pool={len(pool_full)}, val_users={len(val_users)}, "
              f"train недель<={cfg['train_end_week']}")

        item_attrs = load_item_attrs(cfg["attrs_files"])
        base = build_graph_base(train, pool_full, item_attrs)
        nU, nI = base["nU"], base["nI"]
        I_off = nU
        pool_local = np.array([base["i_map"][c] for c in pool_full])
        n_nodes = nU + nI + base["nA"]

        # restart-матрица (n_nodes × B): блок программ = программы пользователя
        B = len(val_users)
        restart_mat = np.zeros((n_nodes, B))
        for b, u in enumerate(val_users):
            ui = None
            # warm: u в u_map? per_user ключи — локальные индексы
            # находим локальный индекс пользователя
            # (u_map построен внутри build_graph_base; восстановим через per_user недоступно,
            #  поэтому ищем по словарю i_map не нужно: используем u_map из base)
        # см. ниже: u_map нужен — вернём его из build_graph_base

        for aw in ATTR_WEIGHTS:
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            T = build_transition(base, aw)
            P = ppr_tripartite(T, restart_mat)
            scores = P[I_off + pool_local, :]
            preds = {}
            for b, u in enumerate(val_users):
                sc = dict(zip(pool_full, scores[:, b]))
                preds[u] = rank_list_from_scores(sc, rank_pop, k=POOL)
            m, n = evaluate(preds, relevant)
            dt = time.perf_counter() - t0

            # холодные программы в топ-5
            new_slots = new_rel = 0
            seen, rel_seen = set(), set()
            for u in val_users:
                for p in preds[u][:5]:
                    if p not in base["train_item_set"]:
                        new_slots += 1
                        seen.add(p)
                        if p in relevant.get(u, ()):
                            new_rel += 1
                            rel_seen.add(p)
            print(f"  attr_weight={aw}: MAP@5={m:.4f} (n={n}) time={dt:.1f}s | "
                  f"нетренированных в топ-5: слотов={new_slots}, уникальных={len(seen)}, "
                  f"релевантных слотов={new_rel}, релевантных уникальных={len(rel_seen)}")

            key = f"MAP5_{split_name}"
            acc[aw][key] = m
            acc[aw][f"time_s"] += dt
            acc[aw][f"new_{split_name}"] = new_slots
            acc[aw][f"newu_{split_name}"] = len(seen)
            acc[aw][f"newr_{split_name}"] = new_rel
        print(f"  [split завершён за {time.perf_counter() - t_split:.1f}s]")

    rows = []
    for aw in ATTR_WEIGHTS:
        a = acc[aw]
        label = (f"E1 attr_weight={aw}" + (" (контроль: бипартитный)" if aw == 0 else ""))
        rows.append({
            "variant": label,
            "params": f"attr_weight={aw}; restart={RESTART}; n_iter={N_ITER}; attrs=ch/cat/gen; graph=tripartite",
            "MAP5_main": a["MAP5_main"], "MAP5_early": a["MAP5_early"],
            "MAP5_mean": (a["MAP5_main"] + a["MAP5_early"]) / 2,
            "time_s": round(a["time_s"], 1), "seed": SEED,
            "new_top5_main": a["new_main"], "new_top5_unique_main": a["newu_main"],
            "new_top5_rel_main": a["newr_main"],
            "new_top5_early": a["new_early"], "new_top5_unique_early": a["newu_early"],
            "new_top5_rel_early": a["newr_early"],
        })
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("MAP5_mean", ascending=False)
    RESULTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out = RESULTS / "exp3_e1.csv"
    df.to_csv(out, index=False)
    print(f"\n[saved] {out}")
    print("\n=== E1: трёхдольный граф PPR (сортировка по среднему MAP@5) ===")
    print(df.to_string(index=False))
    return df


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def pool_check(name, train_end, sched_file, airings_file, max_week):

    cand = pd.read_csv(DATA/sched_file, low_memory=False)
    cand = cand[cand["tv_show_id"] != 0]["tv_show_id"].unique()
    air = pd.read_csv(DATA/airings_file, low_memory=False)

    pop = train[train["week"] >= max_week-3].groupby("tv_show_id")["user_id"].nunique()

    pool = sorted(sc, key=lambda c: (-sc[c], sc[c]))[:500]
    train_items = set(train["tv_show_id"].unique())
    pos = sum(1 for c in pool if sc[c] > 0)
    unseen = [c for c in pool if int(c) not in train_items]

Две находки:

1. **Ошибка в нормировке E1**: эффективная доля атрибутов была ≈0.0007 вместо aw — row-normalize гасил масштаб (сырые Σw по программе ≈ 622 против aw ≤ 0.5). Нужно нормировать внутри групп ДО смешивания: item→user = (1−aw)·w/Σw, item→attr = aw/|attrs|. Контроль aw=0 при этом уже сейчас точно воспроизводит бипартитный PPR (0.533331 / 0.457684) — сверка прошла.
2. **Пул топ-500 целиком состоит из программ, виденных в обучении** (pos_score=500, «в train не встречено=0» на всех трёх окнах): pop×airings отсекает всё ненайденное. Глобальный счётчик «нетренированных в топ-5» структурно всегда 0 — отчитаюсь честно и добавлю осмысленный пер-юзерный счётчик (программы, не виденные ЭТИМ пользователем).

Исправляю нормировку и диагностику:

def build_transition(base, attr_weight):
    """T (csr, row-normalized): user→item (log1p-веса), item→user ×(1−aw),
    item→attr ×aw (равномерно), attr→item (равномерно)."""
    nU, nI, nA = base["nU"], base["nI"], base["nA"]
    n = nU + nI + nA
    I_off, A_off = nU, nU + nI
    eu, ei, ew = base["eu"], base["ei"], base["ew"]
    rows = [eu, ei + I_off]
    cols = [ei + I_off, eu]
    data = [ew, ew * (1.0 - attr_weight)]

def build_transition(base, attr_weight):
    """T (csr, row-normalized): доля attr_weight из программы уходит в атрибуты,
    (1−attr_weight) — к пользователям. Нормировка ВНУТРИ групп ДО смешивания:
    item→user = (1−aw)·w/Σ_u w, item→attr = aw/|attrs(item)| (сумма ряда = 1,
    если оба типа рёбер есть). user→item = w (row_normalize), attr→item = 1
    (row_normalize -> равномерно). aw=0 даёт бипартитный граф бит-в-бит."""
    nU, nI, nA = base["nU"], base["nI"], base["nA"]
    n = nU + nI + nA
    I_off, A_off = nU, nU + nI
    eu, ei, ew = base["eu"], base["ei"], base["ew"]
    item_w_sum = np.bincount(ei, weights=ew, minlength=nI)
    safe_sum = np.where(item_w_sum > 0, item_w_sum, 1.0)
    rows = [eu, ei + I_off]
    cols = [ei + I_off, eu]
    data = [ew, (1.0 - attr_weight) * ew / safe_sum[ei]]

+    item_w_sum = np.bincount(ei, weights=ew, minlength=nI)

+    data = [ew, (1.0 - attr_weight) * ew / safe_sum[ei]]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""E2 (exp3): свежесть в трёхдольном графе PPR поверх лучшего E1 (attr_weight=0.5).

Вес ребра пользователь–программа (агрегированный по просмотрам):
    w_tau(u,i) = log1p( Σ_r overlap_r · exp(−Δ_r/τ) ),  Δ_r = max_week − week_r
(недель от просмотра до конца обучения). При τ→∞ вес совпадает с E1
(log1p Σ overlap_r) — базовая строка таблицы это подтверждает.

τ ∈ {4, 8}. Два варианта restart-вектора:
  - restart=raw:      рестарт по СЫРЫМ весам (лог-нормализация без затухания);
  - restart=decayed:  рестарт по тем же затухающими весами, что и граф.
Атрибуты/attr_weight/рёбра программа–атрибут — как в лучшем E1 (aw=0.5,
restart 0.5, 30 итераций). Диагностика холодных программ — как в E1.

Таблица: results/tables/exp3_e2.csv.
"""
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from exp_rrf_hybrid import (
    DATA, RESULTS, POOL, SEED,
    evaluate, build_split, rank_list_from_scores,
)
from exp3_e1_attr_ppr import (
    ATTR_WEIGHTS, RESTART, N_ITER,
    load_item_attrs, build_graph_base, build_transition, ppr_tripartite,
)

BEST_AW = max(ATTR_WEIGHTS, key=lambda a: a)  # E1: 0.5 (лучший по среднему MAP@5)
TAUS = (4.0, 8.0)
RESTART_MODES = ("raw", "decayed")


def main():
    inter = pd.read_parquet(DATA / "user_interactions.parquet")
    inter["user_id"] = inter["user_id"].astype(str)
    sub = pd.read_csv(DATA / "submission.csv", dtype={"user_id": str})
    sub_users = sub["user_id"].tolist()

    splits = {
        "main": dict(train_end_week=20, val_start_week=21, val_end_week=30,
                     sched_val_path=DATA / "export_arh_21-30-final.csv", max_week=20,
                     airings_file="export_arh_21-30-final.csv",
                     attrs_files=[DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv",
                                  DATA / "export_arh_21-30-final.csv"]),
        "early": dict(train_end_week=16, val_start_week=17, val_end_week=20,
                      sched_val_path=DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv", max_week=16,
                      airings_file="export_arh_11-20-final.csv",
                      attrs_files=[DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv"]),
    }

    # variant-key -> acc
    variants = [("E2 baseline (без decay, как E1 aw=0.5)", None, "raw")]
    for tau in TAUS:
        for mode in RESTART_MODES:
            variants.append((f"E2 tau={tau:.0f} restart={mode}", tau, mode))
    acc = {v[0]: dict(MAP5_main=None, MAP5_early=None, time_s=0.0,
                      uu_main=None, uur_main=None, uu_early=None, uur_early=None)
           for v in variants}

    for split_name, cfg in splits.items():
        t_split = time.perf_counter()
        train, val_sched, candidates, relevant, val_users = build_split(
            inter, sub_users, cfg["train_end_week"], cfg["val_start_week"],
            cfg["val_end_week"], cfg["sched_val_path"])
        max_week = cfg["max_week"]
        airings = pd.read_csv(DATA / cfg["airings_file"], low_memory=False)
        airings = airings[airings["tv_show_id"] != 0]["tv_show_id"].value_counts().to_dict()
        pop_recent = train[train["week"] >= max_week - 3].groupby("tv_show_id")["user_id"].nunique()
        score_b = {c: pop_recent.get(c, 0) * np.log1p(airings.get(c, 0)) for c in candidates}
        pool_full = rank_list_from_scores(score_b, score_b, k=POOL)
        rank_pop = {it: r for r, it in enumerate(pool_full)}
        print(f"\n[split {split_name}] pool={len(pool_full)}, val_users={len(val_users)}, "
              f"train недель<={cfg['train_end_week']}, конец обучения=нед.{max_week}")

        item_attrs = load_item_attrs(cfg["attrs_files"])
        user_train_items = train.groupby("user_id")["tv_show_id"].apply(set).to_dict()

        # база графа пер tau (baseline tau=None -> без затухания); прогоняем по одному tau
        for label, tau, rmode in variants:
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            base = build_graph_base(train, pool_full, item_attrs,
                                    decay_tau=tau, max_week=max_week)
            nU = base["nU"]
            I_off = nU
            n_nodes = nU + base["nI"] + base["nA"]
            pool_local = np.array([base["i_map"][c] for c in pool_full])

            restart_src = base["per_user_raw"] if rmode == "raw" else base["per_user"]
            B = len(val_users)
            restart_mat = np.zeros((n_nodes, B))
            for b, u in enumerate(val_users):
                ui = base["u_map"].get(u)
                if ui is None:
                    continue
                idxs, ws = restart_src[ui]
                restart_mat[I_off + idxs, b] = ws

            T = build_transition(base, BEST_AW)
            P = ppr_tripartite(T, restart_mat)
            scores = P[I_off + pool_local, :]
            preds = {}
            for b, u in enumerate(val_users):
                sc = dict(zip(pool_full, scores[:, b]))
                preds[u] = rank_list_from_scores(sc, rank_pop, k=POOL)
            m, n = evaluate(preds, relevant)
            dt = time.perf_counter() - t0

            unseen_u_slots = unseen_u_rel = 0
            for u in val_users:
                u_hist = user_train_items.get(u, set())
                for p in preds[u][:5]:
                    if p not in u_hist:
                        unseen_u_slots += 1
                        if p in relevant.get(u, ()):
                            unseen_u_rel += 1
            print(f"  {label}: MAP@5={m:.4f} (n={n}) time={dt:.1f}s | "
                  f"пер-юзерно не видел: слотов={unseen_u_slots}, из них релевантных={unseen_u_rel}")

            a = acc[label]
            a[f"MAP5_{split_name}"] = m
            a["time_s"] += dt
            a[f"uu_{split_name}"] = unseen_u_slots
            a[f"uur_{split_name}"] = unseen_u_rel
        print(f"  [split завершён за {time.perf_counter() - t_split:.1f}s]")

    rows = []
    for label, tau, rmode in variants:
        a = acc[label]
        if tau is None:
            params = f"attr_weight={BEST_AW}; decay=none; restart={rmode}; restart_p={RESTART}; n_iter={N_ITER}"
        else:
            params = (f"attr_weight={BEST_AW}; decay_tau={tau:.0f}; restart={rmode}; "
                      f"restart_p={RESTART}; n_iter={N_ITER}")
        rows.append({
            "variant": label, "params": params,
            "MAP5_main": a["MAP5_main"], "MAP5_early": a["MAP5_early"],
            "MAP5_mean": (a["MAP5_main"] + a["MAP5_early"]) / 2,
            "time_s": round(a["time_s"], 1), "seed": SEED,
            "usernew_top5_main": a["uu_main"], "usernew_rel_main": a["uur_main"],
            "usernew_top5_early": a["uu_early"], "usernew_rel_early": a["uur_early"],
        })
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("MAP5_mean", ascending=False)
    RESULTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out = RESULTS / "exp3_e2.csv"
    df.to_csv(out, index=False)
    print(f"\n[saved] {out}")
    print("\n=== E2: свежесть в графе (сортировка по среднему MAP@5) ===")
    print(df.to_string(index=False))
    return df


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

score(item) = w_pop/(k + rank_pop) + w_ppr/(k + rank_ppr) + w_als/(k + rank_als)
  w_pop ∈ {1, 1.5, 2}, w_ppr ∈ {1, 1.5, 2}, w_als ∈ {0, 0.5, 1}, k ∈ {20, 60}
= 54 комбинации. Абляция pop+PPR без ALS покрыта w_als=0 (лучшая отмечена).

Лучший PPR из E1/E2: трёхдольный граф attr_weight=0.5, decay_tau=8,
restart=raw (exp3_e1.csv / exp3_e2.csv). Контроль «текущий финал локально»:
RRF k=60, веса 1/1/1 из pop×airings + бипартитный PPR restart=0.5 (aw=0) + ALS.

Таблица: results/tables/exp3_e3.csv.
"""
import time
from itertools import product

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from exp_rrf_hybrid import (
    DATA, RESULTS, POOL, SEED,
    evaluate, build_split, rank_list_from_scores, als_rankings,
)
from exp3_e1_attr_ppr import (
    RESTART, N_ITER,
    load_item_attrs, build_graph_base, build_transition, ppr_tripartite,
)

W_POP = (1.0, 1.5, 2.0)
W_PPR = (1.0, 1.5, 2.0)
W_ALS = (0.0, 0.5, 1.0)
K_RRF = (20, 60)
BEST_AW = 0.5       # E1
BEST_TAU = 8.0      # E2, restart=raw


def tripartite_rankings(base, restart_src, pool_full, rank_pop, val_users, attr_weight,
                        decay_tau=None):
    """PPR-ранжирование по трёхдольному графу. Возвращает (rankings, scores_matrix)
    scores_matrix — (n_pool, B) в порядке pool_full."""
    nU = base["nU"]
    I_off = nU
    n_nodes = nU + base["nI"] + base["nA"]
    pool_local = np.array([base["i_map"][c] for c in pool_full])
    B = len(val_users)
    restart_mat = np.zeros((n_nodes, B))
    for b, u in enumerate(val_users):
        ui = base["u_map"].get(u)
        if ui is None:
            continue
        idxs, ws = restart_src[ui]
        restart_mat[I_off + idxs, b] = ws
    T = build_transition(base, attr_weight)
    P = ppr_tripartite(T, restart_mat)
    scores = P[I_off + pool_local, :]  # (n_pool, B)
    rankings = {}
    for b, u in enumerate(val_users):
        sc = dict(zip(pool_full, scores[:, b]))
        rankings[u] = rank_list_from_scores(sc, rank_pop, k=POOL)
    for u in val_users:  # cold: нулевые скоры -> порядок пула (tie_rank)
        if u not in rankings:
            rankings[u] = list(pool_full)
    return rankings, scores


def rank_matrix(rankings, val_users, pool_full):
    """(n_users, n_pool) матрица рангов; столбцы в порядке pool_full."""
    idx = {it: j for j, it in enumerate(pool_full)}
    M = np.zeros((len(val_users), len(pool_full)), dtype=np.int32)
    for i, u in enumerate(val_users):
        for r, it in enumerate(rankings[u]):
            M[i, idx[it]] = r
    return M


def fuse_weighted_top5(M_list, weights, k_rrf):
    """Топ-5 по Σ w/(k_rrf+rank); тай-брейк — порядок пула (столбцы)."""
    score = np.zeros_like(M_list[0], dtype=np.float64)
    for M, w in zip(M_list, weights):
        if w != 0.0:
            score += w / (k_rrf + M)
    order = np.argsort(-score, axis=1, kind="stable")[:, :5]
    return order


def main():
    inter = pd.read_parquet(DATA / "user_interactions.parquet")
    inter["user_id"] = inter["user_id"].astype(str)
    sub = pd.read_csv(DATA / "submission.csv", dtype={"user_id": str})
    sub_users = sub["user_id"].tolist()

    splits = {
        "main": dict(train_end_week=20, val_start_week=21, val_end_week=30,
                     sched_val_path=DATA / "export_arh_21-30-final.csv", max_week=20,
                     airings_file="export_arh_21-30-final.csv",
                     attrs_files=[DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv",
                                  DATA / "export_arh_21-30-final.csv"]),
        "early": dict(train_end_week=16, val_start_week=17, val_end_week=20,
                      sched_val_path=DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv", max_week=16,
                      airings_file="export_arh_11-20-final.csv",
                      attrs_files=[DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv"]),
    }

    grid = list(product(W_POP, W_PPR, W_ALS, K_RRF))
    acc = {g: dict(MAP5_main=None, MAP5_early=None, time_s=0.0) for g in grid}
    ctrl = dict(MAP5_main=None, MAP5_early=None)
    meta = dict(MAP5_ppr_main=None, MAP5_ppr_early=None, MAP5_als_main=None, MAP5_als_early=None)

    for split_name, cfg in splits.items():
        t_split = time.perf_counter()
        train, val_sched, candidates, relevant, val_users = build_split(
            inter, sub_users, cfg["train_end_week"], cfg["val_start_week"],
            cfg["val_end_week"], cfg["sched_val_path"])
        max_week = cfg["max_week"]
        airings = pd.read_csv(DATA / cfg["airings_file"], low_memory=False)
        airings = airings[airings["tv_show_id"] != 0]["tv_show_id"].value_counts().to_dict()
        pop_recent = train[train["week"] >= max_week - 3].groupby("tv_show_id")["user_id"].nunique()
        score_b = {c: pop_recent.get(c, 0) * np.log1p(airings.get(c, 0)) for c in candidates}
        pool_full = rank_list_from_scores(score_b, score_b, k=POOL)
        rank_pop = {it: r for r, it in enumerate(pool_full)}
        print(f"\n[split {split_name}] pool={len(pool_full)}, val_users={len(val_users)}")

        item_attrs = load_item_attrs(cfg["attrs_files"])
        # PPR лучший из E1/E2: aw=0.5, tau=8, restart=raw
        base_best = build_graph_base(train, pool_full, item_attrs,
                                     decay_tau=BEST_TAU, max_week=max_week)
        ppr_best, _ = tripartite_rankings(base_best, base_best["per_user"],
                                          pool_full, rank_pop, val_users, BEST_AW)
        # PPR бипартитный (aw=0, restart=raw) — как в текущем финале
        base_bip = build_graph_base(train, pool_full, item_attrs)
        ppr_bip, _ = tripartite_rankings(base_bip, base_bip["per_user"],
                                         pool_full, rank_pop, val_users, 0.0)
        # ALS
        als_r = als_rankings(train, val_users, pool_full, rank_pop)

        pop_rank = {u: list(pool_full) for u in val_users}

        # отдельные комппоненты (справочно)
        m_ppr, _ = evaluate({u: ppr_best[u][:5] for u in val_users}, relevant)
        m_als, _ = evaluate({u: als_r[u][:5] for u in val_users}, relevant)
        meta[f"MAP5_ppr_{split_name}"] = m_ppr
        meta[f"MAP5_als_{split_name}"] = m_als
        print(f"  PPR_best отдельно MAP@5={m_ppr:.4f}; ALS отдельно MAP@5={m_als:.4f}")

        # контроль: текущий финал локально (k=60, w=1/1/1, bipartite PPR restart=0.5)
        M_pop = rank_matrix(pop_rank, val_users, pool_full)
        M_ppr_bip = rank_matrix(ppr_bip, val_users, pool_full)
        M_als = rank_matrix(als_r, val_users, pool_full)
        M_ppr_best = rank_matrix(ppr_best, val_users, pool_full)
        order = fuse_weighted_top5([M_pop, M_ppr_bip, M_als], (1.0, 1.0, 1.0), 60)
        preds_ctrl = {u: [pool_full[j] for j in order[i]] for i, u in enumerate(val_users)}
        m_ctrl, _ = evaluate(preds_ctrl, relevant)
        ctrl[f"MAP5_{split_name}"] = m_ctrl
        print(f"  [контроль: текущий финал локально, RRF k=60 1/1/1 с bipartite PPR] "
              f"MAP@5={m_ctrl:.4f}")

        # сетка 54 комбинации (лучший PPR как компонент)
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        for w_pop, w_ppr, w_als, k_rrf in grid:
            order = fuse_weighted_top5([M_pop, M_ppr_best, M_als],
                                       (w_pop, w_ppr, w_als), k_rrf)
            preds = {u: [pool_full[j] for j in order[i]] for i, u in enumerate(val_users)}
            m, _ = evaluate(preds, relevant)
            g = (w_pop, w_ppr, w_als, k_rrf)
            acc[g][f"MAP5_{split_name}"] = m
            acc[g]["time_s"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
        print(f"  сетка {len(grid)} комбинаций посчитана "
              f"({time.perf_counter() - t_split:.1f}s на сплит)")
        # сохранить лучшие rank-матрицы для E4 не требуется — E4 считает отдельно
        del base_best, base_bip

    rows = []
    for g in grid:
        w_pop, w_ppr, w_als, k_rrf = g
        a = acc[g]
        label = f"E3 w_pop={w_pop} w_ppr={w_ppr} w_als={w_als} k={k_rrf}"
        rows.append({
            "variant": label,
            "params": (f"w_pop={w_pop}; w_ppr={w_ppr}; w_als={w_als}; k_rrf={k_rrf}; "
                       f"ppr=E1aw0.5+E2tau8raw; pool={POOL}"),
            "MAP5_main": a["MAP5_main"], "MAP5_early": a["MAP5_early"],
            "MAP5_mean": (a["MAP5_main"] + a["MAP5_early"]) / 2,
            "time_s": round(a["time_s"], 3), "seed": SEED,
            "ablation_pop_ppr_no_als": w_als == 0,
        })
    # контроль текущего финала и отдельные компоненты — в ту же таблицу
    rows.append({
        "variant": "КОНТРОЛЬ: текущий финал (k=60 w=1/1/1, bipartite PPR restart=0.5)",
        "params": "w_pop=1; w_ppr=1; w_als=1; k_rrf=60; ppr=bipartite restart=0.5",
        "MAP5_main": ctrl["MAP5_main"], "MAP5_early": ctrl["MAP5_early"],
        "MAP5_mean": (ctrl["MAP5_main"] + ctrl["MAP5_early"]) / 2,
        "time_s": None, "seed": SEED, "ablation_pop_ppr_no_als": False,
    })
    rows.append({
        "variant": "справочно: PPR_best отдельно (E1 aw=0.5 + E2 tau=8)",
        "params": "attr_weight=0.5; decay_tau=8; restart=raw; restart_p=0.5; n_iter=30",
        "MAP5_main": meta["MAP5_ppr_main"], "MAP5_early": meta["MAP5_ppr_early"],
        "MAP5_mean": (meta["MAP5_ppr_main"] + meta["MAP5_ppr_early"]) / 2,
        "time_s": None, "seed": SEED, "ablation_pop_ppr_no_als": False,
    })
    rows.append({
        "variant": "справочно: ALS отдельно",
        "params": "factors=64; reg=0.05; iterations=20",
        "MAP5_main": meta["MAP5_als_main"], "MAP5_early": meta["MAP5_als_early"],
        "MAP5_mean": (meta["MAP5_als_main"] + meta["MAP5_als_early"]) / 2,
        "time_s": None, "seed": SEED, "ablation_pop_ppr_no_als": False,
    })
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("MAP5_mean", ascending=False)
    RESULTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out = RESULTS / "exp3_e3.csv"
    df.to_csv(out, index=False)
    print(f"\n[saved] {out}")
    print("\n=== E3: взвешенный RRF (топ-15 по среднему MAP@5) ===")
    print(df.head(15).to_string(index=False))
    print("\n=== абляция pop+PPR без ALS (w_als=0), топ-5 ===")
    abl = df[df["ablation_pop_ppr_no_als"]].head(5)
    print(abl[["variant", "MAP5_main", "MAP5_early", "MAP5_mean"]].to_string(index=False))
    return df


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""E4 (exp3): буст по эфирам поверх PPR как самостоятельный компонент.

score(item) = PPR_best(item) × (1 + airings)^a, a ∈ {0.25, 0.5} — ранжирование
заменяет ОТДЕЛЬНЫЕ компоненты pop×airings и PPR в fusion (как в финале их было
два: pop_airings + PPR; здесь один комбинированный). Оцениваем:
  1) компонент отдельно (MAP@5);
  2) RRF k=60: boost + ALS (замена пары pop×airings + PPR на boost).

airings: на валидации — из расписания val-окна (как в пуле), в финальном
инференсе — из 31–42 (только счётчик эфиров, просмотры не используются).
PPR_best = E1 aw=0.5 + E2 decay_tau=8, restart=raw.

Таблица: results/tables/exp3_e4.csv.
"""
import time

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from exp_rrf_hybrid import (
    DATA, RESULTS, POOL, SEED,
    evaluate, build_split, rank_list_from_scores, als_rankings,
)
from exp3_e1_attr_ppr import (
    RESTART, N_ITER,
    load_item_attrs, build_graph_base, build_transition, ppr_tripartite,
)
from exp3_e3_rrf_weights import tripartite_rankings, rank_matrix, fuse_weighted_top5

A_POW = (0.25, 0.5)
BEST_AW = 0.5
BEST_TAU = 8.0


def main():
    inter = pd.read_parquet(DATA / "user_interactions.parquet")
    inter["user_id"] = inter["user_id"].astype(str)
    sub = pd.read_csv(DATA / "submission.csv", dtype={"user_id": str})
    sub_users = sub["user_id"].tolist()

    splits = {
        "main": dict(train_end_week=20, val_start_week=21, val_end_week=30,
                     sched_val_path=DATA / "export_arh_21-30-final.csv", max_week=20,
                     airings_file="export_arh_21-30-final.csv",
                     attrs_files=[DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv",
                                  DATA / "export_arh_21-30-final.csv"]),
        "early": dict(train_end_week=16, val_start_week=17, val_end_week=20,
                      sched_val_path=DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv", max_week=16,
                      airings_file="export_arh_11-20-final.csv",
                      attrs_files=[DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv"]),
    }

    acc = {(a, "solo"): dict(MAP5_main=None, MAP5_early=None, time_s=0.0) for a in A_POW}
    acc.update({(a, "rrf_als"): dict(MAP5_main=None, MAP5_early=None, time_s=0.0)
                for a in A_POW})
    ctrl = dict(MAP5_main=None, MAP5_early=None)

    for split_name, cfg in splits.items():
        t_split = time.perf_counter()
        train, val_sched, candidates, relevant, val_users = build_split(
            inter, sub_users, cfg["train_end_week"], cfg["val_start_week"],
            cfg["val_end_week"], cfg["sched_val_path"])
        max_week = cfg["max_week"]
        airings = pd.read_csv(DATA / cfg["airings_file"], low_memory=False)
        airings = airings[airings["tv_show_id"] != 0]["tv_show_id"].value_counts().to_dict()
        pop_recent = train[train["week"] >= max_week - 3].groupby("tv_show_id")["user_id"].nunique()
        score_b = {c: pop_recent.get(c, 0) * np.log1p(airings.get(c, 0)) for c in candidates}
        pool_full = rank_list_from_scores(score_b, score_b, k=POOL)
        rank_pop = {it: r for r, it in enumerate(pool_full)}
        print(f"\n[split {split_name}] pool={len(pool_full)}, val_users={len(val_users)}")

        item_attrs = load_item_attrs(cfg["attrs_files"])
        base = build_graph_base(train, pool_full, item_attrs,
                                decay_tau=BEST_TAU, max_week=max_week)
        ppr_r, ppr_scores = tripartite_rankings(base, base["per_user_raw"],
                                                pool_full, rank_pop, val_users, BEST_AW)
        # ppr_scores: (n_pool, B) в порядке pool_full
        als_r = als_rankings(train, val_users, pool_full, rank_pop)
        pop_rank = {u: list(pool_full) for u in val_users}

        # контроль: текущий финал локально (k=60, 1/1/1, bipartite PPR) — из exp3_e3
        # здесь: fusion pop+PPR_best+ALS k=60 как референс "популярная пара отдельно"
        M_pop = rank_matrix(pop_rank, val_users, pool_full)
        M_ppr = rank_matrix(ppr_r, val_users, pool_full)
        M_als = rank_matrix(als_r, val_users, pool_full)
        order_ref = fuse_weighted_top5([M_pop, M_ppr, M_als], (1.0, 1.0, 1.0), 60)
        preds_ref = {u: [pool_full[j] for j in order_ref[i]]
                     for i, u in enumerate(val_users)}
        m_ref, _ = evaluate(preds_ref, relevant)
        print(f"  референс pop+PPR_best+ALS (k=60, 1/1/1): MAP@5={m_ref:.4f}")

        air_arr = np.array([airings.get(c, 0) for c in pool_full], dtype=np.float64)

        for a in A_POW:
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            boost = (1.0 + air_arr) ** a  # (n_pool,)
            # solo: score = PPR × boost
            boosted_scores = ppr_scores * boost[:, None]  # (n_pool, B)
            preds_solo = {}
            for b, u in enumerate(val_users):

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""exp3: генерация четырёх сабмитов (обучение 11–30, пул топ-500 pop×log(1+airings 31-42)).

Все варианты прошли локальный фильтр «не хуже текущего финала на обоих сплитах»
(контроль финала локально: main 0.5015 / early 0.4318, exp3_e3.csv):

1. exp3_e1   — чистый трёхдольный PPR: attr_weight=0.5, restart=0.5, без decay
               (лучший E1; локально 0.5427/0.4643).
2. exp3_e2   — E1 + decay_tau=8, restart=raw (лучший E1+E2; локально 0.5433/0.4645).
3. exp3_e3   — взвешенный RRF k=20: w_pop=1, w_ppr=2, w_als=1
               (лучший E3; локально 0.5357/0.4626).
4. exp3_disc — структура текущего финала RRF k=60, веса 1/1/1, но компонент PPR
               заменён на лучший (E1+E2): «рекорд + улучшенный PPR»
               (локально 0.5125/0.4371; обоснование: изолировать эффект PPR-компонента
               при неизменной fusion-структуре рекорда).

Атрибуты графа (программа–канал–категория–жанр) — из расписаний 11-20/21-30/31-42
(для пула — 31–42). Тестовые просмотры 31–42 не используются: только расписание
(связи и счётчик эфиров). Выход: data/submission_exp3_*.csv + проверка формата.
"""
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "artifacts" / "scripts"))
from exp_rrf_hybrid import (
    DATA, POOL, SEED,
    rank_list_from_scores, als_rankings,
)
from exp3_e1_attr_ppr import load_item_attrs, build_graph_base, ppr_tripartite
from exp3_e3_rrf_weights import tripartite_rankings, rank_matrix, fuse_weighted_top5

BEST_AW = 0.5
BEST_TAU = 8.0
MAX_WEEK = 30
N_TEST = 1260


def check_format(path, template_path, candidates_set):
    """Проверка формата сабмита перед отправкой (как в шаблоне)."""
    out = pd.read_csv(path, dtype={"user_id": str})
    tpl = pd.read_csv(template_path, dtype={"user_id": str})
    assert list(out.columns) == ["user_id", "tv_show_id"], f"колонки: {list(out.columns)}"
    assert len(out) == N_TEST == len(tpl), f"строк: {len(out)} (нужно {N_TEST})"
    assert (out["user_id"].values == tpl["user_id"].values).all(), "порядок user_id != шаблон"
    n_unique_total = 0
    for ids in out["tv_show_id"]:
        parts = str(ids).split()
        assert len(parts) == 5, f"не 5 id: {ids}"
        ints = [int(p) for p in parts]
        assert len(set(ints)) == 5, f"дубликаты в топ-5: {ids}"
        assert all(i in candidates_set for i in ints), f"id вне расписания 31-42: {ids}"
        n_unique_total += len(set(ints))
    print(f"  [format OK] {Path(path).name}: 1260 строк, 5 уникальных id, "
          f"все из расписания 31-42, порядок как в шаблоне")
    return True


def main():
    inter = pd.read_parquet(DATA / "user_interactions.parquet")
    inter["user_id"] = inter["user_id"].astype(str)
    train = inter[inter["week"] <= MAX_WEEK]
    sub = pd.read_csv(DATA / "submission.csv", dtype={"user_id": str})
    test_users = sub["user_id"].tolist()

    sched42 = pd.read_csv(DATA / "export_arh_31-42-final.csv", low_memory=False)
    candidates = sched42[sched42["tv_show_id"] != 0]["tv_show_id"].unique()
    candidates_set = set(int(c) for c in candidates)
    airings = sched42[sched42["tv_show_id"] != 0]["tv_show_id"].value_counts().to_dict()

    pop_recent = train[train["week"] >= MAX_WEEK - 3].groupby("tv_show_id")["user_id"].nunique()
    score_b = {c: pop_recent.get(c, 0) * np.log1p(airings.get(c, 0)) for c in candidates}
    pool_full = rank_list_from_scores(score_b, score_b, k=POOL)
    rank_pop = {it: r for r, it in enumerate(pool_full)}
    print(f"[pool] топ-{len(pool_full)} по pop(27-30)×log(1+airings 31-42); "
          f"train недель<= {MAX_WEEK}, строк={len(train)}")

    # атрибуты: все три расписания (пул получает связи из 31–42)
    item_attrs = load_item_attrs([DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv",
                                  DATA / "export_arh_21-30-final.csv",
                                  DATA / "export_arh_31-42-final.csv"])

    # --- PPR E1 (без decay) ---
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    base_e1 = build_graph_base(train, pool_full, item_attrs)
    ppr_e1, _ = tripartite_rankings(base_e1, base_e1["per_user"],
                                    pool_full, rank_pop, test_users, BEST_AW)
    print(f"[PPR E1 aw={BEST_AW} без decay] {time.perf_counter() - t0:.1f}s")

    # --- PPR E2 (tau=8, restart=raw) ---
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    base_e2 = build_graph_base(train, pool_full, item_attrs,
                               decay_tau=BEST_TAU, max_week=MAX_WEEK)
    ppr_e2, _ = tripartite_rankings(base_e2, base_e2["per_user_raw"],
                                    pool_full, rank_pop, test_users, BEST_AW)
    print(f"[PPR E2 tau={BEST_TAU:.0f} restart=raw] {time.perf_counter() - t0:.1f}s")

    # --- ALS ---
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    als_r = als_rankings(train, test_users, pool_full, rank_pop)
    print(f"[ALS f=64] {time.perf_counter() - t0:.1f}s")

    pop_rank = {u: list(pool_full) for u in test_users}
    M_pop = rank_matrix(pop_rank, test_users, pool_full)
    M_ppr = rank_matrix(ppr_e2, test_users, pool_full)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""exp3: локальная оценка 5-го сабмита — E3-fusion (k=20, w=(1,2,1)) с PPR E1 (без decay).

Гипотеза по Kaggle: decay слегка вредит (E1 0.32306 > E2 0.32261 на public),
поэтому fusion-конфигурация лучшего E3, но с PPR без decay, может быть лучше.
Локальная проверка на обоих сплитах перед отправкой (фильтр: не хуже текущего
финала локально 0.5015/0.4318).

Таблица: results/tables/exp3_e3_ppr_e1.csv.
"""
import time

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from exp_rrf_hybrid import (
    DATA, RESULTS, POOL, SEED,
    evaluate, build_split, rank_list_from_scores, als_rankings,
)
from exp3_e1_attr_ppr import (
    RESTART, N_ITER,
    load_item_attrs, build_graph_base,
)
from exp3_e3_rrf_weights import tripartite_rankings, rank_matrix, fuse_weighted_top5

BEST_AW = 0.5
W = (1.0, 2.0, 1.0)
K_RRF = 20


def main():
    inter = pd.read_parquet(DATA / "user_interactions.parquet")
    inter["user_id"] = inter["user_id"].astype(str)
    sub = pd.read_csv(DATA / "submission.csv", dtype={"user_id": str})
    sub_users = sub["user_id"].tolist()

    splits = {
        "main": dict(train_end_week=20, val_start_week=21, val_end_week=30,
                     sched_val_path=DATA / "export_arh_21-30-final.csv", max_week=20,
                     airings_file="export_arh_21-30-final.csv",
                     attrs_files=[DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv",
                                  DATA / "export_arh_21-30-final.csv"]),
        "early": dict(train_end_week=16, val_start_week=17, val_end_week=20,
                      sched_val_path=DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv", max_week=16,
                      airings_file="export_arh_11-20-final.csv",
                      attrs_files=[DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv"]),
    }
    acc = {}

    for split_name, cfg in splits.items():
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        train, val_sched, candidates, relevant, val_users = build_split(
            inter, sub_users, cfg["train_end_week"], cfg["val_start_week"],
            cfg["val_end_week"], cfg["sched_val_path"])
        max_week = cfg["max_week"]
        airings = pd.read_csv(DATA / cfg["airings_file"], low_memory=False)
        airings = airings[airings["tv_show_id"] != 0]["tv_show_id"].value_counts().to_dict()
        pop_recent = train[train["week"] >= max_week - 3].groupby("tv_show_id")["user_id"].nunique()
        score_b = {c: pop_recent.get(c, 0) * np.log1p(airings.get(c, 0)) for c in candidates}
        pool_full = rank_list_from_scores(score_b, score_b, k=POOL)
        rank_pop = {it: r for r, it in enumerate(pool_full)}

        item_attrs = load_item_attrs(cfg["attrs_files"])
        base = build_graph_base(train, pool_full, item_attrs)  # без decay (E1)
        ppr_r, _ = tripartite_rankings(base, base["per_user"],
                                       pool_full, rank_pop, val_users, BEST_AW)
        als_r = als_rankings(train, val_users, pool_full, rank_pop)
        pop_rank = {u: list(pool_full) for u in val_users}

        M_pop = rank_matrix(pop_rank, val_users, pool_full)
        M_ppr = rank_matrix(ppr_r, val_users, pool_full)
        M_als = rank_matrix(als_r, val_users, pool_full)
        order = fuse_weighted_top5([M_pop, M_ppr, M_als], W, K_RRF)
        preds = {u: [pool_full[j] for j in order[i]] for i, u in enumerate(val_users)}
        m, n = evaluate(preds, relevant)
        m_ppr, _ = evaluate({u: ppr_r[u][:5] for u in val_users}, relevant)
        acc[split_name] = m
        print(f"[{split_name}] fusion k={K_RRF} w={W} + PPR E1 (без decay): "
              f"MAP@5={m:.4f} (n={n}), PPR отдельно={m_ppr:.4f}, "
              f"time={time.perf_counter() - t0:.1f}s")

    df = pd.DataFrame([{
        "variant": "E3-fusion k=20 w=(1,2,1) + PPR E1 (без decay)",
        "params": f"attr_weight={BEST_AW}; decay=none; restart={RESTART}; "
                  f"w_pop={W[0]}; w_ppr={W[1]}; w_als={W[2]}; k_rrf={K_RRF}; n_iter={N_ITER}",
        "MAP5_main": acc["main"], "MAP5_early": acc["early"],
        "MAP5_mean": (acc["main"] + acc["early"]) / 2,
        "time_s": None, "seed": SEED,
    }])
    out = RESULTS / "exp3_e3_ppr_e1.csv"
    df.to_csv(out, index=False)
    print(f"\n[saved] {out}")
    print(df.to_string(index=False))
    return df


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""exp3: 5-й (последний) сабмит раунда — fusion k=20 w=(1,2,1) + PPR E1 без decay.

"""
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "artifacts" / "scripts"))
from exp_rrf_hybrid import DATA, POOL, SEED, rank_list_from_scores, als_rankings
from exp3_e1_attr_ppr import load_item_attrs, build_graph_base
from exp3_e3_rrf_weights import tripartite_rankings, rank_matrix, fuse_weighted_top5
from exp3_submit import check_format

BEST_AW = 0.5
W = (1.0, 2.0, 1.0)
K_RRF = 20
MAX_WEEK = 30


def main():
    inter = pd.read_parquet(DATA / "user_interactions.parquet")
    inter["user_id"] = inter["user_id"].astype(str)
    train = inter[inter["week"] <= MAX_WEEK]
    sub = pd.read_csv(DATA / "submission.csv", dtype={"user_id": str})
    test_users = sub["user_id"].tolist()

    sched42 = pd.read_csv(DATA / "export_arh_31-42-final.csv", low_memory=False)
    candidates = sched42[sched42["tv_show_id"] != 0]["tv_show_id"].unique()
    candidates_set = set(int(c) for c in candidates)
    airings = sched42[sched42["tv_show_id"] != 0]["tv_show_id"].value_counts().to_dict()
    pop_recent = train[train["week"] >= MAX_WEEK - 3].groupby("tv_show_id")["user_id"].nunique()
    score_b = {c: pop_recent.get(c, 0) * np.log1p(airings.get(c, 0)) for c in candidates}
    pool_full = rank_list_from_scores(score_b, score_b, k=POOL)
    rank_pop = {it: r for r, it in enumerate(pool_full)}
    print(f"[pool] топ-{len(pool_full)}; train<= {MAX_WEEK}")

    item_attrs = load_item_attrs([DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv",
                                  DATA / "export_arh_21-30-final.csv",
                                  DATA / "export_arh_31-42-final.csv"])
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    base = build_graph_base(train, pool_full, item_attrs)  # без decay (E1)
    ppr_r, _ = tripartite_rankings(base, base["per_user"],
                                   pool_full, rank_pop, test_users, BEST_AW)
    print(f"[PPR E1 aw={BEST_AW} без decay] {time.perf_counter() - t0:.1f}s")
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    als_r = als_rankings(train, test_users, pool_full, rank_pop)
    print(f"[ALS f=64] {time.perf_counter() - t0:.1f}s")

    M_pop = rank_matrix({u: list(pool_full) for u in test_users}, test_users, pool_full)
    M_ppr = rank_matrix(ppr_r, test_users, pool_full)
    M_als = rank_matrix(als_r, test_users, pool_full)
    order = fuse_weighted_top5([M_pop, M_ppr, M_als], W, K_RRF)
    preds = {u: [pool_full[j] for j in order[i]] for i, u in enumerate(test_users)}
