messages.summary:
## Objective
- Raise Kaggle public MAP@5 for `sweettv-tv-program-recommender` above the previous best, honestly and reproducibly, while writing exam report deliverables (§4–§9) by deadline 24 Oct 2026 19:00 MSK.
- Executing improvement round "exp3" (user's full work order): experiments E1–E4 (tripartite-graph PPR, time decay, weighted RRF, airing-boost) with ≤5 Kaggle submissions; round submissions are now exhausted (5/5) and the final round summary + final decision remain to be written out.

## Requirements
- Step 0 (DONE): final = `submission_rrf2_a_ppr05_als.csv` (public 0.32691 / private 0.31441) copied to root `submission.csv`, README updated, committed as `f326c13`. New rule: change final only if better on BOTH public AND private.
- Kaggle report deliverables per `exam_quiz_GSB.md`: §4 (≥2 methods + popularity baseline), §5 (join rule, thresholds, validation, pool, fallback, hyperparams/seed/runtime), §6 final strategy, §7 two-user examples, §8 business analysis, §9 PDF+AI-session export.
- MAP@5 = AP / min(n_relevant, 5). Validation: strict relevance (summed overlap ≥50% of show's max duration in val window); two splits: main (train≤20, val 21–30), early (train≤16, val 17–20); candidate pool = labelled schedule programmes of val window (final: `export_arh_31-42-final.csv`); repeats allowed; cold-start fallback = popularity.
- Join: channel match + interval overlap, ≥300s OR ≥50% duration; `tv_show_id=0` excluded; `user_id` read as string everywhere.
- exp3 hard rules: no fabricated numbers (only real code output); never overwrite existing results/submissions — new files use prefix `exp3_`; weeks 31–42 view data never used (schedule 31–42 only for programme–channel–genre links and airing counts); work solo, no subagents; max 5 submissions this round — now used up, so stop and output the final summary table; user's verbatim trailing line: "если паблик меньше 0.49 не публикуй" (ambiguity — see Decisions).
- Every variant pre-checked locally on both splits before submitting; decisions by Kaggle.
- Submissions: training 11–30, same top-500 pool (pop×log(1+airings 31-42)), template format (1260 rows, 5 unique ids, all from schedule 31–42), format-check script before sending (all exp3 files passed).
- exp3 experiment stages each → `results/tables/exp3_*.csv` with columns variant, params, MAP@5 main/early/mean, time, seed (all done).

## Decisions
- `user_id` must be string everywhere; vsetv_id ≡ channel_id.
- Local validation systematically overestimates pure history-repeat/personalization and poorly predicts fusion effects — decisions by Kaggle, but every variant pre-checked locally on both splits.
- New final rule: better on BOTH public and private.
- E1 winning variant: attr_weight=0.5 (mean 0.5035 vs control 0.4955); control aw=0 exactly reproduces bipartite PPR (0.533331/0.457684) — implementation verified.
- E2 winning variant: decay_tau=8, restart=raw (mean 0.5039); decay inside restart vector hurts (tau=4 decayed: 0.5282/0.4684).
- E3 winning grid point: w_pop=1, w_ppr=2, w_als=1, k=20 (0.5357/0.4626); all fusion combos locally worse than pure PPR_best (0.5433/0.4645) — known local-vs-Kaggle sign disagreement for fusion.
- E4 (PPR×(1+airings)^a) FAILED local filter vs current-final control 0.5015/0.4318 (best a=0.25 solo: 0.4492/0.3857) → not submitted (rule: only locally non-worse variants).
- 5th discretionary submission = E3-fusion (k=20, w=(1,2,1)) with PPR E1 (no decay), justified by Kaggle E1 (0.32306) > E2 (0.32261); local 0.5365/0.4632 passes filter.
- Candidate new final: `submission_exp3_e3b.csv` (0.34487/0.32361) beats 0.32691/0.31441 on both → qualifies under the both-metrics rule; BUT user's trailing "если паблик меньше 0.49 не публикуй" (0.34487 < 0.49) conflicts — user previously said "Порог 0.49 был ошибкой", then repeated the 0.49 line in this work order; ambiguity unresolved, needs user confirmation before designating/publishing final.

- **E2**: временной decay весов `exp(-Δ/τ)`, `τ ∈ {4, 8}`, два варианта restart.
- **E3**: взвешенный RRF `score = Σ w_c/(k+rank_c)`, сетка 54 комбинации.
- **E4**: буст по числу эфиров поверх PPR `PPR × (1+airings)^a`, `a ∈ {0.25, 0.5}`.

## Жёсткие правила раунда

def main():
    cells = []
    for kind, src in CELLS:
        cell = {"cell_type": "markdown" if kind == "md" else "code",
                "metadata": {}, "source": src.splitlines(keepends=True)}
        if kind == "md":
            cells.append(cell)
            continue
        buf = io.StringIO()
        exec_globals = {"__name__": "__main__"}
        try:
            with redirect_stdout(buf):
                exec(compile(src, "<cell>", "exec"), exec_globals)
            status = "ok"
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — фиксируем в ноутбуке
            buf.write(f"\n[ERROR] {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
            status = "error"
        text = buf.getvalue()
        cell["execution_count"] = None
        cell["outputs"] = [{"output_type": "stream", "name": "stdout",
                            "text": text.splitlines(keepends=True)}]
        cell["metadata"] = {"execution_status": status}
        cells.append(cell)

    nb = {
        "cells": cells,
        "metadata": {
            "kernelspec": {"display_name": "Python 3", "language": "python", "name": "python3"},
            "language_info": {"name": "python", "version": sys.version.split()[0]},
            "exp3": {"seed": 42, "date": "2026-10-23",
                     "winner": "submission_exp3_e3b.csv 0.34487/0.32361"},
        },
        "nbformat": 4,
        "nbformat_minor": 5,
    }
    out = ROOT / "experiments" / f"{datetime.now():%Y-%m-%d-%H%M}-exp3-round.ipynb"
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(json.dumps(nb, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"[saved] {out} ({out.stat().st_size} bytes, {len(cells)} cells)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def ppr_tripartite(T, restart_mat, n_iter=N_ITER):
    """P = alpha*(T^T P) + (1-alpha)*restart; alpha = 1 − RESTART.
    restart_mat (n_nodes×B): ненулевой только блок программ (или нули для cold)."""
    alpha = 1.0 - RESTART
    Tt = T.T.tocsr()
    P = restart_mat.copy()
    for _ in range(n_iter):
        P = alpha * (Tt @ P) + (1.0 - alpha) * restart_mat
    return P

68: def rank_list_from_scores(cand_scores, tie_rank, k=POOL):
69:     """cand_scores: dict item->score. Возвращает список item (длина <=k) -- ранжирование (0=best)."""
70:     items = list(cand_scores.keys())
71:     scores = np.array([cand_scores[i] for i in items])
72:     order = sorted(range(len(items)), key=lambda i: (-scores[i], tie_rank.get(items[i], 10**9)))
73:     return [items[o] for o in order[:k]]

89: # --------------------- PPR (персонализированный, batch, по exp_ppr.py) ---------------------
90: def row_normalize(mat: csr_matrix) -> csr_matrix:
91:     row_sums = np.asarray(mat.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
92:     inv = np.zeros_like(row_sums)
93:     nz = row_sums > 0
94:     inv[nz] = 1.0 / row_sums[nz]
95:     d = csr_matrix((inv, (np.arange(len(inv)), np.arange(len(inv)))), shape=(len(inv), len(inv)))
96:     return d @ mat
97:

99: def build_ppr_graph(train):
100:     agg = train.groupby(["user_id", "tv_show_id"])["overlap_seconds"].sum().reset_index()
101:     agg["weight"] = np.log1p(agg["overlap_seconds"])
102:     graph_users = agg["user_id"].unique()
103:     graph_items = agg["tv_show_id"].unique()
104:     u_map = {u: i for i, u in enumerate(graph_users)}
105:     i_map = {it: i for i, it in enumerate(graph_items)}
106:     rows = agg["user_id"].map(u_map).values
107:     cols = agg["tv_show_id"].map(i_map).values
108:     R = csr_matrix((agg["weight"].values, (rows, cols)), shape=(len(u_map), len(i_map)))
109:     Mu2i = row_normalize(R)
110:     Mi2u = row_normalize(R.T.tocsr())
111:     return u_map, i_map, Mu2i, Mi2u
112: 
113: 
114: def ppr_batch(Mu2i, Mi2u, Vu, Vi, alpha=0.85, n_iter=30):
115:     Pu = Vu.copy()
116:     Pi = Vi.copy()
117:     Mu2iT = Mu2i.T.tocsr()
118:     Mi2uT = Mi2u.T.tocsr()
119:     for _ in range(n_iter):
120:         Pi = alpha * (Mu2iT @ Pu) + (1 - alpha) * Vi
121:         Pu = alpha * (Mi2uT @ Pi) + (1 - alpha) * Vu
122:     return Pu, Pi
123: 
124: 
125: def ppr_rankings(train, val_users, pool, rank_pop):
126:     u_map, i_map, Mu2i, Mi2u = build_ppr_graph(train)
127:     warm_users = [u for u in val_users if u in u_map]
128:     cold = set(u for u in val_users if u not in u_map)
129:     pool_idx = np.array([i_map[c] for c in pool if c in i_map])
130:     pool_known = [c for c in pool if c in i_map]
131:     B = len(warm_users)
132:     Vu = np.zeros((len(u_map), B))
133:     Vi = np.zeros((len(i_map), B))
134:     for b, u in enumerate(warm_users):
135:         Vi[:, b] = Mu2i[u_map[u], :].toarray().ravel()
136:     Pu, Pi = ppr_batch(Mu2i, Mi2u, Vu, Vi)
137:     scores_pool = Pi[pool_idx, :]  # (n_pool_known, B)
138:     rankings = {}
139:     for b, u in enumerate(warm_users):
140:         sc = dict(zip(pool_known, scores_pool[:, b]))
141:         # кандидаты вне PPR-графа получают минимальный балл (ранг в хвосте)
142:         min_sc = min(sc.values()) - 1.0 if sc else 0.0
143:         for c in pool:
144:             if c not in sc:
145:                 sc[c] = min_sc
146:         rankings[u] = rank_list_from_scores(sc, rank_pop, k=POOL)
147:     for u in cold:
148:         rankings[u] = list(pool)  # rank_pop порядок, пул уже по убыванию pop×airings
149:     return rankings

152: # --------------------- AR (association rules, по exp_assoc_rules.py) ---------------------
153: def ar_rankings(train, val_users, candidates, rank_pop, max_week):
154:     g = train[train["overlap_seconds"] > 0].groupby(["user_id", "week"])["tv_show_id"].apply(lambda s: frozenset(s.unique()))
155:     txns = [s for s in g.values if len(s) >= 1]
156:     n_txn = len(txns)
157:     item_count = defaultdict(int)
158:     pair_count = defaultdict(int)
159:     for txn in txns:
160:         for a in txn:
161:             item_count[a] += 1
162:         items = sorted(txn)
163:         for a, b in combinations(items, 2):
164:             pair_count[(a, b)] += 1
165:     freq = {}
166:     for pair, cnt in pair_count.items():
167:         sup = cnt / n_txn
168:         if sup >= MIN_SUPPORT:
169:             freq[pair] = (cnt, sup)
170:     rules_by_ant = defaultdict(list)
171:     for (a, b), (cnt_ab, _) in freq.items():
172:         cnt_a, cnt_b = item_count.get(a, 0), item_count.get(b, 0)
173:         if cnt_a == 0 or cnt_b == 0:
174:             continue
175:         conf_ab = cnt_ab / cnt_a
176:         lift_ab = conf_ab / (cnt_b / n_txn)
177:         if lift_ab > 1:
178:             rules_by_ant[a].append((b, conf_ab))
179:         conf_ba = cnt_ab / cnt_b
180:         lift_ba = conf_ba / (cnt_a / n_txn)
181:         if lift_ba > 1:
182:             rules_by_ant[b].append((a, conf_ba))
183: 
184:     recent4w = train[(train["week"] >= max_week - 3) & (train["overlap_seconds"] > 0)]
185:     user_recent_items = recent4w.groupby("user_id")["tv_show_id"].apply(lambda s: set(s.unique()))
186: 
187:     rankings = {}
188:     cand_set = set(candidates)
189:     for u in val_users:
190:         A_set = user_recent_items.get(u, set())
191:         if not A_set:
192:             rankings[u] = list(candidates[:POOL])
193:             continue
194:         score = defaultdict(float)
195:         for a in A_set:
196:             for c, conf in rules_by_ant.get(a, []):
197:                 if c in cand_set:
198:                     score[c] += conf
199:         if not score:
200:             rankings[u] = list(candidates[:POOL])
201:             continue
202:         rankings[u] = rank_list_from_scores(dict(score), rank_pop, k=POOL)
203:     return rankings

206: # --------------------- ALS (по hybrid_final_submit.py) ---------------------
207: def als_rankings(train, val_users, pool, rank_pop):
208:     train_items = train["tv_show_id"].unique()
209:     train_users = train["user_id"].unique()
210:     u_map = {u: i for i, u in enumerate(train_users)}
211:     i_map = {it: i for i, it in enumerate(train_items)}
212:     rows_u = train["user_id"].map(u_map).values
213:     cols_i = train["tv_show_id"].map(i_map).values
214:     data = np.log1p(train["overlap_seconds"].values)
215:     mat = csr_matrix((data, (rows_u, cols_i)), shape=(len(u_map), len(i_map)))
216:     als = AlternatingLeastSquares(factors=64, regularization=0.05, iterations=20, random_state=SEED)
217:     als.fit(mat)
218:     pool_known = [c for c in pool if c in i_map]
219:     pool_idx = np.array([i_map[c] for c in pool_known])
220:     pool_factors = als.item_factors[pool_idx] if len(pool_idx) else np.zeros((0, 64))
221:     rankings = {}
222:     cold = []
223:     for u in val_users:
224:         if u not in u_map or len(pool_known) == 0:
225:             cold.append(u)
226:             continue
227:         uf = als.user_factors[u_map[u]]
228:         scores = pool_factors @ uf
229:         sc = dict(zip(pool_known, scores))
230:         min_sc = min(sc.values()) - 1.0
231:         for c in pool:
232:             if c not in sc:
233:                 sc[c] = min_sc
234:         rankings[u] = rank_list_from_scores(sc, rank_pop, k=POOL)
235:     for u in cold:
236:         rankings[u] = list(pool)
237:     return rankings

265:             if t not in vocab:
266:                 vocab[t] = len(vocab)

269:         vec = np.zeros(len(vocab))
270:         for t in toks:
271:             vec[vocab[t]] = 1.0
272:         item_mat[sid] = vec

295: def cbf_rankings(train, val_users, pool, rank_pop, max_week, candidates):
296:     pop_train = train.groupby("tv_show_id")["user_id"].nunique()
297:     train_sched = load_train_schedule(max_week)
298:     item_mat, vocab = build_item_tokens(train_sched)
299:     V = len(vocab)
300:     slot_pop, channel_pop, global_mean = build_slot_popularity(train, train_sched, pop_train)
301:     slot_max = float(slot_pop.max()) if len(slot_pop) else 1.0
302: 
303:     val_sched = pd.read_csv(DATA / ("export_arh_21-30-final.csv" if max_week == 20 else "export_arh_11-20-final.csv"), low_memory=False)
304:     val_sched_air = val_sched[val_sched["tv_show_id"] != 0].copy()
305:     val_sched_air["start_time"] = pd.to_datetime(val_sched_air["start_time"], dayfirst=True)
306:     val_sched_air["hour"] = val_sched_air["start_time"].dt.hour.astype(int)
307:     val_sched_air["day_of_week"] = val_sched_air["start_time"].dt.day_of_week.astype(int)
308:     val_sched_air["slot_raw"] = val_sched_air.apply(
309:         lambda r: lookup_slot_pop(r, slot_pop, channel_pop, global_mean), axis=1)
310:     new_slot_norm = {}
311:     for sid, g in val_sched_air.groupby("tv_show_id")["slot_raw"]:
312:         new_slot_norm[sid] = float(g.mean()) / slot_max if slot_max > 0 else 0.0
313: 
314:     all_vec_cands = [c for c in candidates if c in item_mat]
315:     known_cands = [c for c in all_vec_cands if c in pop_train.index]
316:     known_mat = np.stack([item_mat[c] for c in known_cands]) if known_cands else np.zeros((0, V))
317:     known_norm = np.linalg.norm(known_mat, axis=1); known_norm[known_norm == 0] = 1.0
318:     all_mat = np.stack([item_mat[c] for c in all_vec_cands]) if all_vec_cands else np.zeros((0, V))
319:     all_card = all_mat.sum(axis=1) if all_mat.size else np.array([]); all_card[all_card == 0] = 1.0
320:     all_slot_vec = np.array([new_slot_norm.get(c, 0.0) for c in all_vec_cands])
321: 
322:     agg = train.groupby(["user_id", "tv_show_id"])["overlap_seconds"].sum().reset_index()
323:     agg["weight"] = np.log1p(agg["overlap_seconds"])
324:     agg = agg[agg["tv_show_id"].isin(item_mat)]
325:     warm_users = [u for u in val_users if u in set(train["user_id"].unique())]
326:     cold_users = [u for u in val_users if u not in set(train["user_id"].unique())]
327:     user_idx = {u: i for i, u in enumerate(warm_users)}
328:     profile = np.zeros((len(warm_users), V))
329:     for (u, sid), w in zip(zip(agg["user_id"], agg["tv_show_id"]), agg["weight"]):
330:         ui = user_idx.get(u)
331:         if ui is not None:
332:             profile[ui] += w * item_mat[sid]
333:     prof_norm = np.linalg.norm(profile, axis=1); prof_norm[prof_norm == 0] = 1.0
334:     pmax = profile.max(axis=1, keepdims=True); pmax[pmax == 0] = 1.0
335:     prof_unit = profile / pmax
336: 
337:     user_train_items = train.groupby("user_id")["tv_show_id"].apply(set).to_dict()
338:     all_vec_idx = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(all_vec_cands)}
339: 
340:     rankings = {}
341:     pool_known = [c for c in pool if c in pop_train.index and c in item_mat]
342:     known_mat_pool = np.stack([item_mat[c] for c in pool_known]) if pool_known else np.zeros((0, V))
343:     known_norm_pool = np.linalg.norm(known_mat_pool, axis=1); known_norm_pool[known_norm_pool == 0] = 1.0
344:     pool_all_vec = [c for c in pool if c in item_mat]
345:     all_mat_pool = np.stack([item_mat[c] for c in pool_all_vec]) if pool_all_vec else np.zeros((0, V))
346:     all_card_pool = all_mat_pool.sum(axis=1) if all_mat_pool.size else np.array([]); all_card_pool[all_card_pool == 0] = 1.0
347:     all_slot_pool = np.array([new_slot_norm.get(c, 0.0) for c in pool_all_vec])
348: 
349:     for b, u in enumerate(warm_users):
350:         # известные (pool): косинус
351:         if pool_known:
352:             cos = (profile[b] @ known_mat_pool.T) / (prof_norm[b] * known_norm_pool)
353:             known_scores = dict(zip(pool_known, cos))
354:         else:
355:             known_scores = {}
356:         # cold (в пуле, без просмотров этим пользователем): Jaccard*slotpop
357:         cold_pool = [c for c in pool_all_vec if c not in user_train_items.get(u, set())]
358:         cold_scores = {}
359:         if cold_pool:
360:             cold_idx = np.array([pool_all_vec.index(c) for c in cold_pool])
361:             jac_num = prof_unit[b] @ all_mat_pool[cold_idx].T
362:             jac = jac_num / all_card_pool[cold_idx]
363:             cold_scores = dict(zip(cold_pool, jac * all_slot_pool[cold_idx]))
364:         # два страта: сначала известные по косинусу, затем cold (как в exp_cbf_hw2.py)
365:         if known_scores:
366:             top_known = rank_list_from_scores(known_scores, rank_pop, k=POOL)
367:         else:
368:             top_known = []
369:         if cold_scores:
370:             top_cold = rank_list_from_scores(cold_scores, rank_pop, k=POOL)
371:         else:
372:             top_cold = []
373:         merged = top_known[:]
374:         for c in top_cold:
375:             if len(merged) >= POOL:
376:                 break
377:             if c not in merged:
378:                 merged.append(c)
379:         for c in pool:
380:             if len(merged) >= POOL:
381:                 break
382:             if c not in merged:
383:                 merged.append(c)
384:         rankings[u] = merged[:POOL]
385:     for u in cold_users:
386:         rankings[u] = list(pool[:POOL])
387:     return rankings

390: # --------------------- RRF fusion + greedy ablation ---------------------
391: def fuse_rrf(rankings_by_component, selected, pool, weights=None, k=5):
392:     """rankings_by_component: {name: {user: [items ranked, 0=best]}}. selected: list of component names.
393:     RRF score(item) = sum 1/(RRF_K + rank). weights: необязательный dict name->float (по умолчанию 1)."""
394:     preds = {}
395:     users = set()
396:     for name in selected:
397:         users.update(rankings_by_component[name].keys())
398:     for u in users:
399:         sc = defaultdict(float)
400:         for name in selected:
401:             rank_list = rankings_by_component[name].get(u, [])
402:             wgt = 1.0 if weights is None else weights.get(name, 1.0)
403:             for r, item in enumerate(rank_list[:POOL]):
404:                 sc[item] += wgt / (RRF_K + r)
405:         if not sc:
406:             preds[u] = list(pool[:k])
407:             continue
408:         items = list(sc.keys())
409:         scores = np.array([sc[i] for i in items])
410:         order = sorted(range(len(items)), key=lambda i: -scores[i])
411:         preds[u] = [items[o] for o in order[:k]]
412:     return preds
413: 
414: 
415: def greedy_ablation(rankings_by_component, base_name, other_names, relevant, val_users):
416:     """Forward greedy: начинаем с base_name, по одному пробуем добавить каждый из other_names,
417:     оставляем компонент с лучшим MAP@5, повторяем, пока прирост есть."""
418:     selected = [base_name]
419:     log = []
420:     cur_map, _ = evaluate(fuse_rrf(rankings_by_component, selected, [], k=5), relevant)
421:     log.append((tuple(selected), cur_map))
422:     while True:
423:         best_gain = 0.0
424:         best_comp = None
425:         best_map = cur_map
426:         for comp in other_names:
427:             if comp in selected:
428:                 continue
429:             trial = selected + [comp]
430:             m, _ = evaluate(fuse_rrf(rankings_by_component, trial, [], k=5), relevant)
431:             if m - cur_map > best_gain:
432:                 best_gain = m - cur_map
433:                 best_comp = comp
434:                 best_map = m
435:         if best_comp is not None:
436:             selected.append(best_comp)
437:             cur_map = best_map
438:             log.append((tuple(selected), cur_map))
439:         else:
440:             break
441:     return selected, cur_map, log
442:

151: def build_transition(base, attr_weight):
152:     """T (csr, row-normalized): доля attr_weight из программы уходит в атрибуты,
153:     (1−attr_weight) — к пользователям. Нормировка ВНУТРИ групп ДО смешивания:
154:     item→user = (1−aw)·w/Σ_u w, item→attr = aw/|attrs(item)| (сумма ряда = 1,
155:     если оба типа рёбер есть). user→item = w (row_normalize), attr→item = 1
156:     (row_normalize -> равномерно). aw=0 даёт бипартитный граф бит-в-бит."""
157:     nU, nI, nA = base["nU"], base["nI"], base["nA"]
158:     n = nU + nI + nA
159:     I_off, A_off = nU, nU + nI
160:     eu, ei, ew = base["eu"], base["ei"], base["ew"]
161:     item_w_sum = np.bincount(ei, weights=ew, minlength=nI)
162:     safe_sum = np.where(item_w_sum > 0, item_w_sum, 1.0)
163:     rows = [eu, ei + I_off]
164:     cols = [ei + I_off, eu]
165:     data = [ew, (1.0 - attr_weight) * ew / safe_sum[ei]]
166:     counts = np.array([len(a) for a in base["per_item_attrs"]], dtype=np.int64)
167:     total = int(counts.sum())
168:     if total > 0:
169:         item_ids = np.repeat(np.arange(nI, dtype=np.int64), counts)
170:         attr_ids = np.concatenate([np.asarray(a, dtype=np.int64)
171:                                    for a in base["per_item_attrs"] if a])
172:         # item -> attr
173:         rows.append(item_ids + I_off)
174:         cols.append(attr_ids + A_off)
175:         data.append(np.full(total, attr_weight) / np.repeat(counts, counts))
176:         # attr -> item
177:         rows.append(attr_ids + A_off)
178:         cols.append(item_ids + I_off)
179:         data.append(np.ones(total))
180:     T = csr_matrix((np.concatenate(data),
181:                     (np.concatenate(rows), np.concatenate(cols))), shape=(n, n))
182:     return row_normalize(T)

185: def ppr_tripartite(T, restart_mat, n_iter=N_ITER, alpha=None):
186:     """P = alpha*(T^T P) + (1-alpha)*restart; alpha = 1 − RESTART (или заданный alpha)."""
187:     if alpha is None:
188:         alpha = 1.0 - RESTART
189:     Tt = T.T.tocsr()
190:     P = restart_mat.copy()
191:     for _ in range(n_iter):
192:         P = alpha * (Tt @ P) + (1.0 - alpha) * restart_mat
193:     return P

```python
def als_rankings_p(train, val_users, pool, rank_pop, factors=64, reg=0.05, iterations=20, k_pool=None):
    if k_pool is None:
        k_pool = len(pool)
    train_items = train["tv_show_id"].unique()
    train_users = train["user_id"].unique()
    u_map = {u: i for i, u in enumerate(train_users)}
    i_map = {it: i for i, it in enumerate(train_items)}
    rows_u = train["user_id"].map(u_map).values
    cols_i = train["tv_show_id"].map(i_map).values
    data = np.log1p(train["overlap_seconds"].values)
    mat = csr_matrix((data, (rows_u, cols_i)), shape=(len(u_map), len(i_map)))
    als = AlternatingLeastSquares(factors=factors, regularization=reg, iterations=iterations, random_state=SEED)
    als.fit(mat)
    pool_known = [c for c in pool if c in i_map]
    pool_idx = np.array([i_map[c] for c in pool_known])
    pool_factors = als.item_factors[pool_idx] if len(pool_idx) else np.zeros((0, factors))
    rankings = {}
    cold = []
    for u in val_users:
        if u not in u_map or len(pool_known) == 0:
            cold.append(u)
            continue
        uf = als.user_factors[u_map[u]]
        scores = pool_factors @ uf
        sc = dict(zip(pool_known, scores))
        min_sc = min(sc.values()) - 1.0
        for c in pool:
            if c not in sc:
                sc[c] = min_sc
        rankings[u] = rank_list_from_scores(sc, rank_pop, k=k_pool)
    for u in cold:
        rankings[u] = list(pool)
    return rankings
```

def prepare_split(inter, sub_users, cfg, pool_size=POOL):
    train, val_sched, candidates, relevant, val_users = build_split(
        inter, sub_users, cfg["train_end_week"], cfg["val_start_week"],
        cfg["val_end_week"], cfg["sched_val_path"])
    max_week = cfg["max_week"]

    pool_full = rank_list_from_scores(score_b, score_b, k=pool_size)
    rank_pop = {it: r for r, it in enumerate(pool_full)}
    return train, pool_full, rank_pop, relevant, val_users

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Общие утилиты раунда exp4: параметризованный ALS, подготовка сплита/пула.

E5 требует перебора factors/reg/iterations — исходный als_rankings из
exp_rrf_hybrid.py зашит константами (64/0.05/20), поэтому здесь своя версия
als_rankings_p с параметрами и k-пуля из len(pool) (для E8 с更大的 пулом).

Никакие прежние таблицы не перезаписываются; выходные файлы раунда —
results/tables/exp4_*.csv.
"""
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
from implicit.als import AlternatingLeastSquares

from exp_rrf_hybrid import (
    DATA, SEED, evaluate, build_split, rank_list_from_scores,
)


def als_rankings_p(train, val_users, pool, rank_pop, factors=64, reg=0.05,
                   iterations=20):
    """Как exp_rrf_hybrid.als_rankings, но factors/reg/iterations — параметры;
    длина ранжирования = len(pool) (не константа POOL)."""
    train_items = train["tv_show_id"].unique()
    train_users = train["user_id"].unique()
    u_map = {u: i for i, u in enumerate(train_users)}
    i_map = {it: i for i, it in enumerate(train_items)}
    rows_u = train["user_id"].map(u_map).values
    cols_i = train["tv_show_id"].map(i_map).values
    data = np.log1p(train["overlap_seconds"].values)
    mat = csr_matrix((data, (rows_u, cols_i)), shape=(len(u_map), len(i_map)))
    als = AlternatingLeastSquares(factors=factors, regularization=reg,
                                  iterations=iterations, random_state=SEED)
    als.fit(mat)
    pool_known = [c for c in pool if c in i_map]
    pool_idx = np.array([i_map[c] for c in pool_known])
    pool_factors = als.item_factors[pool_idx] if len(pool_idx) else np.zeros((0, factors))
    rankings = {}
    cold = []
    k = len(pool)
    for u in val_users:
        if u not in u_map or len(pool_known) == 0:
            cold.append(u)
            continue
        uf = als.user_factors[u_map[u]]
        scores = pool_factors @ uf
        sc = dict(zip(pool_known, scores))
        min_sc = min(sc.values()) - 1.0
        for c in pool:
            if c not in sc:
                sc[c] = min_sc
        rankings[u] = rank_list_from_scores(sc, rank_pop, k=k)
    for u in cold:
        rankings[u] = list(pool)
    return rankings


def prepare_split(inter, sub_users, cfg, pool_size=500):
    """(train, val_sched, candidates, relevant, val_users, pool_full, rank_pop)."""
    train, val_sched, candidates, relevant, val_users = build_split(
        inter, sub_users, cfg["train_end_week"], cfg["val_start_week"],
        cfg["val_end_week"], cfg["sched_val_path"])
    max_week = cfg["max_week"]
    airings = pd.read_csv(DATA / cfg["airings_file"], low_memory=False)
    airings = airings[airings["tv_show_id"] != 0]["tv_show_id"].value_counts().to_dict()
    pop_recent = train[train["week"] >= max_week - 3].groupby("tv_show_id")["user_id"].nunique()
    score_b = {c: pop_recent.get(c, 0) * np.log1p(airings.get(c, 0)) for c in candidates}
    pool_full = rank_list_from_scores(score_b, score_b, k=pool_size)
    rank_pop = {it: r for r, it in enumerate(pool_full)}
    return train, val_sched, candidates, relevant, val_users, pool_full, rank_pop


SPLITS = {
    "main": dict(train_end_week=20, val_start_week=21, val_end_week=30,
                 sched_val_path=DATA / "export_arh_21-30-final.csv", max_week=20,
                 airings_file="export_arh_21-30-final.csv",
                 attrs_files=[DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv",
                              DATA / "export_arh_21-30-final.csv"]),
    "early": dict(train_end_week=16, val_start_week=17, val_end_week=20,
                  sched_val_path=DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv", max_week=16,
                  airings_file="export_arh_11-20-final.csv",
                  attrs_files=[DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv"]),
}


def load_inter():
    inter = pd.read_parquet(DATA / "user_interactions.parquet")
    inter["user_id"] = inter["user_id"].astype(str)
    sub = pd.read_csv(DATA / "submission.csv", dtype={"user_id": str})
    return inter, sub["user_id"].tolist()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""E5 (exp4): сетка гиперпараметров ALS — «больше эпох».

Текущий ALS (64 factors, reg=0.05, 20 итераций) — самый слабый компонент
(отдельно 0.1399/0.0919), но он входит в Kaggle-победителя exp3_e3b
(RRF k=20 w=(1,2,1) + PPR E1 aw=0.5 без decay). Идея: больше итераций /
факторов может усилить ALS-вклад в fusion.

Сетка: iterations ∈ {20,40,80,160} × factors ∈ {64,128} при reg=0.05
(8 конфигураций) + проба reg ∈ {0.01,0.2} при iterations=40, factors=64.
Для каждого конфига: ALS отдельно MAP@5 и внутри fusion k=20 w=(1,2,1)
с фиксированным PPR E1 (aw=0.5, без decay) на обоих сплитах.

Таблица: results/tables/exp4_als.csv.
"""
import time

import pandas as pd

from exp_rrf_hybrid import RESULTS, SEED
from exp3_e1_attr_ppr import load_item_attrs, build_graph_base
from exp3_e3_rrf_weights import tripartite_rankings, rank_matrix, fuse_weighted_top5
from exp4_common import (
    SPLITS, load_inter, prepare_split, als_rankings_p,
)
from exp_rrf_hybrid import evaluate

BEST_AW = 0.5   # E1
W = (1.0, 2.0, 1.0)
K_RRF = 20

EPOCH_GRID = [(f, it, 0.05) for f in (64, 128) for it in (20, 40, 80, 160)]
REG_GRID = [(64, 40, 0.01), (64, 40, 0.2)]  # проба регуляризации
GRID = EPOCH_GRID + REG_GRID


def main():
    inter, sub_users = load_inter()
    acc = {(f, it, r): dict(MAP5_main=None, MAP5_early=None,
                            stand_main=None, stand_early=None, time_s=0.0)
           for f, it, r in GRID}

    for split_name, cfg in SPLITS.items():
        t_split = time.perf_counter()
        train, val_sched, candidates, relevant, val_users, pool_full, rank_pop = \
            prepare_split(inter, sub_users, cfg, pool_size=500)
        item_attrs = load_item_attrs(cfg["attrs_files"])
        base = build_graph_base(train, pool_full, item_attrs)  # без decay (E1)
        ppr_r, _ = tripartite_rankings(base, base["per_user"], pool_full, rank_pop,
                                       val_users, BEST_AW)
        M_pop = rank_matrix({u: list(pool_full) for u in val_users}, val_users, pool_full)
        M_ppr = rank_matrix(ppr_r, val_users, pool_full)
        print(f"[split {split_name}] pool={len(pool_full)}, val_users={len(val_users)}")

        for f, it, reg in GRID:
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            als_r = als_rankings_p(train, val_users, pool_full, rank_pop,
                                   factors=f, reg=reg, iterations=it)
            m_als, _ = evaluate({u: als_r[u][:5] for u in val_users}, relevant)
            M_als = rank_matrix(als_r, val_users, pool_full)
            order = fuse_weighted_top5([M_pop, M_ppr, M_als], W, K_RRF)
            preds = {u: [pool_full[j] for j in order[i]] for i, u in enumerate(val_users)}
            m_fus, _ = evaluate(preds, relevant)
            dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
            key = (f, it, reg)
            acc[key][f"MAP5_{split_name}"] = m_fus
            acc[key][f"stand_{split_name}"] = m_als
            acc[key]["time_s"] += dt

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""E6 (exp4): PPR-рефинемент — сетка restart × attr_weight + численная проверка сходимости.

Сетка: restart ∈ {0.3, 0.5, 0.7} × attr_weight ∈ {0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7}
(12 точек, оба сплита), PPR без decay (E1-конфигурация победителя).
Для каждого PPR: отдельно MAP@5 и внутри fusion k=20 w=(1,2,1) с ALS 64/0.05/20
(если E5 выявит лучший ALS — точка пересчитается в E7).

Численная проверка сходимости: alpha = 1 − restart; при alpha=0.5 сжатие
0.5^30 ≈ 9.3e-10, при alpha=0.7 (restart=0.3) — 0.7^30 ≈ 2.3e-5. Считаем
score-матрицы при n_iter=30 и n_iter=100, берём max|Δ| — при сходимости
разность на уровне численного шума, и больше итераций не меняют скоры.

Таблица: results/tables/exp4_ppr.csv.
"""
import time

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from exp_rrf_hybrid import RESULTS, SEED, evaluate
from exp3_e1_attr_ppr import RESTART, N_ITER, load_item_attrs, build_graph_base
from exp3_e3_rrf_weights import (
    tripartite_rankings, rank_matrix, fuse_weighted_top5,
)
from exp4_common import SPLITS, load_inter, prepare_split, als_rankings_p

RESTARTS = (0.3, 0.5, 0.7)
ATTR_WEIGHTS = (0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7)
W = (1.0, 2.0, 1.0)
K_RRF = 20
ALS_PARAMS = dict(factors=64, reg=0.05, iterations=20)


def main():
    inter, sub_users = load_inter()
    keys = [(r, aw) for r in RESTARTS for aw in ATTR_WEIGHTS]
    acc = {k: dict(MAP5_main=None, MAP5_early=None,
                   stand_main=None, stand_early=None, time_s=0.0) for k in keys}
    conv = []  # строки числовой проверки сходимости

    for split_name, cfg in SPLITS.items():
        t_split = time.perf_counter()
        train, val_sched, candidates, relevant, val_users, pool_full, rank_pop = \
            prepare_split(inter, sub_users, cfg, pool_size=500)
        item_attrs = load_item_attrs(cfg["attrs_files"])
        base = build_graph_base(train, pool_full, item_attrs)
        als_r = als_rankings_p(train, val_users, pool_full, rank_pop, **ALS_PARAMS)
        M_pop = rank_matrix({u: list(pool_full) for u in val_users}, val_users, pool_full)
        M_als = rank_matrix(als_r, val_users, pool_full)
        print(f"[split {split_name}] pool={len(pool_full)}, val_users={len(val_users)}")

        for restart in RESTARTS:
            alpha = 1.0 - restart
            for aw in ATTR_WEIGHTS:
                t0 = time.perf_counter()
                ppr_r, scores30 = tripartite_rankings(
                    base, base["per_user"], pool_full, rank_pop, val_users, aw,
                    alpha=alpha)
                # численная проверка: 100 итераций против 30
                nU = base["nU"]
                n_nodes = nU + base["nI"] + base["nA"]
                pool_local = np.array([base["i_map"][c] for c in pool_full])
                B = len(val_users)
                restart_mat = np.zeros((n_nodes, B))
                for b, u in enumerate(val_users):
                    ui = base["u_map"].get(u)
                    if ui is None:
                        continue
                    idxs, ws = base["per_user"][ui]
                    restart_mat[nU + idxs, b] = ws
                from exp3_e1_attr_ppr import build_transition, ppr_tripartite
                T = build_transition(base, aw)
                scores100 = ppr_tripartite(T, restart_mat, n_iter=100,
                                           alpha=alpha)[nU + pool_local, :]
                d_max = float(np.abs(scores30 - scores100).max())
                conv.append(dict(split=split_name, restart=restart, alpha=alpha,
                                 attr_weight=aw, n_iter_ref=30, n_iter_check=100,
                                 max_abs_score_diff=d_max,
                                 contraction_alpha_pow30=alpha ** 30))

                m_stand, _ = evaluate({u: ppr_r[u][:5] for u in val_users}, relevant)
                M_ppr = rank_matrix(ppr_r, val_users, pool_full)
                order = fuse_weighted_top5([M_pop, M_ppr, M_als], W, K_RRF)
                preds = {u: [pool_full[j] for j in order[i]]
                         for i, u in enumerate(val_users)}
                m_fus, _ = evaluate(preds, relevant)
                dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
                k = (restart, aw)
                acc[k][f"MAP5_{split_name}"] = m_fus
                acc[k][f"stand_{split_name}"] = m_stand
                acc[k]["time_s"] += dt
                print(f"  restart={restart} aw={aw}: PPR отдельно={m_stand:.4f}, "
                      f"fusion={m_fus:.4f}, max|Δ(30 vs 100 iter)|={d_max:.2e} ({dt:.1f}s)")
        print(f"  [split завершён за {time.perf_counter() - t_split:.1f}s]")

    rows = []
    for restart, aw in keys:
        a = acc[(restart, aw)]
        rows.append({
            "variant": f"E6 restart={restart} attr_weight={aw}",
            "params": (f"restart={restart}; alpha={1.0 - restart:.1f}; attr_weight={aw}; "
                       f"decay=none; n_iter={N_ITER}; fusion=k{K_RRF} w={W}; "
                       f"als=64/0.05/20"),
            "MAP5_main": a["MAP5_main"], "MAP5_early": a["MAP5_early"],
            "MAP5_mean": (a["MAP5_main"] + a["MAP5_early"]) / 2,
            "PPR_standalone_main": a["stand_main"], "PPR_standalone_early": a["stand_early"],
            "PPR_standalone_mean": (a["stand_main"] + a["stand_early"]) / 2,
            "time_s": round(a["time_s"], 1), "seed": SEED,
        })
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("MAP5_mean", ascending=False)
    RESULTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out = RESULTS / "exp4_ppr.csv"
    df.to_csv(out, index=False)
    out_conv = RESULTS / "exp4_ppr_convergence.csv"
    pd.DataFrame(conv).to_csv(out_conv, index=False)
    print(f"\n[saved] {out}")
    print(f"[saved] {out_conv}")
    print("\n=== E6: restart × attr_weight (сортировка по среднему fusion MAP@5) ===")
    print(df.to_string(index=False))
    conv_df = pd.DataFrame(conv)
    print("\n=== E6: численная проверка сходимости (n_iter=30 против 100) ===")
    print(conv_df.groupby("restart")["max_abs_score_diff"].agg(["max", "mean"])
          .to_string())
    return df, conv_df


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Таблица: results/tables/exp4_fusion.csv.

from exp_rrf_hybrid import RESULTS, SEED, evaluate

from exp3_e3_rrf_weights import tripartite_rankings, rank_matrix, fuse_weighted_top5
from exp4_common import SPLITS, load_inter, prepare_split, als_rankings_p

K_GRID = (10, 20, 40)
W_PPR = (1.5, 2.0, 3.0)
W_ALS = (0.5, 1.0)
W_POP = 1.0


def _best_als_params():
    """Лучшая ALS-конфигурация из exp4_als.csv (E5), исключая строку-референс."""
    df = pd.read_csv(RESULTS / "exp4_als.csv")
    grid = df[~df["variant"].str.startswith("референс")].sort_values(
        "MAP5_mean", ascending=False).iloc[0]
    import re
    m = re.search(r"f=(\d+) it=(\d+) reg=([\d.]+)", grid["variant"])
    return dict(factors=int(m.group(1)), iterations=int(m.group(2)),
                reg=float(m.group(3))), grid["variant"], grid["MAP5_mean"]


def _best_ppr_params():
    """Лучшая PPR-конфигурация из exp4_ppr.csv (E6)."""
    df = pd.read_csv(RESULTS / "exp4_ppr.csv")
    best = df.sort_values("MAP5_mean", ascending=False).iloc[0]
    m = pd.read_csv(RESULTS / "exp4_ppr.csv")  # parse из params
    import re
    pm = re.search(r"restart=([\d.]+); alpha=[\d.]+; attr_weight=([\d.]+)",
                   best["params"])
    return dict(restart=float(pm.group(1)), attr_weight=float(pm.group(2))), \
        best["variant"], best["MAP5_mean"]


def main():
    als_params, als_src, als_map = _best_als_params()
    ppr_params, ppr_src, ppr_map = _best_ppr_params()
    alpha = 1.0 - ppr_params["restart"]
    print(f"[E7] ALS из E5: {als_src} (MAP5_mean={als_map:.4f}) -> {als_params}")
    print(f"[E7] PPR из E6: {ppr_src} (MAP5_mean={ppr_map:.4f}) -> {ppr_params}")

    inter, sub_users = load_inter()
    keys = [(k, wp, wa) for k in K_GRID for wp in W_PPR for wa in W_ALS]
    acc = {key: dict(MAP5_main=None, MAP5_early=None, time_s=0.0) for key in keys}

    for split_name, cfg in SPLITS.items():
        t_split = time.perf_counter()
        train, val_sched, candidates, relevant, val_users, pool_full, rank_pop = \
            prepare_split(inter, sub_users, cfg, pool_size=500)
        item_attrs = load_item_attrs(cfg["attrs_files"])
        base = build_graph_base(train, pool_full, item_attrs)
        ppr_r, _ = tripartite_rankings(base, base["per_user"], pool_full, rank_pop,
                                       val_users, ppr_params["attr_weight"],
                                       alpha=alpha)
        als_r = als_rankings_p(train, val_users, pool_full, rank_pop, **als_params)
        M_pop = rank_matrix({u: list(pool_full) for u in val_users}, val_users, pool_full)
        M_ppr = rank_matrix(ppr_r, val_users, pool_full)
        M_als = rank_matrix(als_r, val_users, pool_full)
        print(f"[split {split_name}] pool={len(pool_full)}, val_users={len(val_users)}")

        for k_rrf in K_GRID:
            for w_ppr in W_PPR:
                for w_als in W_ALS:
                    t0 = time.perf_counter()
                    order = fuse_weighted_top5([M_pop, M_ppr, M_als],
                                               (W_POP, w_ppr, w_als), k_rrf)
                    preds = {u: [pool_full[j] for j in order[i]]
                             for i, u in enumerate(val_users)}
                    m, _ = evaluate(preds, relevant)
                    dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
                    key = (k_rrf, w_ppr, w_als)
                    acc[key][f"MAP5_{split_name}"] = m
                    acc[key]["time_s"] += dt
        print(f"  сетка {len(keys)} посчитана "
              f"({time.perf_counter() - t_split:.1f}s на сплит)")

    rows = []
    for k_rrf, w_ppr, w_als in keys:
        a = acc[(k_rrf, w_ppr, w_als)]
        is_ctrl = (k_rrf, w_ppr, w_als) == (20, 2.0, 1.0)
        rows.append({
            "variant": (f"E7 k={k_rrf} w_pop={W_POP} w_ppr={w_ppr} w_als={w_als}"
                        + (" (контроль: точка победителя exp3)" if is_ctrl else "")),
            "params": (f"k_rrf={k_rrf}; w_pop={W_POP}; w_ppr={w_ppr}; w_als={w_als}; "
                       f"ppr={ppr_src}; als={als_src}"),
            "MAP5_main": a["MAP5_main"], "MAP5_early": a["MAP5_early"],
            "MAP5_mean": (a["MAP5_main"] + a["MAP5_early"]) / 2,
            "time_s": round(a["time_s"], 3), "seed": SEED,
            "exp3_winner_point": is_ctrl,
        })
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("MAP5_mean", ascending=False)
    RESULTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out = RESULTS / "exp4_fusion.csv"
    df.to_csv(out, index=False)
    print(f"\n[saved] {out}")
    print("\n=== E7: fusion-доводка (топ-10 по среднему MAP@5) ===")
    print(df.head(10).to_string(index=False))
    return df


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""E8 (exp4): размер пула кандидатов — 500 против 1000 и 2000.

Гипотеза: за пределами топ-500 по pop×log(1+airings) есть релевантные
программы, которые fusion сейчас не видит (пул — жёсткая шапка списка
кандидатов всех компонентов). Считаем конфигурацию-победителя (лучшие ALS
из E5, PPR из E6, fusion из E7) при pool ∈ {500, 1000, 2000} на обоих сплитах.

Таблица: results/tables/exp4_pool.csv.
"""
import re
import time

import pandas as pd

from exp_rrf_hybrid import RESULTS, SEED, evaluate
from exp3_e1_attr_ppr import load_item_attrs, build_graph_base
from exp3_e3_rrf_weights import tripartite_rankings, rank_matrix, fuse_weighted_top5
from exp4_common import SPLITS, load_inter, prepare_split, als_rankings_p

POOL_SIZES = (500, 1000, 2000)


def _winners():
    """(als_params, ppr_params, fusion_params) из таблиц E5/E6/E7."""
    df_als = pd.read_csv(RESULTS / "exp4_als.csv")
    best_als = df_als[~df_als["variant"].str.startswith("референс")].sort_values(
        "MAP5_mean", ascending=False).iloc[0]
    m = re.search(r"f=(\d+) it=(\d+) reg=([\d.]+)", best_als["variant"])
    als_params = dict(factors=int(m.group(1)), iterations=int(m.group(2)),
                      reg=float(m.group(3)))

    df_ppr = pd.read_csv(RESULTS / "exp4_ppr.csv")
    best_ppr = df_ppr.sort_values("MAP5_mean", ascending=False).iloc[0]
    pm = re.search(r"restart=([\d.]+); alpha=[\d.]+; attr_weight=([\d.]+)",
                   best_ppr["params"])
    ppr_params = dict(restart=float(pm.group(1)),
                      attr_weight=float(pm.group(2)))

    df_fus = pd.read_csv(RESULTS / "exp4_fusion.csv")
    best_fus = df_fus.sort_values("MAP5_mean", ascending=False).iloc[0]
    fm = re.search(r"k_rrf=(\d+); w_pop=([\d.]+); w_ppr=([\d.]+); w_als=([\d.]+)",
                   best_fus["params"])
    fus_params = dict(k_rrf=int(fm.group(1)), w_pop=float(fm.group(2)),
                      w_ppr=float(fm.group(3)), w_als=float(fm.group(4)))
    return als_params, ppr_params, fus_params, \
        (best_als["variant"], best_ppr["variant"], best_fus["variant"])


def main():
    als_params, ppr_params, fus_params, srcs = _winners()
    alpha = 1.0 - ppr_params["restart"]
    print(f"[E8] ALS (E5): {srcs[0]} -> {als_params}")
    print(f"[E8] PPR (E6): {srcs[1]} -> {ppr_params}")
    print(f"[E8] fusion (E7): {srcs[2]} -> {fus_params}")

    inter, sub_users = load_inter()
    acc = {ps: dict(MAP5_main=None, MAP5_early=None, time_s=0.0) for ps in POOL_SIZES}

    for split_name, cfg in SPLITS.items():
        t_split = time.perf_counter()
        # prepare_split без пула: нужен один train/val для всех размеров пула
        train, val_sched, candidates, relevant, val_users, _, _ = \
            prepare_split(inter, sub_users, cfg, pool_size=500)
        item_attrs = load_item_attrs(cfg["attrs_files"])
        print(f"[split {split_name}] val_users={len(val_users)}")

        for ps in POOL_SIZES:
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            # пул: топ-ps по pop×airings (prepare_split при pool_size=ps)
            _, _, _, _, _, pool_full, rank_pop = \
                prepare_split(inter, sub_users, cfg, pool_size=ps)
            base = build_graph_base(train, pool_full, item_attrs)
            ppr_r, _ = tripartite_rankings(base, base["per_user"], pool_full,
                                           rank_pop, val_users,
                                           ppr_params["attr_weight"], alpha=alpha,
                                           k_pool=ps)
            als_r = als_rankings_p(train, val_users, pool_full, rank_pop,
                                   **als_params)
            M_pop = rank_matrix({u: list(pool_full) for u in val_users},
                                val_users, pool_full)
            M_ppr = rank_matrix(ppr_r, val_users, pool_full)
            M_als = rank_matrix(als_r, val_users, pool_full)
            order = fuse_weighted_top5([M_pop, M_ppr, M_als],
                                       (fus_params["w_pop"], fus_params["w_ppr"],
                                        fus_params["w_als"]), fus_params["k_rrf"])
            preds = {u: [pool_full[j] for j in order[i]]
                     for i, u in enumerate(val_users)}
            m, _ = evaluate(preds, relevant)
            dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
            acc[ps][f"MAP5_{split_name}"] = m
            acc[ps]["time_s"] += dt
            print(f"  pool={ps}: MAP@5={m:.4f} ({dt:.1f}s)")
        print(f"  [split завершён за {time.perf_counter() - t_split:.1f}s]")

    rows = []
    for ps in POOL_SIZES:
        a = acc[ps]
        rows.append({
            "variant": f"E8 pool={ps}",
            "params": (f"pool={ps}; ppr={ppr_params}; als={als_params}; "
                       f"fusion={fus_params}"),
            "MAP5_main": a["MAP5_main"], "MAP5_early": a["MAP5_early"],
            "MAP5_mean": (a["MAP5_main"] + a["MAP5_early"]) / 2,
            "time_s": round(a["time_s"], 1), "seed": SEED,
            "baseline_pool500": ps == 500,
        })
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("MAP5_mean", ascending=False)
    RESULTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out = RESULTS / "exp4_pool.csv"
    df.to_csv(out, index=False)
    print(f"\n[saved] {out}")
    print("\n=== E8: размер пула ===")
    print(df.to_string(index=False))
    return df


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Сборка ноутбука experiments/*-exp4-round.ipynb из реального выполнения ячеек.

Как build_exp3_notebook.py: каждый code-cell выполняется через exec с перенаправлением
stdout, вывод встраивается в ноутбук (capture-at-creation). Числа берутся из
таблиц results/tables/exp4_*.csv и логов Kaggle, никаких выдуманных значений.
"""
import io
import json
import sys
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

CELLS = [
    ("md", """# exp4 — раунд увеличения скора: больше эпох ALS, PPR-рефинемент, fusion-доводка, размер пула

**Дата:** 2026-10-23. **Seed:** 42 везде. **Контекст:** победитель exp3 —

  больше итераций/факторов усилит его вклад в fusion.

  `restart ∈ {0.3,0.5,0.7}`. Плюс численная проверка: при alpha=1−restart
  сжатие alpha^30, итераций 30 достаточно?
- **E7**: в окрестности победителя (k, w_ppr, w_als) есть близкая точка лучше.
- **E8**: пул топ-500 урезает кандидатов; 1000/2000 дадут рост recall.

## Метод
Оба сплита (main: train≤20/val21–30; early: train≤16/val17–20), строгая
релевантность, join = канал + overlap ≥300s или ≥50%. Локальный фильтр:
не хуже победителя exp3 (0.5365/0.4632) на обоих сплитах. Решения по Kaggle."""),
    ("code", """import pandas as pd
e5 = pd.read_csv("results/tables/exp4_als.csv")
print(e5.to_string(index=False))"""),
    ("md", """**E5 результат.** Таблица `exp4_als.csv`: ALS-гиперпараметры, fusion MAP@5
(к k=20 w=(1,2,1), PPR E1 фиксирован) и ALS отдельно на обоих сплитах."""),
    ("code", """e6 = pd.read_csv("results/tables/exp4_ppr.csv")
print(e6.to_string(index=False))"""),
    ("md", """**E6 результат.** Сетка restart × attr_weight + строка референса
(0.32306/0.29313 из exp3_e1.csv). Численная проверка сходимости —
`exp4_ppr_convergence.csv`: max|score(30 iter) − score(100 iter)|."""),
    ("code", """conv = pd.read_csv("results/tables/exp4_ppr_convergence.csv")
print(conv.groupby(["restart", "alpha"])["max_abs_score_diff"]

print("\\nalpha^30 (теоретическое сжатие):")
print(conv.groupby("restart")["contraction_alpha_pow30"].first().to_string())"""),
    ("md", """**Численная проверка сходимости.** Если max|Δ| на уровне 1e-9 при alpha=0.5
(теория: 0.5^30 ≈ 9.3e-10), то 30 итераций достаточно и увеличивать эпохи PPR

print(e8.to_string(index=False))"""),
    ("md", """**E8 результат.** Размер пула 500/1000/2000 с конфигурацией-победителем."""),
]


def main():
    cells = []
    shared = {"__name__": "__main__", "pd": __import__("pandas")}
    for kind, src in CELLS:
        cell = {"cell_type": "markdown" if kind == "md" else "code",
                "metadata": {}, "source": src.splitlines(keepends=True)}
        if kind == "md":
            cells.append(cell)
            continue
        buf = io.StringIO()
        try:
            with redirect_stdout(buf):
                exec(compile(src, "<cell>", "exec"), shared)
            status = "ok"
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — фиксируем в ноутбуке
            buf.write(f"\n[ERROR] {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
            status = "error"
        cell["execution_count"] = None
        cell["outputs"] = [{"output_type": "stream", "name": "stdout",
                            "text": buf.getvalue().splitlines(keepends=True)}]
        cell["metadata"] = {"execution_status": status}
        cells.append(cell)

    nb = {
        "cells": cells,
        "metadata": {
            "kernelspec": {"display_name": "Python 3", "language": "python",
                           "name": "python3"},
            "language_info": {"name": "python", "version": sys.version.split()[0]},

        "nbformat_minor": 5,
    }
    out = ROOT / "experiments" / f"{datetime.now():%Y-%m-%d-%H%M}-exp4-round.ipynb"
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(json.dumps(nb, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    bad = sum(1 for c in cells
              if c["cell_type"] == "code"
              and c["metadata"].get("execution_status") != "ok")
    print(f"[saved] {out} ({out.stat().st_size} bytes, {len(cells)} cells, "
          f"errors={bad})")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Диагностика E6: реальная стоимость одного PPR-запуска (30 и 100 итераций).

Зачем: первый запуск E6 не уложился в 40 минут. Замеряем время build_transition,
PPR30, PPR100 на сплите main (aw=0.5, restart=0.5), чтобы оценить бюджет сетки
(12 точек × 2 сплита) и проверки сходимости.
"""
import time

from exp3_e1_attr_ppr import load_item_attrs, build_graph_base, build_transition, \
    ppr_tripartite
from exp4_common import SPLITS, load_inter, prepare_split, als_rankings_p
import numpy as np

AW = 0.5
ALPHA = 0.5


def main():
    inter, sub_users = load_inter()
    cfg = SPLITS["main"]
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    train, _, _, _, val_users, pool_full, rank_pop = \
        prepare_split(inter, sub_users, cfg, pool_size=500)
    item_attrs = load_item_attrs(cfg["attrs_files"])
    base = build_graph_base(train, pool_full, item_attrs)
    print(f"prepare+graph: {time.perf_counter() - t0:.1f}s", flush=True)

    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    T = build_transition(base, AW)
    print(f"build_transition: {time.perf_counter() - t0:.1f}s, nnz(T)={T.nnz}", flush=True)

    nU = base["nU"]
    n_nodes = nU + base["nI"] + base["nA"]
    B = len(val_users)
    restart_mat = np.zeros((n_nodes, B))
    for b, u in enumerate(val_users):
        ui = base["u_map"].get(u)
        if ui is None:
            continue
        idxs, ws = base["per_user"][ui]
        restart_mat[nU + idxs, b] = ws

    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    P30 = ppr_tripartite(T, restart_mat, n_iter=30, alpha=ALPHA)
    t30 = time.perf_counter() - t0
    print(f"PPR n_iter=30: {t30:.1f}s", flush=True)

    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    P100 = ppr_tripartite(T, restart_mat, n_iter=100, alpha=ALPHA)
    t100 = time.perf_counter() - t0
    print(f"PPR n_iter=100: {t100:.1f}s", flush=True)

    d = float(np.abs(P30 - P100).max())
    print(f"max|P30 - P100| (все узлы): {d:.3e}; alpha^30={ALPHA ** 30:.3e}", flush=True)
    print(f"\nОценка бюджета E6: сетка 12x2 PPR30 ≈ {24 * t30:.0f}s; "
          f"проверка сходимости (6 точек: 1 aw на restart) ≈ {6 * t100:.0f}s",
          flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

1: # Task: Improve Kaggle sweet.tv TV Program Recommender MAP@5
2: 
3: You are a senior recommender-systems engineer and ML researcher. Your task is to improve the existing solution for the Kaggle competition **sweet.tv — TV program recommender**.
4: 
5: Do not start from scratch. First inspect the existing repository, implementation, experiment results, validation code, feature engineering, and submission generation pipeline. Preserve working components and build on the strongest verified results.
6: 
7: ## 1. Current results and baseline
8: 
9: The current best submission is:
10: 
11: - `submission_hybrid_pop_als_w01.csv`
12: - Candidate generation: top-50 programs ranked by popularity × log(1 + airings)
13: - Re-ranking: implicit ALS with weight `w=0.1`
14: - Public MAP@5: 0.30215
15: - Private MAP@5: 0.29635
16: 
17: The strongest pure popularity baseline is:
18: 
19: - `submission_pop_x_log_airings.csv`
20: - Score: Public 0.30050, Private 0.29538
21:

23:

25: - Popularity + content-based re-ranking: Public 0.28914, Private 0.28692
26: - Repeat-own-history approaches: Public 0.27339, Private 0.24269

29: 
30: - Pure popularity: MAP@5 = 0.4565
31: - ALS hybrid: MAP@5 = 0.4544
32: - Channel-based content model: MAP@5 = 0.4182
33: 
34: The Kaggle improvement of the ALS hybrid over the strongest pure baseline is small. The local validation ranking disagrees with Kaggle. Treat the improvement as uncertain rather than assuming ALS is universally superior.
35: 
36: ## 2. Primary objective
37: 
38: Find a reproducible recommendation strategy that improves MAP@5 on a valid chronological holdout and produces a valid Kaggle submission.
39: 
40: Optimize MAP@5, not accuracy, RMSE, AUC, or an unrelated proxy metric.
41: 
42: Use the existing Kaggle evaluation results as historical evidence, not as a substitute for local validation. Do not claim an improvement unless the relevant experiment has actually been run.
43: 
44: ## 3. First inspect the repository
45: 
46: Before changing code:
47: 
48: 1. Inspect the repository tree, README, data schemas, preprocessing, joins, training scripts, validation code, diagnostics, and submission generation.
49: 2. Read `results/tables/hybrid_validation.csv` and `results/tables/diagnostics_strict.csv`.
50: 3. Locate the exact code that generates the best submission and reproduce its predictions if feasible.
51: 4. Verify how viewing intervals are joined to scheduled programs, how viewing duration is thresholded, how `tv_show_id = 0` is handled, and how candidate IDs are mapped to submission IDs.
52: 5. Check for data leakage, train-validation contamination, duplicate interactions, incorrect temporal boundaries, and inconsistencies between local validation and test inference.
53: 6. Identify which code paths and settings generated each recorded score.
54: 
55: Do not overwrite the existing best submission or experiment outputs. Use versioned experiment files.
56: 
57: ## 4. Highest-priority experiments
58: 
59: Run experiments incrementally, measuring the marginal contribution of each change.
60: 
61: ### A. Improve the popularity baseline
62: 
63: Test the following alternatives on exactly the same chronological validation splits:
64: 
65: - Different recent-history windows, such as 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 weeks.
66: - Exponential time decay instead of a hard cutoff.
67: - Unique-user popularity versus interaction-count popularity.
68: - Duration-weighted and binary interactions.
69: - Popularity normalized by channel, category, or airing frequency.
70: - Smoothed popularity estimates for rare programs.
71: - Robust combinations of recent popularity and long-term popularity.
72: - Alternative exponents for the airing-frequency adjustment:
73:   score = popularity × (1 + airings)^alpha.
74: - Compare raw counts, logarithmic transforms, and normalized scores.
75: 
76: Avoid optimizing dozens of parameters blindly. Use a structured search, record all results, and retain only changes supported by validation.
77: 
78: ### B. Improve candidate generation
79: 
80: The current ALS hybrid considers only the top-50 popularity candidates. This may exclude relevant programs before re-ranking.
81: 
82: Test candidate pools of 50, 100, 200, and 500 programs where computationally feasible.
83: 
84: Measure candidate recall@5 and recall@K on validation. Determine whether the best ranking model is constrained by missing relevant candidates.
85: 
86: Test unions of candidate generators:
87: 
88: - Popularity candidates.
89: - ALS recommendations.
90: - Item-item collaborative filtering.
91: - User-program co-view similarity.
92: - Content-based candidates from genres, categories, actors, and directors.
93: - Channel or time-slot affinity, only where supported by the data and valid at recommendation time.
94: 
95: Deduplicate candidates and ensure all methods use the same eligible program pool and repeat policy.
96: 
97: ### C. Improve collaborative filtering
98: 
99: Inspect the existing ALS implementation before replacing it.
100: 
101: Test a small, controlled grid of:
102: 
103: - Latent factors.
104: - Regularization.
105: - Confidence scaling for implicit feedback.
106: - Binary versus count-weighted interactions.
107: - Duration weighting with robust clipping.
108: - Time-decayed user-program interactions.
109: - Random seeds and initialization stability where applicable.
110: 
111: Compare ALS with item-item cosine similarity and co-view graph recommendations. Consider BPR only if the available interaction construction and runtime justify it.
112: 
113: Do not assume that a more complex model will perform better.
114: 
115: ### D. Improve the hybrid ranking
116: 
117: Compare these approaches:
118: 
119: 1. Pure popularity ranking.
120: 2. Popularity candidates plus ALS re-ranking.
121: 3. Popularity candidates plus item-item scoring.
122: 4. Candidate union plus score fusion.
123: 5. Candidate union plus rank fusion.
124: 6. A lightweight LightGBM ranker, if reliable out-of-time training examples can be constructed.
125: 
126: Tune fusion weights using validation only. Consider user-history length and confidence-dependent blending, but keep such rules only if they improve the same validation metric.
127: 
128: For LightGBM, prevent target leakage when creating training features. Use temporally valid historical examples rather than features calculated from future interactions.
129: 
130: ### E. Improve interaction construction
131: 
132: Audit the view-to-schedule join and run controlled comparisons of defensible viewing thresholds.
133: 
134: Check interval overlap, duration normalization, channel-ID mapping, schedule boundaries, timezone consistency, duplicate rows, and programme-ID coverage.
135: 
136: Do not silently change preprocessing while comparing models. Track each preprocessing change as a separate experiment.
137: 
138: ## 5. Validation protocol
139: 
140: Use a chronological validation design that mimics the real task: predict future viewing behavior from earlier data.
141: 
142: - Fit all model parameters and interaction statistics on training history only.
143: - Use validation labels only for evaluation and model selection.
144: - Do not use validation or test viewing behavior as input features.
145: - Use the same candidate eligibility and repeat policy across methods.
146: - Define cold-start behavior explicitly.
147: - Report MAP@5 on identical validation users and time windows.
148: - Where feasible, evaluate multiple forward-chaining temporal windows.

# Отчёт: рекомендации TV-программ (sweet.tv — TV program recommender, MAP@5)

**Квиз GSB, дедлайн 24.10.2026 19:00 МСК.** Индивидуальная работа.
Репозиторий: см. §9. Все числа в отчёте воспроизводимы командами из §9 и
происходят из таблиц `results/tables/` или из возвращённых Kaggle-скоров
(run-id указан).

---

## §1 Постановка

Конкурс [sweet.tv — TV program recommender](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/sweettv-tv-program-recommender)
(slug `sweettv-tv-program-recommender`, id 24201) — community prediction,
лёд заморожен, поздние сабмиты принимаются. Метрика страницы — MAP@{K};
шаблон несёт пять id на строку, поэтому **везде K = 5**: в сабмите, в
валидации, в отчёте. Позиция в когорте (§10 квиза) определяется только
**возвращённым public score** назначенного сабмита.

Задача: по логу просмотров недель 11–30 предсказать, какие пять программ
каждый из 1 260 тестовых пользователей посмотрит в неделях 31–42.
Джойн лога к расписанию → валидация на хронологическом hold-out →
минимум два реализованных метода → гибрид с документированным выбором весов.

## §2 Данные (EDA: `docs/facts.md`, скрипт `artifacts/scripts/eda.py`)

| Файл | Строк | Роль |
|---|---:|---|
| `dataset11-30.csv` | 5 821 987 | лог просмотров (нед. 11–30) |
| `export_arh_11-20-final.csv` | 1 074 235 | расписание train |
| `export_arh_21-30-final.csv` | 1 074 394 | расписание validation |
| `export_arh_31-42-final.csv` | 1 295 378 | расписание test (31–42) |
| `submission.csv` | 1 260 × 5 | шаблон |

Ключевые факты (`docs/facts.md`):

- **Только 10,8 % строк расписания несут `tv_show_id`** (нед. 11–20:
  115 613 из 1 074 235; 21–30: 121 505 из 1 074 394; 31–42: 144 774 из
  1 295 378). Остальное — неразмеченный эфир, item'ом быть не может.
- Размеченные программы: 5 847 (11–20) / 6 363 (21–30) / 6 636 (31–42);
  пересечение всех трёх файлов — 3 260; **новых программ в тесте,
  отсутствующих в train, — 1 437** (`docs/facts.md:48-52`).
- Лог: 4 914 пользователей, `duraton` (опечатка в файле) == `stop_time −
  start_time` (проверка: 583/583 сэмплов, `docs/facts.md:65`), медиана 394 с.
- Тестовых пользователей: 1 260; **cold-start без истории — 0** (0,0 %,
  `docs/facts.md:83`).
- Среда: Python 3.14.8, macOS arm64, `uv`, SEED=42 везде.

## §3 Джойн лог × расписание (правило просмотра)

`artifacts/scripts/join_interactions.py`, проверки — `reports/join_checks.txt`:

1. **Канал:** `vsetv_id` ≡ `channel_id`. Сверено на сдвигах часовых поясов —
   максимум совпадений ровно на сдвиге 0 ч (иначе расписание ушло бы в UTC).
   98,0 % строк лога попадают в каналы расписаний (`docs/facts.md:60`).
2. **Пересечение интервалов** `[view_start, view_stop)` × `[air_start,
   air_start+duration)`.
3. **Порог «просмотрено»:** пересечение ≥ **300 с ИЛИ ≥ 50 % длительности

- PPR/гибрид — пул топ-500 по pop×log(1+эфиров) (пространство их валидации).
Fallback одинаковый: популярность Recent-4w.

Выбор пользователей идентичен examples.py (детерминированно) — те же два id.
Выход: reports/examples_full.md (прежний examples.md не перезаписывается).
"""
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
from implicit.als import AlternatingLeastSquares

from exp_rrf_hybrid import DATA, RESULTS, SEED, evaluate, build_split, rank_list_from_scores
from exp_assoc_rules import (
    MIN_SUPPORT, build_transactions, count_itemsets, frequent_pairs,
    generate_rules, rank_from_scores,
)
from exp3_e1_attr_ppr import load_item_attrs, build_graph_base
from exp3_e3_rrf_weights import tripartite_rankings, rank_matrix, fuse_weighted_top5
from exp4_common import SPLITS

REPORTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "reports"

# конфигурация гибрида (exp3_e3b — Kaggle 0.34487/0.32361)
HYBRID = dict(k_rrf=20, w=(1.0, 2.0, 1.0), ppr_aw=0.5, ppr_alpha=0.5,
              als=dict(factors=64, reg=0.05, iterations=20))
POOL_SIZE = 500


def build_top5(score_dict, pop_rank, k=5):
    items = sorted(score_dict.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], pop_rank.get(kv[0], 10**9)))
    return [i for i, _ in items[:k]]


def main():
    inter = pd.read_parquet(DATA / "user_interactions.parquet")
    inter["user_id"] = inter["user_id"].astype(str)
    train = inter[inter["week"] <= 20].copy()
    val = inter[(inter["week"] > 20) & (inter["week"] <= 30)].copy()

    val_sched = pd.read_csv(DATA / "export_arh_21-30-final.csv")
    sched_lookup = val_sched[val_sched["tv_show_id"] != 0].drop_duplicates("tv_show_id").set_index("tv_show_id")
    candidates = sched_lookup.index.unique().tolist()

    # выбор пользователей — идентичен examples.py (тяжёлый/лёгкий)
    user_counts = train.groupby("user_id")["overlap_seconds"].agg(["count", "sum"])
    val_users_set = set(val["user_id"].unique())
    eligible = user_counts[user_counts.index.isin(val_users_set)]
    heavy_user = eligible.sort_values("sum", ascending=False).index[0]
    light_user = eligible[eligible["count"] >= 1].sort_values("count").index[0]
    two_users = [heavy_user, light_user]
    print(f"users: heavy={heavy_user}, light={light_user}", flush=True)

    # --- популярность Recent-4w (как examples.py) ---
    pop_recent = train[train["week"] >= 17].groupby("tv_show_id")["user_id"].nunique().sort_values(ascending=False)
    pop_rank_train = {it: r for r, it in enumerate(pop_recent.index)}
    top5_pop = pop_recent.index.tolist()[:5]

    # ранги популярности по кандидатам (для ничьих AR/гибрида, как в exp_assoc/exp_rrf)
    pop_cand = train[train["week"] >= 17].groupby("tv_show_id")["user_id"].nunique()
    pop_cand = pop_cand.reindex(candidates).fillna(0.0).sort_values(ascending=False)
    pop_rank_cand = {it: r for r, it in enumerate(pop_cand.index)}

    # --- ALS (как examples.py: полный пул кандидатов) ---
    train_items = train["tv_show_id"].unique()
    train_users = train["user_id"].unique()
    u_map = {u: i for i, u in enumerate(train_users)}
    i_map = {it: i for i, it in enumerate(train_items)}
    rows = train["user_id"].map(u_map).values
    cols = train["tv_show_id"].map(i_map).values
    data = np.log1p(train["overlap_seconds"].values)
    mat = csr_matrix((data, (rows, cols)), shape=(len(u_map), len(i_map)))
    als = AlternatingLeastSquares(factors=64, regularization=0.05, iterations=20, random_state=SEED)
    als.fit(mat)
    cand_known = [c for c in candidates if c in i_map]
    cand_unknown = [c for c in candidates if c not in i_map]
    item_factors = als.item_factors[np.array([i_map[c] for c in cand_known])]

    def als_top5(user):
        if user not in u_map:
            return top5_pop
        uf = als.user_factors[u_map[user]]
        scores = item_factors @ uf
        min_score = scores.min() - 1.0
        score_dict = dict(zip(cand_known, scores))
        for c in cand_unknown:
            score_dict[c] = min_score
        return build_top5(score_dict, pop_rank_train)

    # --- CBF (как examples.py) ---
    sched_tr = pd.read_csv(DATA / "export_arh_11-20-final.csv")
    feat = sched_tr[sched_tr["tv_show_id"] != 0].drop_duplicates("tv_show_id").copy()
    genre_cols = []
    for col in ["tv_show_category", "tv_show_genre_1", "tv_show_genre_2", "tv_show_genre_3"]:
        genre_cols.append(pd.get_dummies(feat[col].fillna(""), prefix=col))
    feat["year"] = pd.to_numeric(feat["year_of_production"], errors="coerce").fillna(2000)
    feat["decade"] = (feat["year"] // 10 * 10).astype(int).astype(str)
    feats = pd.concat(genre_cols + [pd.get_dummies(feat["decade"], prefix="decade")], axis=1).values.astype(float)
    feats = feats / (np.linalg.norm(feats, axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-9)
    cbf_id_to_idx = {it: i for i, it in enumerate(feat["tv_show_id"].values)}
    train_w = train.copy()
    train_w["weight"] = np.log1p(train_w["overlap_seconds"])

    def cbf_top5(user):
        g = train_w[train_w["user_id"] == user]
        mask = g["tv_show_id"].isin(cbf_id_to_idx)
        if not mask.any():
            return top5_pop
        idxs = [cbf_id_to_idx[sid] for sid in g.loc[mask, "tv_show_id"]]
        weights = g.loc[mask, "weight"].values
        profile = (feats[idxs].T @ weights) / weights.sum()
        profile = profile / (np.linalg.norm(profile) + 1e-9)
        known = [c for c in candidates if c in cbf_id_to_idx]
        scores = feats[np.array([cbf_id_to_idx[c] for c in known])] @ profile
        return build_top5(dict(zip(known, scores)), pop_rank_train)

    # --- Association Rules (как exp_assoc_rules: транзакции user×week, support>=0.2%, lift>1) ---
    txns = build_transactions(train)
    n_txn = len(txns)
    item_count, pair_count = count_itemsets(txns)
    freq_pairs = frequent_pairs(pair_count, n_txn, MIN_SUPPORT)
    rules = generate_rules(freq_pairs, item_count, n_txn)
    rules_by_ant = defaultdict(list)
    for r in rules:
        rules_by_ant[r["antecedent"]].append((r["consequent"], r["confidence"]))
    print(f"AR: транзакций={n_txn}, частых пар={len(freq_pairs)}, правил lift>1={len(rules)}", flush=True)

    recent4w = train[(train["week"] >= 17) & (train["overlap_seconds"] > 0)]
    user_recent_items = recent4w.groupby("user_id")["tv_show_id"].apply(lambda s: set(s.unique()))

    def ar_top5(user):
        A_set = user_recent_items.get(user, set())
        if not A_set:
            return top5_pop
        score = defaultdict(float)
        for a in A_set:
            for c, conf in rules_by_ant.get(a, []):
                if c in candidates:
                    score[c] += conf
        if not score:
            return top5_pop
        ids = list(score.keys())
        scores = np.array([score[i] for i in ids])
        top = rank_from_scores(ids, scores, pop_rank_cand)
        for p in top5_pop:
            if len(top) >= 5:
                break
            if p not in top:
                top.append(p)
        return top[:5]

    # --- PPR и гибрид (пространство: пул топ-500, как в их валидации exp3) ---
    cfg = SPLITS["main"]
    train_s, _, _, _, _, pool_full, rank_pop = \
        build_split_and_pool(inter, cfg) if False else (None,) * 6  # placeholder
    train_s, val_sched_s, candidates_s, relevant_s, val_users_s, pool_full, rank_pop = \
        prepare_split(inter, list(eligible.index), cfg, pool_size=POOL_SIZE)
    item_attrs = load_item_attrs(cfg["attrs_files"])
    base = build_graph_base(train_s, pool_full, item_attrs)

    def ppr_pool_rankings(aw, alpha):
        r, _ = tripartite_rankings(base, base["per_user"], pool_full, rank_pop,
                                   two_users, aw, alpha=alpha, k_pool=POOL_SIZE)
        return r

    ppr_bip = ppr_pool_rankings(aw=0.0, alpha=HYBRID["ppr_alpha"])   # бипартитный (aw=0 ≡ контроль)
    ppr_tri = ppr_pool_rankings(aw=HYBRID["ppr_aw"], alpha=HYBRID["ppr_alpha"])

    from exp4_common import als_rankings_p
    als_pool = als_rankings_p(train_s, two_users, pool_full, rank_pop, **HYBRID["als"])

    def rrf_top5():
        M_pop = rank_matrix({u: list(pool_full) for u in two_users}, two_users, pool_full)
        M_ppr = rank_matrix(ppr_tri, two_users, pool_full)
        M_als = rank_matrix(als_pool, two_users, pool_full)
        order = fuse_weighted_top5([M_pop, M_ppr, M_als], HYBRID["w"], HYBRID["k_rrf"])
        return {u: [pool_full[j] for j in order[i]] for i, u in enumerate(two_users)}

    hybrid_preds = rrf_top5()

    def lookup(show_id):
        if show_id in sched_lookup.index:
            row = sched_lookup.loc[show_id]
            if isinstance(row, pd.DataFrame):
                row = row.iloc[0]
            return row["tv_show_title"], row["tv_show_category"]
        return "(неизвестно, вне пула 21-30)", "-"

    lines = ["# §7 Примеры рекомендаций (полные): все методы, те же два пользователя\n"]
    lines.append(
        "Выбор пользователей идентичен `reports/examples.md`: **тяжёлый** — максимум секунд "
        "в train (11–20); **лёгкий** — минимум просмотров (≥1) при наличии просмотров в проверке (21–30). "
        "Fallback одинаковый для всех методов — популярность Recent-4w.\n\n"
        "**Пул кандидатов различается по дизайну методов:** Popularity/CBF/ALS/AR ранжируют полный пул "
        "(программы расписания 21–30 с `tv_show_id != 0`); PPR и гибрид работают в пуле топ-500 по "
        "pop×log(1+эфиров) — пространстве, на котором они валидировались (exp3). "
        "Фолбэк-заполнение до 5 слотов — популярность."
    )
    lines.append(
        f"\nКонфигурация гибрида (exp3_e3b): RRF k={HYBRID['k_rrf']}, w={HYBRID['w']}, "
        f"PPR трёхдольный attr_weight={HYBRID['ppr_aw']} (restart=0, alpha={HYBRID['ppr_alpha']}), "
        f"ALS {HYBRID['als']}."
    )

    for label, user in [("Тяжёлый", heavy_user), ("Лёгкий", light_user)]:
        lines.append(f"\n## {label} пользователь `{user}`")
        lines.append(f"- train (11–20): {eligible.loc[user,'count']:.0f} просмотров, "
                     f"{eligible.loc[user,'sum']:.0f} сек суммарно")
        watched = val[val["user_id"] == user]["tv_show_id"].unique().tolist()
        lines.append(f"- реально смотрел в проверке (21–30): {len(watched)} программ")
        lines.append("\n**Факт: что реально смотрел (21–30)**\n")
        lines.append("| id | title | category |")
        lines.append("|---|---|---|")
        for sid in watched[:10]:
            t, c = lookup(sid)
            lines.append(f"| {sid} | {t} | {c} |")
        if len(watched) > 10:
            lines.append(f"| … | ещё {len(watched)-10} программ | |")

        blocks = [
            ("Popularity (Recent 4w)", top5_pop),
            ("CBF (full pool)", cbf_top5(user)),
            ("Association Rules (Σ confidence, last-4w)", ar_top5(user)),
            ("ALS f=64 reg=0.05 it=20 (full pool)", als_top5(user)),
            ("PPR бипартитный user–item (restart=0,5; пул-500)", ppr_bip[user][:5]),
            ("PPR трёхдольный user–item–attr aw=0,5 (restart=0,5; пул-500)", ppr_tri[user][:5]),
            ("Гибрид exp3_e3b: RRF k=20 w=(1,2,1) (пул-500)", hybrid_preds[user]),
        ]
        for method_name, top5 in blocks:
            lines.append(f"\n**{method_name} — Top-5**\n")
            lines.append("| rank | id | title | category | в фактическом списке? |")
            lines.append("|---|---|---|---|---|")
            for rank, sid in enumerate(top5, 1):
                t, c = lookup(sid)
                hit = "да" if sid in watched else "нет"
                lines.append(f"| {rank} | {sid} | {t} | {c} | {hit} |")

    REPORTS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out = REPORTS / "examples_full.md"
    out.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"[saved] {out}", flush=True)
